ex.en: He must be 70 if he's a day!
ex.cn: 他至少 70 岁了！

senses.def: during the part of sb's life when they were most successful, famous, etc.

ex.en: She was a great dancer in her day.
ex.cn: 她曾是红极一时的舞蹈家。

senses.def: when sb was young

ex.en: In my day, there were plenty of jobs when you left school.
ex.cn: 我年轻时，毕业后就业机会很多。

senses.def: now, in the modern world
senses.chn: 当代；当今；在今天这个时代

senses.def: used when several unfortunate or unpleasant things happen on the same day
senses.chn: 祸不单行；特别倒霉的一天

ex.en: My car broke down and then I locked myself out—it's just not my day!
ex.cn: 我的汽车抛锚了，我又把钥匙锁到车里，真是祸不单行！

senses.def: to make sb feel very happy on a particular day

ex.en: The phone call from Mike really made my day.
ex.cn: 迈克打来电话，真让我高兴了一整天。

senses.def: to make a particular enjoyable activity last for a whole day instead of only part of it
to not have much time

ex.en: Come on! We don't have all day!
ex.cn: 快一点！我们的时间不多了！

senses.def: during a particular period of time when sb lived

ex.en: the best player of his day
ex.cn: 他那个时代最优秀的运动员

ex.en: Bessie Smith was the Madonna of her day.
ex.cn: 贝西 · 史密斯是她那个时代的麦当娜。

senses.def: that is served on a particular day in a restaurant

ex.en: soup of the day
ex.cn: 当日供应的汤

senses.def: used to emphasize what you are saying when you are surprised, shocked or annoyed
senses.chn: （吃惊或恼火时加强语气）我的天啊

ex.en: Oh my days! Is that true?
ex.cn: 我的天啊！那是真的吗？

senses.def: at some time in the future, or on a particular day in the past

ex.en: One day, I want to leave the city and move to the country.
ex.cn: 有朝一日，我要离开城市搬到乡下去。

ex.en: One day, he walked out of the house with a small bag and never came back.
ex.cn: 一天，他带了个小提包走出家门，再也没有回来。

senses.def: before a long time has passed

ex.en: One of these days you'll come back and ask me to forgive you.
ex.cn: 你很快就会回来请求我原谅的。

senses.def: a day when there are a lot of mistakes and a lot of things go wrong
senses.chn: 诸事不顺的日子；倒霉的日子

ex.en: It's been one of those days!
ex.cn: 这一天真倒霉！

senses.def: at an unknown time in the future

ex.en: Some day I'll be famous.
ex.cn: 总有一天我会成名的。

senses.def: to not think about what will happen in the future
senses.chn: 得过且过；做一天和尚撞一天钟；过一天算一天

ex.en: I don't know if he'll get better. We're just taking it one day at a time.
ex.cn: 我不知道他还能不能好转，我们只有过一天算一天。

senses.def: used when you are saying that sth is very unlikely to happen
senses.chn: 那样的事永远不可能；哪有那样的事

ex.en: Paul? Apologize? That'll be the day!
ex.cn: 保罗？道歉？那真是太阳从西边出来了！

senses.def: used to talk about the present, especially when you are comparing it with the past
senses.chn: （尤用于拿现在和过去比较）如今，而今

ex.en: These days kids grow up so quickly.
ex.cn: 如今孩子们成长得真快。

senses.def: used to suggest that a time in the past was happier or better than now
senses.chn: （指过去）那才是好时光，那才是好年头

senses.def: exactly

ex.en: It's been three years to the day since we met.
ex.cn: 我们整整三年没见面了。

senses.def: even now, when a lot of time has passed

ex.en: To this day, I still don't understand why he did it.
ex.cn: 我直到今天仍然不明白他当时为什么那样做。

senses.def: in the past

ex.en: My dad's always talking about how great everything was back in the day.
ex.cn: 我爸爸总是讲过去的一切如何如何的好。

senses.def: at a particular time in the past

ex.en: I was a fan back in the days when the band wasn't yet famous.
ex.cn: 在这个乐队还没出名的时候，我就是他们的歌迷。

senses.def: used when you are very surprised at sth you have never heard or seen before
senses.chn: （表示惊讶）这辈子（未听说，未见）

ex.en: I've never heard such nonsense in all my born days.
ex.cn: 我这辈子还从没听说过此等废话呢。

senses.def: the moment in the early hours of the morning when it begins to get light
to decide or agree to stop doing sth
senses.chn: 结束一天的工作；到此为止；停止

ex.en: After forty years in politics I think it's time for me to call it a day (= to retire).
ex.cn: 从政四十年，我想现在也该退休了。

senses.def: easy to see or understand
when you have had time to think calmly about sth; in the morning when things are clearer
senses.chn: 有时间冷静考虑时；在头脑更清醒些的第二天早晨

ex.en: These things always look different in the cold light of day.
ex.cn: 这些事情在冷静地考虑后总会显得不同。

senses.def: a helpful, kind thing that you do
everyone has good luck or success at some point in their life
used to say that it is too soon to be sure how a situation will develop
used to introduce the most important fact after everything has been considered
senses.chn: （考虑到所有情况后引出最重要的事实）最终，到头来

ex.en: At the end of the day, he'll still have to make his own decision.
ex.cn: 最终，他还得自己拿主意。

senses.def: to spend the last part of your life in a particular state or place
senses.chn: （在某种状态下或某处）度过余生，安度晚年

ex.en: He ended his days in poverty.
ex.cn: 他在贫穷中度过余生。

senses.def: the time when you have to do sth difficult or unpleasant
senses.chn: 倒霉的时候（或日子、时刻）

senses.def: beginning on that day; from that time
used to say that you prefer a particular thing or person to the one that has just been mentioned
senses.chn: 我宁愿；我更喜欢；我宁可选择

ex.en: We don't go out much. Give me a quiet night in front of the TV any day!
ex.cn: 我们不常出去。我宁愿坐在电视机前安安静静地过一夜！

senses.def: after the time when an action could be successful

ex.en: He started working hard much too late in the day—he couldn't possibly catch up.
ex.cn: 他太晚才开始努力工作，不可能赶上了。

senses.def: used to say that although you have failed or had a bad experience, you will continue
senses.chn: （虽已失败或经历很糟但仍要）改日再战，卷土重来

senses.def: the whole length of the day
a friendly way of saying goodbye, especially to customers
all the time; continuously
senses.chn: 日日夜夜；夜以继日；连续不断

ex.en: The machines are kept running night and day.
ex.cn: 这些机器夜以继日地运转着。

senses.def: a person or thing that makes people excited for a short time but does not last very long
senses.chn: 昙花一现；轰动一时的人（或事物）

senses.def: an earlier period of time in your life or in history that is seen as better/worse than the present

ex.en: That was in the bad old days of rampant inflation.
ex.cn: 那是在物价飞涨、生活艰难的往昔。

senses.def: common, popular or suitable at a particular time or for a particular occasion

ex.en: Pessimism seems to be the order of the day.
ex.cn: 悲观失望似乎是当今司空见惯的情形。

senses.def: recently
senses.chn: 那天，那天早上，那天晚上，那个星期（用于指说话前不久的日子）

ex.en: I saw Jack the other day.
ex.cn: 我前几天看到杰克了。

senses.def: to say hello to sb and have a short conversation with them
senses.chn: （与某人）寒暄，打招呼，闲谈一会儿

senses.def: very obvious
senses.chn: 一清二楚；一目了然；显而易见

senses.def: to save sth, especially money, for a time when you will really need it
used to say that a complicated task will take a long time and needs patience
senses.chn: 罗马不是一天建成的；复杂的工作不会一蹴而就

senses.def: the time when you are young and do not have much experience of life
senses.chn: 年少不谙世事的岁月；涉世未深的青少年时代

senses.def: to prevent failure or defeat, when this seems certain to happen

ex.en: Gerrard's late goal saved the day for Liverpool.
ex.cn: 杰拉德后来的进球为利物浦队挽回了败局。

senses.def: to refuse to speak to sb because you do not like or respect them

ex.en: Since the success of her novel, people shake her hand who once wouldn't have given her the time of day.
ex.cn: 自从她的小说获得成功之后，曾经懒得答理她的人也跟她握起手来。

senses.def: each day repeatedly (used especially when sth is boring or annoying)
senses.chn: 日复一日，一天又一天（尤指枯燥无味、令人厌烦）

ex.en: She hates doing the same work day after day.
ex.cn: 她讨厌日复一日做同样的工作。

senses.def: all the time; continuously
senses.chn: 日日夜夜；夜以继日；连续不断

ex.en: The machines are kept running night and day.
ex.cn: 这些机器夜以继日地运转着。

senses.def: a bed or sofa for resting on during the day
senses.chn: （供白天休息用的）床，沙发，卧榻

senses.def: a boy day pupil
the time of day when light first appears

ex.en: We left before daybreak.
ex.cn: 我们是在黎明前离开的。

senses.def: all the time; a little at a time and gradually

ex.en: Day by day his condition improved.
ex.cn: 他的健康状况一天天好转。

senses.def: care for small children, or for old or sick people, away from home, during the day

ex.en: Day care is provided by the company she works for.
ex.cn: 她工作的那家公司有日托。

senses.def: a place where small children are cared for while their parents are at work
a place that provides care for old or sick people during the day
senses.chn: （老人或病人）日间护理站，日间照顾中心

senses.def: pleasant thoughts that make you forget about the present

ex.en: She stared out of the window, lost in a daydream.
ex.cn: 她凝视窗外，沉浸在幻想之中。

senses.def: a girl day pupil
the paid work that sb normally does
senses.chn: 日常的有薪工作；（白天的）正职

senses.def: used to tell sb that they should continue doing what they are used to, rather than trying sth new which they are likely to fail at
senses.chn: 别放弃白天的正职（别放弃老本行去尝试没有把握的新事物）

ex.en: So you want to be a writer? Well my advice is, don't give up the day job.
ex.cn: 这么说你想成为一个作家了？得了，我劝你不要放弃老本行。

senses.def: the light that comes from the sun during the day

ex.en: They emerged from the church into the bright daylight.
ex.cn: 他们走出教堂来到明亮的日光下。

ex.en: The street looks very different in daylight.
ex.cn: 大街在白天看来大不一样。

ex.en: They left before daylight (= before the sun had risen).
ex.cn: 他们天亮前就走了。

senses.def: the fact of sb charging too much money for sth

ex.en: You wouldn't believe some of the prices they charge; it's daylight robbery.
ex.cn: 他们的要价有一些你都不会相信，简直就是在光天化日之下抢劫呀！

senses.def: (in) the clear light of day, when it is easy to see

ex.en: The robbery occurred in broad daylight, in a crowded street.
ex.cn: 抢劫就发生在光天化日之下的一条熙熙攘攘的街道上。

senses.def: the fact of sb charging too much money for sth

ex.en: You wouldn't believe some of the prices they charge; it's daylight robbery.
ex.cn: 他们的要价有一些你都不会相信，简直就是在光天化日之下抢劫呀！

senses.def: to hit sb very hard several times and hurt them very much
to frighten sb very much
senses.chn: 吓得某人六神无主（或魂飞魄散）

senses.def: the period during which in some countries the clocks are put forward one hour, so that it is light for an extra hour in the evening
senses.chn: 夏令时（有些国家实行夏时制，将时钟拨快一小时，以节约照明能源）

senses.def: lasting for a whole day

ex.en: a daylong meeting
ex.cn: 一整天的会议

senses.def: a place where small children are cared for while their parents are at work
a day on which you do not have to work

ex.en: Most weeks, Sunday is my only day off.
ex.cn: 我多半只有星期天才休息。

ex.en: Why not take a few days off?
ex.cn: 为什么不休息几天呢？

senses.def: a trip or visit somewhere for a day

ex.en: We had a day out in the country.
ex.cn: 我们在乡下玩了一天。

ex.en: a business trip
ex.cn: 出差

ex.en: a five-minute trip by taxi
ex.cn: 五分钟的出租车车程

ex.en: a long and difficult journey across the mountains
ex.cn: 漫长而艰难的翻山旅行

ex.en: a trip to New York
ex.cn: 去纽约的旅行

ex.en: a round-the-world trip
ex.cn: 环球旅行

senses.def: a school student who goes to a boarding school but lives at home
a system of allowing employees days off work for education
senses.chn: （职工）脱产学习，脱产进修制度，进修休假制度

ex.en: time off for study on day release
ex.cn: 请假脱产学习的时间

ex.en: a day release course
ex.cn: 脱产进修课程

senses.def: a ticket at a reduced price for a journey to a place and back again on the same day
a room in a hospital or other institution where people can sit, relax, watch television, etc. during the day
senses.chn: （医院或其他机构的）日间娱乐室，日间休息室

senses.def: a private school with students who live at home and only go to school during the day
senses.chn: 私立走读学校；私立日校

senses.def: a course of education lasting one day, at which a particular topic is discussed

ex.en: a day school at Leeds University on women in Victorian times
ex.cn: 利兹大学为期一天的关于维多利亚时代妇女的专题讲座

senses.def: a school student who goes to a boarding school but lives at home
the period during the day between the time when it gets light and the time when it gets dark

ex.en: You don't often see this bird in (the) daytime.
ex.cn: 这种鸟白天不常见。

ex.en: The park is open during (the) daytime.
ex.cn: 这个公园日间开放。

ex.en: Daytime temperatures never fell below 30°C.
ex.cn: 日间温度从未低于 30 摄氏度。

ex.en: Please give your name and daytime phone number.
ex.cn: 请提供姓名和日间联络电话。

senses.def: planning for only one day at a time
senses.chn: 按日计划的；逐日的；每天的

ex.en: I have organized the cleaning on a day-to-day basis, until our usual cleaner returns.
ex.cn: 我已逐日安排好清洁工作，直到我们的清洁工回来为止。

senses.def: involving the usual events or tasks of each day

ex.en: She has been looking after the day-to-day running of the school.
ex.cn: 她一直在负责学校的日常管理工作。

senses.def: a city in the US state of Ohio
senses.chn: 代顿（美国俄亥俄州城市）

senses.def: buying and selling shares very quickly on the same day using the Internet in order to make a profit from small price changes
senses.chn: 当日交易（用互联网即日频繁买卖股票，从微小差价中获利）

senses.def: a trip or visit completed in one day

ex.en: a day trip to France
ex.cn: 法国一日游

senses.def: clothes for wearing every day, for example for working or shopping, not for special occasions
in a confused state

ex.en: I've been in a complete daze since hearing the news.
ex.cn: 自从听到那消息，我一直茫然不知所措。

senses.def: unable to think clearly, especially because of a shock or because you have been hit on the head
senses.chn: （由于震惊或头部受到撞击）神志不清的，茫然的

ex.en: Survivors waited for the rescue boats, dazed and frightened.
ex.cn: 生还者不知所措，心有余悸，等待着救援船只。

ex.en: Jimmy was still dazed by the blow to his head.
ex.cn: 吉米由于头部被击，仍然神志不清。

senses.def: if a strong light dazzles you, it is so bright that you cannot see for a short time

ex.en: He was momentarily dazzled by the strong sunlight.
ex.cn: 强烈的阳光使他一时睁不开眼。

senses.def: to impress sb a lot with your beauty, skill, etc.
senses.chn: （美貌、技能等）使倾倒，使赞叹不已，使眼花缭乱

ex.en: He was dazzled by the warmth of her smile.
ex.cn: 她那温柔的微笑使他神魂颠倒。

senses.def: the quality that bright light has that stops you from seeing clearly
senses.chn: 耀眼眩目；令人眼花缭乱

senses.def: a thing or quality that impresses you but may prevent you from understanding or thinking clearly
senses.chn: 令人眼花缭乱的东西（或特性）

senses.def: (in Britain) Department for Business, Innovation and Skills
database management system

(in the UK) Disclosure and Barring Service (formerly called the Criminal Records Bureau), a government body that checks to see whether people have committed crimes which make them unsuitable for certain jobs, e.g. working with children, or to adopt children
senses.chn: （英国）犯罪记录披露与禁止从业局（全写为 Disclosure and Barring Service，旧称 the Criminal Records Bureau，核查某人有无犯罪记录，从而判断其是否适合做与儿童接触的工作或收养孩子等）

ex.en: a DBS check
ex.cn: 犯罪记录核查

senses.def: direct current
District of Columbia in the US

ex.en: Washington, DC
ex.cn: 华盛顿（哥伦比亚特区）

senses.def: (in Britain) Department for Culture, Media and Sport
(especially in text messages, emails, etc.) darling daughter
senses.chn: 宝贝女儿（全写为 darling daughter，尤用于短信、电邮等）

ex.en: My DD is nearly a year old now.
ex.cn: 我的宝贝女儿快一岁了。

senses.def: a date on which sth important is expected to happen
senses.chn: 重大事情预定发生日；计划行动开始日

senses.def: a chemical used, especially in the past, for killing insects that harm crops
senses.chn: 滴滴涕（旧时尤用作农业杀虫剂）

senses.def: the opposite of

ex.en: decentralization
ex.cn: 权力分散

senses.def: removing sth

ex.en: to defrost the refrigerator (= remove layers of ice from it)
ex.cn: 给冰箱除霜

senses.def: (in the Roman Catholic, Anglican and Orthodox Churches) a religious leader just below the rank of a priest
senses.chn: （天主教、圣公会和东正教会的）执事，会吏

senses.def: (in some Nonconformist Churches) a person who is not a member of the clergy, but who helps a minister with church business affairs
senses.chn: （某些不信奉英国国教的教会中协助管理教会事务的）助祭

senses.def: (in some Christian Churches) a woman who has duties that are similar to those of a deacon
senses.chn: （某些基督教会中的）女执事，女会吏，女助祭

senses.def: to make sth such as a device or chemical process stop working
senses.chn: 使（仪器等）停止工作；使失活；使（化学过程）灭活化（或减活化、钝化）

ex.en: Do you know how to deactivate the alarm?
ex.cn: 你知道如何让闹钟不响吗？

senses.def: no longer alive
senses.chn: 死的；失去生命的；枯萎的

ex.en: My mother's dead; she died in 1987.
ex.cn: 我母亲不在了，她是 1987 年去世的。

ex.en: a dead person/animal
ex.cn: 死人；死去的动物

ex.en: dead leaves/wood/skin
ex.cn: 枯叶；枯木；死皮

ex.en: He was shot dead by a gunman outside his home.
ex.cn: 他在家门外被持枪歹徒开枪打死。

ex.en: Catherine's dead body lay peacefully on the bed.
ex.cn: 凯瑟琳的尸体安详地躺在床上。

ex.en: He dropped dead (= died suddenly) last week.
ex.cn: 他上星期突然就死了。

senses.def: no longer believed in or aimed for

ex.en: Many believe the peace plan is dead.
ex.cn: 许多人认为和平计划已成泡影。

ex.en: Unfortunately racism is not yet dead.
ex.cn: 不幸的是种族歧视仍未消亡。

ex.en: Though the idea may be dead, it is far from being buried (= people still talk about it, even though there is nothing new to say).
ex.cn: 尽管这种思想可能已无人相信，但还远没被人遗忘。

senses.def: belonging to the past; no longer practised or fashionable
senses.chn: 过时的；已废弃的；不流行的

ex.en: Is the Western a dead art form?
ex.cn: 西部电影这种艺术形式过时了吗？

ex.en: a dead language (= one that is no longer spoken, for example Latin)
ex.cn: 死语言（不再通用，如拉丁语）

senses.def: finished; not able to be used any more

ex.en: dead matches
ex.cn: 划过的火柴

ex.en: There were two dead bottles of wine on the table.
ex.cn: 桌子上有两个空酒瓶。

senses.def: not working because of a lack of power
senses.chn: （因为缺电）不运行的，不转动的

ex.en: a dead battery
ex.cn: 用完的电池

ex.en: Suddenly the phone went dead.
ex.cn: 电话突然没声音了。

senses.def: very quiet, without activity or interest
senses.chn: 死气沉沉的；无活力的；无趣的

ex.en: There were no theatres, no cinemas, no coffee bars. It was dead as anything.
ex.cn: 那时既无剧院，又无电影院，也无咖啡馆，死气沉沉。

senses.def: without activity; with nobody buying or selling anything

ex.en: 'The market is absolutely dead this morning,' said one foreign exchange trader.
ex.cn: “今天早上市场萧条极了。” 一个外汇交易商说道。

ex.en: Winter is traditionally the dead season for the housing market.
ex.cn: 冬天历来是住房市场的萧条期。

senses.def: extremely tired; not well

ex.en: half dead with cold and hunger
ex.cn: 饥寒交迫，筋疲力尽

ex.en: She felt dead on her feet and didn't have the energy to question them further.
ex.cn: 她觉得累死了，没有力气继续审问他们了。

senses.def: unable to feel because of cold, etc.

ex.en: My left arm had gone dead.
ex.cn: 我的左胳臂已经麻木了。

senses.def: unable to feel or understand emotions
senses.chn: 无动于衷；麻木不仁；无感觉

ex.en: He was dead to all feelings of pity.
ex.cn: 他毫无同情心。

senses.def: showing no emotion
senses.chn: 无表情的；冷漠的；漠不关心的

ex.en: She said, 'I'm sorry, too,' in a quiet, dead voice.
ex.cn: 她平静而冷漠地说：“我也很抱歉。”

ex.en: His usually dead grey eyes were sparkling.
ex.cn: 他那平日冷漠的灰眼睛突然亮了起来。

senses.def: complete or exact

ex.en: a dead silence/calm
ex.cn: 死寂；完全静止

ex.en: the dead centre of the target
ex.cn: 靶子正中心

ex.en: The car gave a sudden jerk and came to a dead stop.
ex.cn: 汽车猛然一颠，猝然停下。

ex.en: This horse is a dead cert for (= will certainly win) the race tomorrow.
ex.cn: 这匹马明天比赛一定能赢。

ex.en: She crumpled to the floor in a dead faint (= completely unconscious).
ex.cn: 她倒在地上全然不省人事。

senses.def: never having been alive

ex.en: dead matter (= for example rock)
ex.cn: 无生命物质（如岩石）

ex.en: a dead planet (= one with no life on it)
ex.cn: 无生命存在的行星

senses.def: outside the playing area
to be dead

ex.en: You'll be sorry you said that when I'm dead and gone.
ex.cn: 我死后你会为你说的话感到后悔的。

senses.def: to look very like sb
senses.chn: 酷似，极像（某人）；（和某人）一模一样

ex.en: She's a dead ringer for a girl I used to know.
ex.cn: 她酷似我以前认识的一个女孩。

senses.def: completely dead; no longer interesting or valid
senses.chn: 完全过时；不再引人注目；失效

senses.def: completely dead
a plan, an event, etc. that has failed or is certain to fail and that is therefore not worth discussing
senses.chn: 已失败（或注定要失败、毫无讨论价值）的计划（或事情等）

senses.def: an influence that controls or restricts sth
senses.chn: （控制或阻碍事物发展的）影响

ex.en: We need to free business from the dead hand of bureaucracy.
ex.cn: 我们必须摆脱官僚主义对工作的严重影响。

senses.def: a person or plan that is dead in the water has failed and has little hope of succeeding in the future

ex.en: His leadership campaign is dead in the water.
ex.cn: 他参加领导层竞选无望成功。

senses.def: in serious trouble

ex.en: If anyone finds out, you're dead meat.
ex.cn: 如果有人发现，你可要倒大霉了。

senses.def: (of an accident victim or other patient) already dead when arriving at hospital
senses.chn: （事故受害者或病人）到达医院时已经死亡

ex.en: She was pronounced dead on arrival.
ex.cn: 她在送达医院时即被宣布死亡。

senses.def: very unlikely to be successful; not working when it is delivered
senses.chn: 已不可能成功；到货即损；到达时已无用

ex.en: The bill was dead on arrival in the Senate.
ex.cn: 这项法案在参议院就不可能通过。

ex.en: The software was DOA.
ex.cn: 这软件送达时已经损坏。

senses.def: fast asleep
used to show you are strongly opposed to sth
senses.chn: （表示强烈反对）除非我死了，我死也不

ex.en: She moves into our home over my dead body.
ex.cn: 除非我死了，否则她别想搬进我们家。

senses.def: used to say that you would not like to wear particular clothes, or to be in a particular situation
senses.chn: （表示不愿穿戴某衣物或处于某种环境）死也不愿意

ex.en: She wouldn't be seen dead in a hat.
ex.cn: 她最讨厌戴帽子。

ex.en: He wouldn't be caught dead going to a club with his mother.
ex.cn: 他死也不愿意跟母亲一起去俱乐部。

senses.def: to waste your effort by trying to do sth that is no longer possible
senses.chn: 鞭策死马；做徒劳无益的事

senses.def: to impress sb very much

ex.en: You look fabulous—you'll knock 'em dead tonight.
ex.cn: 你看上去漂亮极了，今晚肯定把他们迷倒。

senses.def: people who have died

ex.en: The dead and wounded in that one attack amounted to 6 000.
ex.cn: 仅那一次进攻就死伤达 6 000 人。

senses.def: the state of being dead

ex.en: Christians believe that God raised Jesus from the dead.
ex.cn: 基督徒相信上帝使耶稣复活。

ex.en: In nine years he has brought his party back from the dead almost to the brink of power.
ex.cn: 九年来他使该党起死回生，甚至差点成为执政党。

senses.def: in the quietest part of the night
senses.chn: 深夜；在夜晚万籁俱寂时

ex.en: I crept out of bed in the dead of night and sneaked downstairs.
ex.cn: 深夜我悄悄地从床上爬起来，蹑手蹑脚地下了楼。

senses.def: in the coldest part of winter
completely; exactly

ex.en: You're dead right!
ex.cn: 你完全正确！

ex.en: a dead straight road
ex.cn: 笔直的道路

ex.en: The train was dead on time.
ex.cn: 火车正点出发。

ex.en: He's dead against the idea.
ex.cn: 他坚决反对这个想法。

ex.en: The sight made him stop dead in his tracks (= stop suddenly).
ex.cn: 一看这情景，他惊呆了。

ex.en: She's dead set on getting (= determined to get) this new job.
ex.cn: 她打定主意要得到这个新工作。

senses.def: very; extremely

ex.en: The instructions are dead easy to follow.
ex.cn: 这些指令很容易执行。

ex.en: You were dead lucky to get that job.
ex.cn: 你得到那份工作，真是太幸运了。

ex.en: I was dead scared.
ex.cn: 我怕得要死。

senses.def: to pretend not to have seen sb; to refuse to say hello to sb
senses.chn: 假装没看见，不理睬（某人）

ex.en: She saw me, recognized me and cut me dead.
ex.cn: 她看见了我，也认出了我，却不理睬我。

senses.def: with definite proof of having committed a crime, so that you cannot claim to be innocent

ex.en: We've got you bang to rights handling stolen property.
ex.cn: 你在销赃时被我们抓了个正着。

senses.def: very tired

ex.en: You look dead beat.
ex.cn: 你好像累得够呛。

senses.def: a lazy person; a person with no job and no money, who is not part of normal society
senses.chn: 懒人；二流子；身无分文的无业者

senses.def: a person or company that tries to avoid paying their debts
senses.chn: 赖账者；赖债者；不讲信用的公司

senses.def: a father who does not live with his children and does not pay their mother any money to take care of them
senses.chn: （不与子女同住，也不支付抚养费的）无良父亲，失职父亲

senses.def: a type of lock on a door that needs a key to open or close it
a temporary and small upward movement in share prices after a large fall, often before they start to fall again
senses.chn: “死猫反弹”（股价大跌后出现的短暂小幅反弹）

senses.def: to make sth such as a sound, a feeling, etc. less strong
senses.chn: 使（声音、感觉等）减弱，缓和，迟钝

ex.en: He was given drugs to deaden the pain.
ex.cn: 给了他止痛药。

senses.def: a road, passage, etc. that is closed at one end
senses.chn: 一头封死的道路（或通道等）

ex.en: The first street we tried turned out to be a dead end.
ex.cn: 我们想走的头一条路结果是条死胡同。

senses.def: a point at which you can make no further progress in what you are doing

ex.en: We had come to a dead end in our research.
ex.cn: 我们的研究工作已陷入绝境。

ex.en: He's in a dead-end job in the local factory (= one with low wages and no hope of promotion).
ex.cn: 他在当地工厂的工作是没有前途的。

ex.en: These negotiations are a dead-end street (= they have reached a point where no further progress is possible).
ex.cn: 谈判陷入僵局。

senses.def: to remove dead flowers from a plant
a result in a race when two of those taking part finish at exactly the same time
senses.chn: （速度比赛中两个参赛者）同时到达终点，成绩并列

senses.def: a situation during a race or competition, etc. when two or more people are at the same level
senses.chn: 势均力敌；不分胜负；不相上下

ex.en: The two candidates are in a dead heat in the polls.
ex.cn: 两名候选人在民意测验中势均力敌。

senses.def: a person or plan that is dead in the water has failed and has little hope of succeeding in the future

ex.en: His leadership campaign is dead in the water.
ex.cn: 他参加领导层竞选无望成功。

senses.def: a law or an agreement that still exists but that is ignored
senses.chn: 无人遵守的法律；形同虚设的协定；空文

senses.def: a letter that cannot be delivered to an address or to the person who sent it
senses.chn: 死信；无法投递（或退回）的邮件

senses.def: a point in time by which sth must be done

ex.en: I prefer to work to a deadline.
ex.cn: 我喜欢按规定的期限完成工作。

ex.en: The deadline for applications is 30 April.
ex.cn: 交申请书的截止日期是 4 月 30 日。

ex.en: the January 15 deadline set by the United Nations
ex.cn: 联合国规定的 1 月 15 日最后期限

senses.def: a complete failure to reach agreement or settle an argument

ex.en: European agriculture ministers failed to break the deadlock over farm subsidies.
ex.cn: 欧洲各国农业部长在农业补贴问题上未能打破僵局。

ex.en: The strike appeared to have reached deadlock.
ex.cn: 罢工好像已陷入僵局。

ex.en: The strike has reached a deadlock.
ex.cn: 罢工已陷入僵局。

senses.def: a type of lock on a door that needs a key to open or close it
a person or thing that is not helpful or useful

ex.en: He may be a very talented designer, but as a manager he's a dead loss.
ex.cn: 他可能是一个很有天赋的设计师，但作为经理他却很无能。

senses.def: causing or likely to cause death

ex.en: a deadly weapon/disease
ex.cn: 致命的武器／疾病

ex.en: deadly poison
ex.cn: 剧毒

ex.en: The cobra is one of the world's deadliest snakes.
ex.cn: 眼镜蛇是世界上最致命的蛇类之一。

ex.en: The terrorists have chosen to play a deadly game with the civilian population.
ex.cn: 恐怖分子决意要同平民百姓玩死亡游戏。

senses.def: extreme; complete

ex.en: I'm in deadly earnest.
ex.cn: 我是非常认真的。

ex.en: We sat in deadly silence.
ex.cn: 我们默不作声地坐着。

ex.en: They are deadly enemies (= are full of hatred for each other).
ex.cn: 他们是不共戴天的仇敌。

senses.def: extremely effective, so that no defence is possible
senses.chn: 非常有效的；无法防御的

ex.en: His aim is deadly (= so accurate that he can kill easily).
ex.cn: 他弹无虚发。

ex.en: It was the deadly striker's 11th goal of the season.
ex.cn: 这是杀手前锋本赛季的第 11 个进球。

senses.def: very boring

ex.en: The lecture was absolutely deadly.
ex.cn: 这讲座简直无聊透了。

senses.def: extremely

ex.en: deadly serious/dull
ex.cn: 极其严肃认真／乏味

senses.def: a very poisonous plant with purple flowers and black berries
senses.chn: 颠茄（有毒，开紫花，结黑色浆果）

senses.def: one of the seven actions for which you can go to hell, in Christian tradition
senses.chn: 七罪宗之一，大罪（基督教指罪恶的根源）

ex.en: Greed is one of the seven deadly sins.
ex.cn: 贪婪是七罪宗之一。

senses.def: in serious trouble

ex.en: If anyone finds out, you're dead meat.
ex.cn: 如果有人发现，你可要倒大霉了。

senses.def: (of an accident victim or other patient) already dead when arriving at hospital
senses.chn: （事故受害者或病人）到达医院时已经死亡

ex.en: She was pronounced dead on arrival.
ex.cn: 她在送达医院时即被宣布死亡。

senses.def: very unlikely to be successful; not working when it is delivered
senses.chn: 已不可能成功；到货即损；到达时已无用

ex.en: The bill was dead on arrival in the Senate.
ex.cn: 这项法案在参议院就不可能通过。

ex.en: The software was DOA.
ex.cn: 这软件送达时已经损坏。

senses.def: without any expression or emotion; often pretending to be serious when you are joking
senses.chn: 面无表情的；不带感情色彩的；冷面幽默的

ex.en: deadpan humour
ex.cn: 冷面幽默

senses.def: fast asleep
a thing that is very heavy and difficult to lift or move
a person or thing that makes it difficult for sth to succeed or change
people or things that have become useless or unnecessary in an organization
a place or a period of time in which nothing happens
senses.chn: 空白地带，空白期（没有事情发生）

ex.en: The town is a cultural dead zone.
ex.cn: 这个镇子是个文化荒原。

senses.def: an area which separates two places, groups of people, etc.

ex.en: The UN is trying to maintain a dead zone between the warring groups.
ex.cn: 联合国正试图在交战方之间保留隔离带。

senses.def: a place where a mobile/cell phone does not work because no signal can be received
an area of water in which animals cannot live because there is not enough oxygen
senses.chn: 死水区（因缺氧而使动物无法生存）

senses.def: unable to hear anything or unable to hear very well

ex.en: to become/go deaf
ex.cn: 变聋

ex.en: She was born deaf.
ex.cn: 她天生耳聋。

senses.def: people who cannot hear

ex.en: television subtitles for the deaf and hard of hearing
ex.cn: 为耳聋和耳背者做的电视字幕

ex.en: a business trip
ex.cn: 出差

ex.en: a five-minute trip by taxi
ex.cn: 五分钟的出租车车程

ex.en: a long and difficult journey across the mountains
ex.cn: 漫长而艰难的翻山旅行

ex.en: a trip to New York
ex.cn: 去纽约的旅行

ex.en: a round-the-world trip
ex.cn: 环球旅行

senses.def: not willing to listen or pay attention to sth

ex.en: He was deaf to my requests for help.
ex.cn: 他对我的求助充耳不闻。

senses.def: very deaf
senses.chn: 全聋；聋得什么也听不见

senses.def: to be ignored or not noticed by other people
senses.chn: 不被理睬；不被注意；被置若罔闻

ex.en: Her advice fell on deaf ears.
ex.cn: 她的忠告没有受到重视。

senses.def: to ignore or refuse to listen to sb/sth

ex.en: He turned a deaf ear to the rumours.
ex.cn: 他对这些谣言置若罔闻。

senses.def: to make sb unable to hear the sounds around them because there is too much noise

ex.en: The noise of the siren was deafening her.
ex.cn: 汽笛声震得她耳朵都快聋了。

senses.def: to make sb deaf
very loud

ex.en: deafening applause
ex.cn: 掌声如雷

ex.en: The noise of the machine was deafening.
ex.cn: 机器的轰鸣声震耳欲聋。

ex.en: The government's response to the report has been a deafening silence (= it was very noticeable that nothing was said or done).
ex.cn: 政府对此报道显然置之不理。

senses.def: a person who is unable to hear or speak
to give cards to each player in a game of cards

ex.en: Whose turn is it to deal?
ex.cn: 该谁发牌了？

ex.en: Start by dealing out ten cards to each player.
ex.cn: 首先给每家发十张牌。

ex.en: He dealt me two aces.
ex.cn: 他给我发了两张 A 牌。

senses.def: to buy and sell illegal drugs

ex.en: You can often see people dealing openly on the streets.
ex.cn: 经常可以看到一些人在大街上公然买卖毒品。

senses.def: to be very shocking or harmful to sb/sth
senses.chn: 令…震惊；给…以打击；使…受到伤害

ex.en: Her sudden death dealt a blow to the whole country.
ex.cn: 她突然逝世，举国上下为之震惊。

senses.def: to hit sb/sth
used to tell sb that they cannot change a situation so they must accept it
senses.chn: （用以告诉某人无法改变现状）接受现实吧

ex.en: That's the way it is, so deal with it!
ex.cn: 就是这个样子，接受现实吧！

senses.def: to do a lot of complicated deals in business or politics, often in a dishonest way
senses.chn: （在商界或政界）工于心计；（以不正当的方式）进行纷繁复杂的交易，周旋

senses.def: to buy and sell a particular product

ex.en: The company deals in computer software.
ex.cn: 这个公司经营计算机软件。

senses.def: to accept sth as a basis for your decisions, attitudes or actions

ex.en: We don't deal in rumours or guesswork.
ex.cn: 我们不听信谣言，也不胡乱猜测。

senses.def: to include sb in an activity
senses.chn: 将某人算在里边；让某人参与

ex.en: That sounds great. Deal me in!
ex.cn: 这听起来太棒了。算我一个！

senses.def: to share sth out among a group of people

ex.en: The profits were dealt out among the investors.
ex.cn: 利润分给了投资者。

senses.def: to say what punishment sb should have

ex.en: Many judges deal out harsher sentences to men than to women.
ex.cn: 许多法官对男性比对女性的判决更严厉。

senses.def: to take appropriate action in a particular situation or according to who you are talking to, managing, etc.

ex.en: She is used to dealing with all kinds of people in her job.
ex.cn: 她已习惯于和工作中遇到的各种各样的人打交道。

senses.def: to do business with a person, a company or an organization
to solve a problem, perform a task, etc.

ex.en: to deal with enquiries/issues/complaints
ex.cn: 处理各种询问／问题／投诉

ex.en: Have you dealt with these letters yet?
ex.cn: 这些信件你处理了吗？

ex.en: He's good at dealing with pressure.
ex.cn: 他善于应付压力。

senses.def: to be about sth

ex.en: Her poems often deal with the subject of death.
ex.cn: 她的诗经常涉及死亡这一主题。

ex.en: The book is about homeless people in the cities.
ex.cn: 这本书写的是城市中无家可归的人们。

ex.en: The report deals with the issue of homelessness in London.
ex.cn: 这篇报道是关于伦敦的无家可归问题。

ex.en: The writer discusses the problems faced by homeless people.
ex.cn: 作者讨论了无家可归者面临的种种问题。

ex.en: The article presents an overview of the issues surrounding homelessness.
ex.cn: 这篇文章概述了有关无家可归的种种问题。

ex.en: The novel explores the theme of friendship among homeless people.
ex.cn: 这部小说探究了无家可归者之间的友谊这个主题。

senses.def: much; a lot

ex.en: They spent a great deal of money.
ex.cn: 他们花了大量的钱。

ex.en: It took a great deal of time.
ex.cn: 这费了很多时间。

ex.en: I'm feeling a good deal better.
ex.cn: 我感觉好多了。

ex.en: We see them a great deal (= often).
ex.cn: 我们经常见到他们。

senses.def: an agreement, especially in business, on particular conditions for buying or doing sth

ex.en: to make/sign/conclude/close a deal (with sb)
ex.cn: （与某人）达成一笔交易

ex.en: Did you cut a deal (= make one)?
ex.cn: 你们交易做成了吗？

ex.en: We did a deal with the management on overtime.
ex.cn: 我们与资方在加班问题上达成了一项协议。

ex.en: They were hoping for a better pay deal.
ex.cn: 他们希望达成一项提高工资的协议。

ex.en: A deal was struck after lengthy negotiations.
ex.cn: 经过漫长的谈判终于达成了协议。

ex.en: The deal fell through (= no agreement was reached).
ex.cn: 交易没有谈成。

senses.def: the way that sb/sth is treated

ex.en: If elected, the party has promised a new deal (= better and fairer treatment) for teachers.
ex.cn: 该党承诺如果当选将给教师更好的待遇。

ex.en: They knew they'd been given a raw/rough deal (= been treated unfairly).
ex.cn: 他们知道自己受到了不公正待遇。

ex.en: We tried to ensure that everyone got a fair deal.
ex.cn: 我们尽力保证每个人都受到公平待遇。

ex.en: It was a square deal for everyone.
ex.cn: 这对任何人来说都是公平合理的。

senses.def: the action of giving out cards to the players

ex.en: It's your deal.
ex.cn: 该你发牌了。

senses.def: the soft pale wood of fir or pine trees, especially when it is cut into boards for making things

ex.en: a deal table
ex.cn: 松木桌子

senses.def: what is happening in the present situation?

ex.en: What's the deal? Do you want to go out or not?
ex.cn: 怎么啦？你想不想出去？

senses.def: used to say that you are not impressed by sth

ex.en: So he earns more than me. Big deal!
ex.cn: 他不就是比我多赚点钱，有什么了不起的！

senses.def: an agreement or a plan that has been finally completed or agreed
senses.chn: 达成的协议；决定了的计划

ex.en: The merger is by no means a done deal yet.
ex.cn: 合并之事远未成定局。

senses.def: to make an agreement with sb in which both sides have an advantage
senses.chn: 达成（对双方都有利的）协议

senses.def: something that causes sb to reject a deal in politics or business

ex.en: The candidate's support for the war is the deal-breaker (= people will not vote for the candidate because of it).
ex.cn: 候选人因为支持这场战争而失去了选民。

senses.def: a person whose business is buying and selling a particular product

ex.en: an art/antique dealer
ex.cn: 艺术品经销商；古董商

ex.en: He's a dealer in second-hand cars.
ex.cn: 他经销二手汽车。

senses.def: a person who sells illegal drugs
the person who gives out the cards in a card game
a business that buys and sells products, especially cars, for a particular company; the position of being a dealer who can buy and sell sth
senses.chn: 专项商品（尤指汽车）经销店；专项商品经销

ex.en: a Ford dealership
ex.cn: 福特汽车经销店

senses.def: business activities; the relations that you have with sb in business

ex.en: Have you had any previous dealings with this company?
ex.cn: 你曾与这家公司有过业务往来吗？

ex.en: I knew nothing of his business dealings.
ex.cn: 我对他生意上的事一概不知道。

ex.en: She has always been very polite in her dealings with me.
ex.cn: 她在与我交往的过程中总是彬彬有礼。

senses.def: a way of doing business with sb

ex.en: a reputation for fair/honest dealing
ex.cn: 公平交易／诚信经营的美名

senses.def: buying and selling

ex.en: drug dealing
ex.cn: 毒品交易

ex.en: dealings in shares
ex.cn: 股票交易

senses.def: to buy and sell a particular product

ex.en: The company deals in computer software.
ex.cn: 这个公司经营计算机软件。

senses.def: to accept sth as a basis for your decisions, attitudes or actions

ex.en: We don't deal in rumours or guesswork.
ex.cn: 我们不听信谣言，也不胡乱猜测。

senses.def: to include sb in an activity
senses.chn: 将某人算在里边；让某人参与

ex.en: That sounds great. Deal me in!
ex.cn: 这听起来太棒了。算我一个！

senses.def: used to tell sb that they cannot change a situation so they must accept it
senses.chn: （用以告诉某人无法改变现状）接受现实吧

ex.en: That's the way it is, so deal with it!
ex.cn: 就是这个样子，接受现实吧！

senses.def: to take appropriate action in a particular situation or according to who you are talking to, managing, etc.

ex.en: She is used to dealing with all kinds of people in her job.
ex.cn: 她已习惯于和工作中遇到的各种各样的人打交道。

senses.def: to solve a problem, perform a task, etc.

ex.en: to deal with enquiries/issues/complaints
ex.cn: 处理各种询问／问题／投诉

ex.en: Have you dealt with these letters yet?
ex.cn: 这些信件你处理了吗？

ex.en: He's good at dealing with pressure.
ex.cn: 他善于应付压力。

senses.def: to be about sth

ex.en: Her poems often deal with the subject of death.
ex.cn: 她的诗经常涉及死亡这一主题。

ex.en: The book is about homeless people in the cities.
ex.cn: 这本书写的是城市中无家可归的人们。

ex.en: The report deals with the issue of homelessness in London.
ex.cn: 这篇报道是关于伦敦的无家可归问题。

ex.en: The writer discusses the problems faced by homeless people.
ex.cn: 作者讨论了无家可归者面临的种种问题。

ex.en: The article presents an overview of the issues surrounding homelessness.
ex.cn: 这篇文章概述了有关无家可归的种种问题。

ex.en: The novel explores the theme of friendship among homeless people.
ex.cn: 这部小说探究了无家可归者之间的友谊这个主题。

senses.def: a priest of high rank who is in charge of the other priests in a cathedral
a priest who is in charge of the priests of several churches in an area
senses.chn: （乡间主管若干教堂牧师的）主任牧师

senses.def: a person in a university who is in charge of a department of studies
(in a college or university, especially at Oxford or Cambridge) a person who is responsible for the discipline of students
senses.chn: （大学，尤指牛津、剑桥大学的）学监

senses.def: a group of parishes controlled by a dean (2)
senses.chn: 总铎区；（统辖若干教区的）主任牧师管辖区

senses.def: the office or house of a dean (1) , dean (2)
senses.chn: 主任牧师办公室（或住所）

senses.def: (in the US) a list that is published every year of the best students in a college or university
senses.chn: （美国大学的）年度优秀学生名单

senses.def: loved by or important to sb

ex.en: He's one of my dearest friends.
ex.cn: 他是我最亲密的朋友之一。

ex.en: Her daughter is very dear to her.
ex.cn: 她的女儿是她心爱的宝贝。

senses.def: used at the beginning of a letter before the name or title of the person that you are writing to
senses.chn: （用于信函抬头的名字或头衔前）亲爱的

ex.en: Dear Sir or Madam
ex.cn: 亲爱的先生／女士

ex.en: Dear Mrs Jones
ex.cn: 亲爱的琼斯太太

senses.def: expensive; costing a lot of money

ex.en: Everything's so dear now, isn't it?
ex.cn: 现在什么东西都那么贵，是不是？

senses.def: used to describe sb in a way that shows affection

ex.en: Dear old Sue! I knew she'd help.
ex.cn: 亲爱的休啊！我知道她会帮忙的。

ex.en: Their baby's a dear little thing.
ex.cn: 他们的宝宝真是个小乖乖。

senses.def: to care very much for sb/sth; to value sb/sth highly
senses.chn: 非常关心；十分看重；极为珍视

ex.en: He had destroyed everything we held dear.
ex.cn: 他把我们珍视的一切都给毁了。

senses.def: having a lot of importance and interest for sb
senses.chn: 为某人所重视关心；为某人所爱

senses.def: as hard or as fast as possible

ex.en: She was holding on to the rope for dear life.
ex.cn: 她死命抓着那根绳子。

ex.en: Run for your life!
ex.cn: 快跑啊！

senses.def: your close family and friends
senses.chn: 至亲；至爱；最亲密的亲友

senses.def: used in expressions that show that you are surprised, upset, annoyed or worried
senses.chn: （惊奇、不安、烦恼、担忧等时说）啊，哎呀，糟糕，天哪

ex.en: Oh dear! I think I've lost my purse!
ex.cn: 糟糕，我可能把钱包给丢了！

ex.en: Oh dear! What a shame.
ex.cn: 天哪，太可惜啦！

ex.en: Dear me! What a mess!
ex.cn: 哎呀，真是一团糟！

ex.en: Dear oh dear! What are you going to do now?
ex.cn: 哎呀呀，你现在怎么办呢？

senses.def: a kind person

ex.en: Isn't he a dear?
ex.cn: 他不是很可爱吗？

ex.en: Be a dear and fetch me my coat.
ex.cn: 劳驾把外套给我拿来。

senses.def: used when speaking to sb you love

ex.en: Would you like a drink, dear?
ex.cn: 喝点什么吗，亲爱的？

ex.en: Come here, my dear.
ex.cn: 上这儿来，亲爱的。

senses.def: used when speaking to sb in a friendly way, for example by an older person to a young person or a child
senses.chn: （对较年轻的人或孩子说话时用）亲爱的，乖乖

ex.en: What's your name, dear?
ex.cn: 你叫什么名字，亲爱的？

senses.def: at a high price

ex.en: to buy cheap and sell dear
ex.cn: 贱买贵卖

ex.en: That one mistake has cost him dear over the years.
ex.cn: 那一个差错使他多年来付出了沉重的代价。

senses.def: used when writing to sb you love
senses.chn: （给所爱的人写信时用）最亲爱的

ex.en: 'Dearest Nina', the letter began.
ex.cn: “最亲爱的尼娜”，信的开端这样写道。

senses.def: that you feel deeply

ex.en: It was her dearest wish to have a family.
ex.cn: 有一个家是她由衷的希望。

senses.def: used when speaking to sb you love

ex.en: Come (my) dearest, let's go home.
ex.cn: 好啦，亲爱的，咱们回家吧。

senses.def: used to address sb in a friendly way
senses.chn: （表示友好的称呼）亲爱的，乖乖

ex.en: Sit down, dearie.
ex.cn: 坐下，亲爱的。

senses.def: very much

ex.en: She loves him dearly.
ex.cn: 她深深地爱着他。

ex.en: I would dearly like/love to know what he was thinking.
ex.cn: 我很想知道他在想什么。

ex.en: dearly beloved (= used by a minister at a Christian church service to address people)
ex.cn: 最亲爱的教友们（神职人员对参礼信众的称呼）

senses.def: in a way that causes a lot of suffering or damage, or that costs a lot of money
senses.chn: 代价极大地；高价地；昂贵地

ex.en: Success has cost him dearly.
ex.cn: 他为成功付出了高昂的代价。

ex.en: She paid dearly for her mistake.
ex.cn: 她因犯错误而付出了巨大的代价。

senses.def: a lack of sth; the fact of there not being enough of sth

ex.en: There was a dearth of reliable information on the subject.
ex.cn: 关于这个课题缺乏可靠资料。

senses.def: the fact of sb dying or being killed

ex.en: a sudden/violent/peaceful, etc. death
ex.cn: 猝死、横死、安详的死等

ex.en: the anniversary of his wife's death
ex.cn: 他妻子的忌日

ex.en: an increase in deaths from cancer
ex.cn: 癌症死亡人数的增加

ex.en: He died a slow and painful death.
ex.cn: 他缓慢而痛苦地死去。

senses.def: the end of life; the state of being dead

ex.en: Two children were burnt to death in the fire (= they died as a result of the fire).
ex.cn: 两个孩子被大火烧死。

ex.en: He's drinking himself to death (= so that it will kill him).
ex.cn: 他这样喝酒非醉死不可。

ex.en: Police are trying to establish the cause of death.
ex.cn: 警方在设法确定死因。

ex.en: Do you believe in life after death?
ex.cn: 你相信来世吗？

ex.en: a death camp (= a place where prisoners are killed, usually in a war)
ex.cn: 死亡集中营（常指战争中杀害俘虏的地方）

ex.en: He was sentenced to death (= to be executed).
ex.cn: 他被判处死刑。

senses.def: the permanent end or destruction of sth

ex.en: the death of all my plans
ex.cn: 我所有计划的破灭

ex.en: the death of fascism
ex.cn: 法西斯主义的灭亡

senses.def: the power that destroys life, imagined as human in form

ex.en: Death is often shown in paintings as a human skeleton.
ex.cn: 死神在绘画作品中常以骷髅形式出现。

senses.def: so ill/sick that you may die
to worry or upset sb very much
senses.chn: 让某人担心得要命；使某人深感不安

ex.en: Those kids will be the death of me.
ex.cn: 为那些孩子操心会把我累死。

senses.def: to do or perform sth so often that people become tired of seeing or hearing it

ex.en: That joke's been done to death.
ex.cn: 那个笑话都听腻了。

senses.def: to frighten sb very much
to look or feel very ill/sick or tired
senses.chn: 看起来病得厉害（或疲惫不堪）；感到很不舒服（或累得要命）

senses.def: to kill sb as a punishment

ex.en: The prisoner will be put to death at dawn.
ex.cn: 囚犯将在黎明时被处死。

senses.def: extremely; very much

ex.en: to be bored to death
ex.cn: 腻烦得要命

ex.en: I'm sick to death of your endless criticism.
ex.cn: 你这无休止的指责真让我烦死了。

senses.def: until sb is dead

ex.en: a fight to the death
ex.cn: 战斗到底

senses.def: to catch a very bad cold
to survive in a situation where you could have died
to risk your life by doing sth that you know is dangerous
to fail completely

ex.en: The play got terrible reviews and quickly died a death.
ex.cn: 这出戏被批得一无是处，很快就收场了。

senses.def: a terrible thing that could happen
to be unwilling to accept sth or do sth, and to try to avoid it
senses.chn: 不愿接受（或做）某事；回避；躲避

ex.en: Successive governments have fought shy of such measures.
ex.cn: 一届接一届政府均不愿采取这些措施。

senses.def: to use an idea, a story, etc. so often that it is no longer interesting
senses.chn: 多次重复（想法、故事等）而使人失去兴趣

senses.def: to hold sb/sth very tightly because you are afraid
senses.chn: （害怕得）死死抓住不放，紧紧抓住不松手

senses.def: an event that seems good, but is certain to make sth else fail
senses.chn: 貌似有利却肯定会在别处导致失利的事物；表面有利实则有害的事物

senses.def: the possibility or belief that people continue to exist in some form after they die
used to describe a situation that is very important or serious
senses.chn: 生死攸关的事；成败的关键

senses.def: the bed in which sb is dying or dies

ex.en: a deathbed confession/conversion
ex.cn: 临终告解／皈依

ex.en: He told me the truth on his deathbed (= as he lay dying).
ex.cn: 他临终时向我吐露了实情。

ex.en: She was on her deathbed (= going to die very soon).
ex.cn: 她已生命垂危。

ex.en: You'd have to be practically on your deathbed before the doctor would come and see you!
ex.cn: 你非病到就要一命呜呼的时候医生才会来看你！

senses.def: an event that destroys or puts an end to sth
senses.chn: 导致毁灭的事情；致命的一击

ex.en: They thought the arrival of television would deal a death blow to mass cinema audiences.
ex.cn: 他们认为电视的问世将使观众涌向影院的现象不复存在。

senses.def: an official document, signed by a doctor, that states the cause and time of sb's death
an event that means that the end or destruction of sth will come soon
senses.chn: 丧钟；死亡的征兆；预示毁灭的事件

senses.def: never dying or forgotten

ex.en: written in his usual deathless prose (= very bad)
ex.cn: 用他那万世不变的笔调写成

senses.def: like a dead person; suggesting death
senses.chn: 死一般地；让人想到死亡

ex.en: Her face was deathly pale.
ex.cn: 她的脸色死一般苍白。

ex.en: The house was deathly still.
ex.cn: 房子死寂。

senses.def: a model of the face of a person who has just died, made by pressing a soft substance over their face and removing it when it becomes hard
senses.chn: （用柔软物质压在死人脸上，变硬后取出制成的）死人面部模型

senses.def: the number of deaths every year for every 1 000 people in the population of a place
senses.chn: 死亡率（某地每年每 1 000 人的死亡人数）

ex.en: a high/low death rate
ex.cn: 高／低死亡率

senses.def: the number of deaths every year from a particular disease or in a particular group
senses.chn: （某种疾病或某个群体的）死亡率

ex.en: Death rates from heart disease have risen considerably in recent years.
ex.cn: 近年来心脏病的死亡率大大上升了。

senses.def: a sound sometimes heard in the throat of a dying person
the cells in a prison for prisoners who are waiting to be killed as punishment for a serious crime

ex.en: prisoners on death row
ex.cn: 死囚区的犯人

senses.def: the legal punishment of being killed for a serious crime

ex.en: to be given/to receive the death sentence for murder
ex.cn: 因谋杀罪被判死刑

senses.def: a human skull (= the bone structure of the head) used as a symbol of death
a group of people who are ordered by a government to kill other people, especially the government's political opponents
senses.chn: （受命于政府谋杀政敌等的）处决小队，暗杀小组

senses.def: the final stages of sth just before it comes to an end

ex.en: The regime is now in its death throes.
ex.cn: 这一政权大势已去。

senses.def: violent pains and movements at the moment of death
senses.chn: 临终的剧痛；死前的挣扎

senses.def: the number of people killed in an accident, a war, a disaster, etc.
senses.chn: （事故、战争、灾难等的）死亡人数

senses.def: a building, vehicle, etc. that is dangerous and could cause sb's death
senses.chn: 死亡陷阱（潜藏祸患的建筑物、车辆等）

ex.en: The cars blocking the exits could turn this place into a deathtrap.
ex.cn: 堵住出口的汽车可能使这地方成为死亡陷阱。

senses.def: an official document stating that sb should receive the punishment of being killed for a crime that they have committed

ex.en: The President signed the death warrant.
ex.cn: 总统签署了死刑执行令。

ex.en: If you pay the ransom, you may be signing your son's death warrant.
ex.cn: 如果你付赎金，可能就要了你儿子的命。

ex.en: By withdrawing the funding, the government signed the project's death warrant.
ex.cn: 政府撤回资金，也就是对这项工程判了死刑。

senses.def: a small insect that eats into old wood, making sounds like a watch ticking
senses.chn: 红毛窃蠹（专蛀旧木，发出类似表的嘀嗒声的小甲虫）

senses.def: a desire to die, often that sb is not aware of
an event or a situation that is a complete failure and causes embarrassment
to officially prevent sb from doing sth, joining sth, etc.
senses.chn: 阻止，禁止（某人做某事、加入某团体等）

ex.en: He was debarred from holding public office.
ex.cn: 他被禁止担任公职。

senses.def: to make sb/sth less valuable or respected
senses.chn: 降低…的价值；败坏…的名誉

ex.en: Sport is being debased by commercial sponsorship.
ex.cn: 体育运动因受商业赞助而降低了声誉。

senses.def: not certain because people can have different ideas and opinions about the thing being discussed

ex.en: a debatable point
ex.cn: 有争议的观点

ex.en: It is highly debatable whether conditions have improved for low-income families.
ex.cn: 低收入家庭的生活状况是否已得到改善是一个颇有争议的问题。

senses.def: a formal discussion of an issue at a public meeting or in a parliament. In a debate two or more speakers express opposing views and then there is often a vote on the issue.
senses.chn: （在公共集会上或议会里就某问题进行的、常以表决结束的）辩论

ex.en: a debate on abortion
ex.cn: 关于堕胎的辩论

ex.en: The minister opened the debate (= was the first to speak).
ex.cn: 部长在辩论时率先发言。

ex.en: The motion under debate (= being discussed) was put to a vote.
ex.cn: 辩论中的动议已付诸表决。

ex.en: After a long debate, Congress approved the proposal.
ex.cn: 经过长时间辩论，国会通过了这项提议。

ex.en: Discussions are still taking place between the two leaders.
ex.cn: 两位领导人仍在进行讨论。

ex.en: a telephone conversation
ex.cn: 电话交谈

senses.def: an argument or a discussion expressing different opinions
senses.chn: （各自发表不同意见的）争论，辩论，讨论

ex.en: a heated/wide-ranging/lively debate
ex.cn: 激烈的／广泛的／热烈的争论

ex.en: the current debate about tax
ex.cn: 目前关于税收的讨论

ex.en: There had been much debate on the issue of childcare.
ex.cn: 人们对儿童照管问题议论纷纷。

ex.en: Whether he deserves what has happened to him is open to debate/a matter for debate (= cannot be certain or decided yet).
ex.cn: 他是否罪有应得还有待于讨论。

ex.en: The theatre's future is a subject of considerable debate.
ex.cn: 剧院的前途是一个颇有争议的问题。

senses.def: to discuss sth, especially formally, before making a decision or finding a solution

ex.en: Politicians will be debating the bill later this week.
ex.cn: 政界将在本周晚些时候讨论这个议案。

ex.en: The question of the origin of the universe is still hotly debated (= strongly argued about) by scientists.
ex.cn: 关于宇宙起源问题，科学家仍在激烈辩论。

ex.en: The committee will debate whether to lower the age of club membership to 16.
ex.cn: 委员会将讨论是否将参加俱乐部的年龄限制放宽到 16 岁。

ex.en: We talked on the phone for over an hour.
ex.cn: 我们在电话里谈了一个多小时。

ex.en: Have you discussed the problem with anyone?
ex.cn: 你与谁商量过这个问题吗？

ex.en: I've spoken to the manager about it.
ex.cn: 那件事我已经和经理谈过了。

senses.def: to think carefully about sth before making a decision

ex.en: She debated with herself for a while, and then picked up the phone.
ex.cn: 她仔细琢磨了一会儿，然后拿起了电话。

ex.en: We're debating whether or not to go skiing this winter.
ex.cn: 我们盘算着今年冬天是否去滑雪。

ex.en: For a moment he debated going after her.
ex.cn: 他仔细思考了片刻要不要去追求她。

senses.def: a person who is involved in a debate
a debauched person is immoral in their sexual behaviour, drinks a lot of alcohol, takes drugs, etc.
senses.chn: 道德败坏的；淫荡的；沉湎酒色的；嗜毒的

senses.def: immoral behaviour involving sex, alcohol or drugs
senses.chn: 道德败坏；淫荡；沉湎酒色（或毒品）

senses.def: an official document that is given by a company, showing it has borrowed money from a person and stating the interest payments that it will make to them
to make sb's body or mind weaker
senses.chn: 使身心衰弱；使衰竭；使虚弱

ex.en: a debilitating disease
ex.cn: 使人虚弱的疾病

senses.def: to make a country, an organization, etc. weaker
senses.chn: 削弱（国家、机构等）的力量；使软弱无力

ex.en: Prolonged strike action debilitated the industry.
ex.cn: 长时间的罢工削弱了这个行业的活力。

senses.def: physical weakness, especially as a result of illness
senses.chn: （尤指疾病引起的）体弱，虚弱，衰弱

senses.def: a written note in a bank account or other financial record of a sum of money owed or spent

ex.en: on the debit side of an account
ex.cn: 账户的借方

ex.en: On the debit side (= a negative result will be that) the new shopping centre will increase traffic problems.
