ex.en: A government spokesperson made a statement to the press.
ex.cn: 政府发言人向新闻界发表了一份声明。

ex.en: She made helpful comments on my work.
ex.cn: 她对我的工作提出了有益的意见。

ex.en: the announcement of a peace agreement
ex.cn: 和平协议公告

ex.en: He made a number of rude remarks about the food.
ex.cn: 他对这食物作了许多无礼的评论。

ex.en: the declaration of war
ex.cn: 宣战

senses.def: an official written statement giving information

ex.en: a declaration of income
ex.cn: 收益申报表

ex.en: customs declarations (= giving details of goods that have been brought into a country)
ex.cn: 报关单（带入境内物品的详细清单）

senses.def: in the form of a simple statement
to say sth officially or publicly

ex.en: The government has declared a state of emergency.
ex.cn: 政府已宣布进入紧急状态。

ex.en: Germany declared war on France on 1 August 1914.
ex.cn: 德国在 1914 年 8 月 1 日向法国宣战。

ex.en: The government has declared war on (= officially stated its intention to stop) illiteracy.
ex.cn: 政府已宣布要扫除文盲。

ex.en: The court declared that strike action was illegal.
ex.cn: 法庭宣判罢工为非法。

ex.en: The area has been declared a national park.
ex.cn: 这地区已宣布为国家公园。

ex.en: The painting was declared to be a forgery.
ex.cn: 这幅画被判定为赝品。

senses.def: to state sth firmly and clearly

ex.en: 'I'll do it!' Tom declared.
ex.cn: “让我来！” 汤姆果断地说。

ex.en: He declared that he was in love with her.
ex.cn: 他声称他已爱上她。

ex.en: Few people dared to declare their opposition to the regime.
ex.cn: 很少有人敢宣称他们反对这个政权。

ex.en: She declared herself extremely hurt by his lack of support.
ex.cn: 她说自己非常伤心，因为没有得到他的支持。

ex.en: to declare war
ex.cn: 宣战

ex.en: The painting was declared to be a forgery.
ex.cn: 这幅画被判定为赝品。

senses.def: to tell the tax authorities how much money you have earned

ex.en: All income must be declared.
ex.cn: 所有收益必须申报。

senses.def: to tell customs officers (= at the border of a country) that you are carrying goods on which you should pay tax

ex.en: Do you have anything to declare?
ex.cn: 你有什么要申报的吗？

senses.def: to decide to end your innings (= the period during which your team is batting) before all your players have batted
senses.chn: （在击球员还未全部出局时）宣布结束赛局，宣布停止击球

senses.def: to say publicly that you do not support sb/sth
to say publicly that you support sb/sth
stated in an open way so that people know about it
senses.chn: 公开宣布（或声明、表态）的

ex.en: the government's declared intention to reduce crime
ex.cn: 政府公开宣布的减少犯罪的计划

senses.def: to state officially that secret government information is no longer secret

ex.en: declassified information/documents
ex.cn: 已解密的情报／文件

senses.def: a set of nouns, adjectives or pronouns that change in the same way to show case, number and gender
senses.chn: （名词、形容词或代词显示性、数、格的）变格

senses.def: the way in which some sets of nouns, adjectives and pronouns change their form or endings to show case, number or gender
senses.chn: （名词、形容词和代词显示性、数、格的）词形变化

senses.def: a continuous decrease in the number, value, quality, etc. of sth
senses.chn: （数量、价值、质量等的）减少，下降，衰落，衰退

ex.en: a rapid/sharp/gradual decline
ex.cn: 迅速／急剧／逐渐下降

ex.en: urban/economic decline
ex.cn: 城市衰落；经济衰退

ex.en: The company reported a small decline in its profits.
ex.cn: 公司报告其利润略有减少。

ex.en: An increase in cars has resulted in the decline of public transport.
ex.cn: 小汽车的增加导致了公共交通的减少。

ex.en: The town fell into (a) decline (= started to be less busy, important, etc.) after the mine closed.
ex.cn: 这个镇在矿井关闭后开始衰落。

ex.en: Industry in Britain has been in decline since the 1970s.
ex.cn: 英国工业自 20 世纪 70 年代以来一直在走下坡路。

senses.def: to become smaller, fewer, weaker, etc.

ex.en: Support for the party continues to decline.
ex.cn: 对该党的支持继续下降。

ex.en: The number of tourists to the resort declined by 10% last year.
ex.cn: 去年到这个胜地旅游的人数减少了 10%。

ex.en: Her health was declining rapidly.
ex.cn: 她的健康状况迅速恶化。

senses.def: to refuse politely to accept or to do sth

ex.en: I offered to give them a lift but they declined.
ex.cn: 我主动提议开车送他们，但他们婉言谢绝了。

ex.en: to decline an offer/invitation
ex.cn: 谢绝对方的主动帮助／邀请

ex.en: Their spokesman declined to comment on the allegations.
ex.cn: 他们的发言人拒绝对这些指控加以评论。

senses.def: if a noun, an adjective or a pronoun declines, it has different forms according to whether it is the subject or the object of a verb, whether it is in the singular or plural, etc. When you decline a noun, etc., you list these forms.
senses.chn: （根据名词、形容词或代词在句中的作用）变格，使发生词形变化

senses.def: the last years of sb's life
to remove things that you do not use so that you have more space and can easily find things when you need them

ex.en: Moving is a good opportunity to declutter.
ex.cn: 搬家是清理无用杂物的好时机。

ex.en: a 7-step plan to help you declutter your home
ex.cn: 帮你把家清理干净的 7 步骤计划

senses.def: to find the meaning of sth, especially sth that has been written in code
to receive an electronic signal and change it into pictures that can be shown on a television screen

ex.en: decoding equipment
ex.cn: 电子信号译码设备

senses.def: to understand the meaning of sth in a foreign language
a device that changes an electronic signal into a form that people can understand, such as sound and pictures

ex.en: a satellite/video decoder
ex.cn: 卫星／视频解码器

senses.def: the process of a colony or colonies becoming independent
senses.chn: 非殖民（地）化；殖民地独立

senses.def: to officially stop using weapons, a nuclear power station, etc.
senses.chn: 正式停止使用（武器、核电站等）

senses.def: to be destroyed gradually by natural chemical processes

ex.en: a decomposing corpse
ex.cn: 正在腐烂的尸体

ex.en: As the waste materials decompose, they produce methane gas.
ex.cn: 废物腐烂时会产生沼气。

ex.en: a decomposed body
ex.cn: 已经腐烂了的尸体

senses.def: to divide sth into smaller parts; to divide into smaller parts
to have the air pressure in sth reduced to a normal level or to reduce it to its normal level
to return files, etc. to their original size after they have been compressed
senses.chn: 解压缩（将压缩文件等恢复到原大小）

senses.def: a reduction in air pressure; the act of reducing the pressure of the air

ex.en: a decompression chamber (= a piece of equipment that divers sit in so that they can return slowly to normal air pressure after being deep in the sea)
ex.cn: 减压舱（潜水员深海作业后坐在其中恢复到正常气压）

ex.en: decompression sickness (= severe pain and difficulty in breathing experienced by divers who come back to the surface of deep water too quickly)
ex.cn: 减压病（潜水员从深水迅速回到水面后感到的剧痛和呼吸困难）

senses.def: the act or process of allowing sth that has been compressed (= made smaller) to fill the space that it originally took up
senses.chn: 解压缩（将压缩的东西恢复到原状）

senses.def: a device for reducing pressure in a vehicle's engine
senses.chn: （机动车发动机的）减压装置，减压器

senses.def: a computer program which returns files, etc. to their original size after they have been compressed
a medicine that helps sb with a cold to breathe more easily

ex.en: a nasal decongestant
ex.cn: 鼻塞通药

senses.def: to stop using sth, especially a building, for a religious purpose
senses.chn: 停止把（建筑物等）用于宗教目的；把…改作俗用

ex.en: a deconsecrated church
ex.cn: 改作俗用的教堂

senses.def: to analyse a text in order to show that there is no fixed meaning within the text but that the meaning is created each time in the act of reading
senses.chn: 解构（文本没有固定意义，只有在阅读中才获得意义）

senses.def: to separate sth into the parts from which it is made up and put them together again in a different way

ex.en: Picasso deconstructed his subjects into cubes and colours.
ex.cn: 毕加索将他的表现对象拆解重组为一个个小方块和不同的颜色。

ex.en: deconstructed lasagne
ex.cn: 散煮宽面

senses.def: a theory that states that it is impossible for a text to have one fixed meaning, and emphasizes the role of the reader in the production of meaning
senses.chn: 解构理论（文本不可能只有一个固定含义，强调读者在意义发生过程中的作用）

senses.def: to remove harmful substances from a place or thing
senses.chn: 清除有害物质；排除…的污染

ex.en: the process of decontaminating areas exposed to radioactivity
ex.cn: 清除受放射污染地区有害物质的过程

senses.def: if a government decontrols sth, it removes legal controls from it
senses.chn: 解除对…的控制；撤销对…的管制

senses.def: the style in which the inside of a building is decorated
senses.chn: （建筑内部的）装饰布局，装饰风格

ex.en: interior decor
ex.cn: 室内装饰风格

ex.en: the restaurant's elegant new decor
ex.cn: 餐馆内部雅致的新装潢

senses.def: to make sth look more attractive by putting things on it

ex.en: They decorated the room with flowers and balloons.
ex.cn: 他们用花和气球装饰了房间。

ex.en: The cake was decorated to look like a car.
ex.cn: 这蛋糕装饰得像一辆汽车。

senses.def: to put paint, wallpaper, etc. on the walls and ceilings of a room or house

ex.en: I hate decorating.
ex.cn: 我讨厌粉刷墙壁。

ex.en: He has his own painting and decorating business.
ex.cn: 他经营自己的油漆和粉刷墙壁生意。

ex.en: We need to decorate the sitting room.
ex.cn: 我们需要将客厅粉刷一下。

ex.en: The sitting room needs decorating.
ex.cn: 客厅需要粉刷。

senses.def: to be placed on sth in order to make it look more attractive

ex.en: Photographs of actors decorated the walls of the restaurant.
ex.cn: 演员的照片装点着餐馆的墙壁。

senses.def: to give sb a medal as a sign of respect for sth they have done
a thing that makes sth look more attractive on special occasions

ex.en: Christmas decorations
ex.cn: 圣诞节装饰品

ex.en: a table decoration
ex.cn: 餐桌装饰物

senses.def: a pattern, etc. that is added to sth and that stops it from being plain

ex.en: the elaborate decoration on the carved wooden door
ex.cn: 木雕门上精美的装饰图案

senses.def: the style in which sth is decorated

ex.en: a Chinese theme in the interior decoration
ex.cn: 室内装饰的中国主题

senses.def: the act or process of decorating sth such as the inside of a house by painting it, etc.
a medal that is given to sb as an honour
decorated in a way that makes it attractive; intended to look attractive or pretty

ex.en: The mirror is functional yet decorative.
ex.cn: 这镜子能照人，但也有装饰作用。

ex.en: purely decorative arches
ex.cn: 纯属装饰性的拱门

senses.def: artistic activities which produce objects which are useful and beautiful at the same time
a person whose job is painting and decorating houses
polite and appropriate in a particular social situation; not shocking
senses.chn: 礼貌得体的；端庄稳重的

ex.en: a decorous kiss
ex.cn: 礼貌得体的一吻

senses.def: polite behaviour that is appropriate in a social situation
to end the connection or relationship between two things
an animal or a bird, or a model of one, that attracts other animals or birds, especially so that they can be shot by people who are hunting them
a thing or a person that is used to trick sb into doing what you want them to do, going where you want them to go, etc.
senses.chn: 诱饵；诱惑物；用作诱饵的人

senses.def: to become or make sth become smaller in size, number, etc.
senses.chn: （使大小、数量等）减少，减小，降低

ex.en: The number of new students decreased from 210 to 160 this year.
ex.cn: 今年新生人数从 210 减少到 160。

ex.en: a decreasing population
ex.cn: 逐渐减少的人口

ex.en: The price of wheat has decreased by 5%.
ex.cn: 小麦价格降低了 5%。

ex.en: This species of bird is decreasing in numbers every year.
ex.cn: 这种鸟的数量在逐年减少。

ex.en: People should decrease the amount of fat they eat.
ex.cn: 人们应减少脂肪的摄入量。

senses.def: the process of reducing sth or the amount that sth is reduced by

ex.en: There has been some decrease in military spending this year.
ex.cn: 今年的军费开支有所减少。

ex.en: a decrease of nearly 6% in the number of visitors to the museum
ex.cn: 参观博物馆人数下降将近 6%

senses.def: an official order from a ruler or a government that becomes the law

ex.en: to issue/sign a decree
ex.cn: 颁布／签署法令

ex.en: a leader who rules by decree (= not in a democratic way)
ex.cn: 专制统治者

senses.def: a decision that is made in court
to decide, judge or order sth officially

ex.en: The government decreed a state of emergency.
ex.cn: 政府下令进入紧急状态。

ex.en: We cannot decree what the committee should do.
ex.cn: 我们不能决定委员会应该做什么。

ex.en: It was decreed that the following day would be a holiday.
ex.cn: 法令宣布第二天为休假日。

senses.def: an order from a court that finally ends a marriage, making the two people divorced
senses.chn: （法院对离婚诉讼的）绝对判决，最终判决

ex.en: The period between the decree nisi and the decree absolute was six weeks.
ex.cn: 离婚初期判决和最终判决之间的期限当时为六个星期。

senses.def: an order from a court that a marriage will end after a fixed amount of time unless there is a good reason why it should not
senses.chn: （法院对离婚诉讼的）非绝对判决，初期判决

senses.def: very old and not in good condition or health
the state of being old and in poor condition or health
to change the law so that sth is no longer illegal

ex.en: There are moves to decriminalize some soft drugs.
ex.cn: 已采取步骤使某些软毒品合法化。

senses.def: to strongly criticize sb/sth, especially publicly

ex.en: The measures were decried as useless.
ex.cn: 这些措施受到指责，说是不起作用。

senses.def: to change information that is in code into ordinary language so that it can be understood by anyone
to give a lot of your time and effort to a particular activity or purpose because you think it is important

ex.en: She dedicates herself to her work.
ex.cn: 她献身于自己的工作。

ex.en: He dedicated his life to helping the poor.
ex.cn: 他毕生致力于帮助穷人。

senses.def: to say at the beginning of a book, a piece of music or a performance that you are doing it for sb, as a way of thanking them or showing respect
senses.chn: （在书、音乐或演出的前部）题献词

ex.en: This book is dedicated to my parents.
ex.cn: 谨以此书献给我的父母。

senses.def: to hold an official ceremony to say that a building or an object has a special purpose or is special to the memory of a particular person
senses.chn: 为…举行奉献典礼；为（建筑物等）举行落成典礼

ex.en: The chapel was dedicated in 1880.
ex.cn: 这座小教堂于 1880 年举行献堂典礼。

ex.en: A memorial stone was dedicated to those who were killed in the war.
ex.cn: 为阵亡将士纪念碑举行了落成典礼。

senses.def: working hard at sth because it is very important to you
senses.chn: 献身的；专心致志的；一心一意的

ex.en: a dedicated teacher
ex.cn: 富有献身精神的教师

ex.en: She is dedicated to her job.
ex.cn: 她对工作专心致志。

senses.def: designed to do only one particular type of work; used for one particular purpose only

ex.en: Software is exported through a dedicated satellite link.
ex.cn: 软件通过专用卫星链路出口。

senses.def: the hard work and effort that sb puts into an activity or a purpose because they think it is important

ex.en: hard work and dedication
ex.cn: 勤奋和奉献

senses.def: a ceremony that is held to show that a building or an object has a special purpose or is special to the memory of a particular person
the words that are used at the beginning of a book, piece of music, a performance, etc. to offer it to sb as a sign of thanks or respect
senses.chn: 题献（作者在书、音乐作品、演出等开始前表示将其献给某人的一段话）

senses.def: to form an opinion about sth based on the information or evidence that is available

ex.en: We can deduce a lot from what people choose to buy.
ex.cn: 从人们选购的东西可以作出多方面的推断。

ex.en: Can we deduce from your silence that you do not approve?
ex.cn: 你保持沉默，我们是否可以据此而推断出你不赞成？

senses.def: to take away money, points, etc. from a total amount

ex.en: Ten points will be deducted for a wrong answer.
ex.cn: 答错一题扣十分。

ex.en: The cost of your uniform will be deducted from your wages.
ex.cn: 制服费将从你的工资中扣除。

senses.def: that can be taken away from an amount of money you earn, from tax, etc.

ex.en: These costs are deductible from profits.
ex.cn: 这些费用可从利润中扣除。

ex.en: tax-deductible expenses (= that you do not have to pay tax on)
ex.cn: 可减免税款的开支

senses.def: the part of an insurance claim that a person has to pay while the insurance company pays the rest

ex.en: a policy with a very high deductible
ex.cn: 免赔额极高的保单

senses.def: the process of using information you have in order to understand a particular situation or to find the answer to a problem

ex.en: He arrived at the solution by a simple process of deduction.
ex.cn: 他通过一番简单的推理得出了解决问题的方法。

ex.en: If my deductions are correct, I can tell you who the killer was.
ex.cn: 如果我的推论正确的话，我可以告诉你谁是凶手。

senses.def: the process of taking an amount of sth, especially money, away from a total; the amount that is taken away

ex.en: deductions from your pay for tax, etc.
ex.cn: 从工资中扣除税金等的数额

ex.en: tax deductions
ex.cn: 减税额

senses.def: using knowledge about things that are generally true in order to think about and understand particular situations or problems

ex.en: deductive logic/reasoning
ex.cn: 演绎逻辑／推理

senses.def: a thing that sb does that is usually very good or very bad

ex.en: a(n) brave/charitable/evil/good deed
ex.cn: 勇敢的行为；善举；恶行；善行

ex.en: a tale of heroic deeds
ex.cn: 英雄事迹的故事

senses.def: a legal document that you sign, especially one that proves that you own a house or a building

ex.en: the deeds of the house
ex.cn: 房契

senses.def: a helpful, kind thing that you do
an agreement to pay a regular amount of money to sb/sth, especially a charity, that means that they also receive the tax that would have to be paid on this money
senses.chn: 付款契据（承诺定期捐款的契约，受款人可兼获为此款所应缴的税额）

ex.en: Signing a deed of covenant makes £1 worth £1.20.
ex.cn: 签署一张付款契据就使 1 英镑价值变为 1.20 英镑。

senses.def: a legal document signed by only one person, especially in order to change their name
senses.chn: 单务契约，单边契据（由一方签立，尤为更改姓名）

ex.en: Smith changed his name by deed poll to Jervis-Smith.
ex.cn: 史密斯通过单边契据将自己的名字更改为杰维斯–史密斯。

senses.def: to perform as a disc jockey, especially in a club
senses.chn: （尤指在俱乐部）当唱片节目主持人

senses.def: to have a particular opinion about sth

ex.en: The evening was deemed a great success.
ex.cn: 大家认为这次晚会非常成功。

ex.en: She deemed it prudent not to say anything.
ex.cn: 她认为什么都不说是明智的。

ex.en: They would take any action deemed necessary.
ex.cn: 他们会采取认为必要的任何行动。

senses.def: having a large distance from the top or surface to the bottom

ex.en: a deep hole/well/river
ex.cn: 很深的洞／井／河

ex.en: deep water/snow
ex.cn: 深水；厚雪

senses.def: having a large distance from the front edge to the furthest point inside

ex.en: a deep cut/wound
ex.cn: 很深的划口／伤口

ex.en: a deep space
ex.cn: 深邃的空间

senses.def: used to describe or ask about the depth of sth

ex.en: The water is only a few inches deep.
ex.cn: 这水只有几英寸深。

ex.en: How deep is the wound?
ex.cn: 伤口有多深？

senses.def: as far up or down as the point mentioned

ex.en: The water was only waist-deep so I walked ashore.
ex.cn: 水只有齐腰深，所以我涉水上了岸。

senses.def: in the number of rows mentioned, one behind the other

ex.en: They were standing three-deep at the bar.
ex.cn: 他们在吧台前站成三排。

senses.def: taking in or giving out a lot of air

ex.en: She took a deep breath.
ex.cn: 她深深地吸了一口气。

ex.en: He gave a deep sigh.
ex.cn: 他深深地叹了一口气。

senses.def: low

ex.en: I heard his deep warm voice filling the room.
ex.cn: 我听到他低沉暖人的话语在整个房间里回荡。

ex.en: a deep roar/groan
ex.cn: 低沉的轰鸣声／呻吟声

senses.def: strong and dark

ex.en: a rich deep red
ex.cn: 浓重的深红色

senses.def: a person in a deep sleep is difficult to wake

ex.en: to be in a deep sleep/trance/coma
ex.cn: 酣睡；昏睡；昏迷

senses.def: extreme or serious

ex.en: He's in deep trouble.
ex.cn: 他陷入极度困境之中。

ex.en: a deep economic recession
ex.cn: 严重的经济衰退

ex.en: The affair had exposed deep divisions within the party.
ex.cn: 这件事暴露出党内的严重分歧。

ex.en: a place of great power and of deep significance
ex.cn: 具有重大影响力和深远意义的地方

senses.def: strongly felt

ex.en: deep respect
ex.cn: 深深的敬意

ex.en: a deep sense of loss
ex.cn: 强烈的失落感

senses.def: showing great knowledge or understanding

ex.en: a deep understanding
ex.cn: 深刻的理解

senses.def: difficult to understand

ex.en: This discussion's getting too deep for me.
ex.cn: 这讨论越来越深奥，使我难以理解。

ex.en: He pondered, as if over some deep philosophical point.
ex.cn: 他沉思着，仿佛在思索某个深奥的哲学问题。

senses.def: fully involved in an activity or a state

ex.en: to be deep in thought/conversation
ex.cn: 陷入深思；专心谈话

ex.en: He is often so deep in his books that he forgets to eat.
ex.cn: 他常常专心于读书以致忘了吃饭。

ex.en: The firm ended up deep in debt.
ex.cn: 这家公司最后债台高筑。

senses.def: if a person is deep, they hide their real feelings and opinions
senses.chn: 深沉的；摸不透的；城府深的

ex.en: She's always been a deep one, trusting no one.
ex.cn: 她这个人一直城府很深，对谁也不相信。

senses.def: to or from a position far down or across the field

ex.en: a deep ball from Brown
ex.cn: 布朗踢到球场远端的一脚球

senses.def: to suddenly become very angry or emotional
senses.chn: （突然）火冒三丈，大发脾气，非常激动

senses.def: in trouble or difficulty
to start or be made to start a new and difficult activity that you are not prepared for
senses.chn: （使）陷入未曾料到的艰难处境，一筹莫展

ex.en: Junior hospital doctors are thrown in at the deep end in their first jobs.
ex.cn: 医院的初级医生开始工作时会遇上未曾料到的困难。

senses.def: in a difficult situation where there are two equally unpleasant or unacceptable choices
in trouble

ex.en: I'll be in the shit if I don't get this work finished today.
ex.cn: 要是今天不把这活儿做完，那我就惨了。

senses.def: a long way below the surface of sth or a long way inside or into sth

ex.en: Dig deeper!
ex.cn: 再挖深点！

ex.en: The miners were trapped deep underground.
ex.cn: 矿工被困在地下深处。

ex.en: whales that feed deep beneath the waves
ex.cn: 在大海深处进食的鲸鱼

ex.en: He gazed deep into her eyes.
ex.cn: 他深深凝视着她的眼睛。

ex.en: They sat and talked deep into the night (= until very late).
ex.cn: 他们坐着谈话，一直谈到深夜。

ex.en: deep in the forest
ex.cn: 在森林深处

senses.def: if you know sth deep down, you know your true feelings about sth, although you may not admit them to yourself

ex.en: Deep down I still loved him.
ex.cn: 我在内心深处仍然爱着他。

senses.def: if sth is true deep down, it is really like that, although it may not be obvious to people

ex.en: He seems confident but deep down he's quite insecure.
ex.cn: 他好像很有信心，实际上却没什么把握。

senses.def: to be felt in a strong way, especially for a long time

ex.en: Dignity and pride run deep in this community.
ex.cn: 尊严和骄傲已深深扎根于这个群体之中。

senses.def: to search thoroughly for information

ex.en: You'll need to dig deep into the records to find the figures you want.
ex.cn: 你必须仔细查阅档案才能找到你需要的数字。

senses.def: to try hard to provide the money, equipment, etc. that is needed
senses.chn: 尽力提供（所需金钱、设备等）

ex.en: We're asking you to dig deep for the earthquake victims.
ex.cn: 我们请求你们尽力为地震灾民提供财物。

senses.def: to spend a lot of your own money on sth
a person who seems to be quiet or shy may surprise you by knowing a lot or having deep feelings
senses.chn: 静水流深；木讷寡言者也许胸藏丘壑

senses.def: the sea
a deep part of sth; the deepest part of sth

ex.en: in the deep of night/winter (= in the middle of the night/of winter)
ex.cn: 在深夜／隆冬

ex.en: the deeps of Loch Ness
ex.cn: 尼斯湖的深处

ex.en: the deeps of sorrow
ex.cn: 悲伤的深渊

senses.def: if you know sth deep down, you know your true feelings about sth, although you may not admit them to yourself

ex.en: Deep down I still loved him.
ex.cn: 我在内心深处仍然爱着他。

senses.def: if sth is true deep down, it is really like that, although it may not be obvious to people

ex.en: He seems confident but deep down he's quite insecure.
ex.cn: 他好像很有信心，实际上却没什么把握。

senses.def: having a particular characteristic or opinion very strongly
senses.chn: 特性明显的；立场鲜明的；十足的

ex.en: a deep-dyed socialist
ex.cn: 立场鲜明的社会主义者

senses.def: if an emotion or a feeling deepens, or if sth deepens it, it becomes stronger

ex.en: Their friendship soon deepened into love.
ex.cn: 他们的友谊很快发展成为爱情。

senses.def: to become worse; to make sth worse

ex.en: Warships were sent in as the crisis deepened.
ex.cn: 危机加重时军舰便奉命来到现场。

ex.en: a deepening economic recession
ex.cn: 越来越严重的经济衰退

senses.def: to become deeper; to make sth deeper

ex.en: The water deepened gradually.
ex.cn: 水渐渐变深了。

ex.en: His frown deepened.
ex.cn: 他的眉头皱得更紧了。

ex.en: There were plans to deepen a stretch of the river.
ex.cn: 曾经有过加深一段河道的计划。

senses.def: to improve your knowledge or understanding of sth

ex.en: an opportunity for students to deepen their understanding of different cultures
ex.cn: 学生加深理解不同文化的机会

senses.def: if colour or light deepens or if sth deepens it, it becomes darker
senses.chn: （使色泽、光线等）变浓；（使）变昏暗

ex.en: deepening shadows
ex.cn: 越来越暗的阴影

senses.def: if a sound or voice deepens or if you deepen it, it becomes lower or you make it lower

ex.en: His voice deepened to a growl.
ex.cn: 他的声音变成了低沉的怒吼。

senses.def: if your breathing deepens, you breathe more deeply than usual
preserved at an extremely low temperature
to cook food in oil that covers it completely

ex.en: deep-fried chicken pieces
ex.cn: 油炸鸡块

senses.def: very; very much

ex.en: She is deeply religious.
ex.cn: 她非常虔诚。

ex.en: They were deeply disturbed by the accident.
ex.cn: 这个事故使他们深感不安。

ex.en: Opinion is deeply divided on this issue.
ex.cn: 对这个问题的意见分歧很大。

ex.en: deeply rooted customs/ideas
ex.cn: 根深蒂固的习俗／思想

ex.en: deeply held beliefs/convictions/views (= that sb feels very strongly)
ex.cn: 坚定不移的信仰／信念／观点

senses.def: used with some verbs to show that sth is done in a very complete way
senses.chn: （与某些动词连用）深刻地，强烈地，深沉地

ex.en: to breathe/sigh/exhale deeply (= using all of the air in your lungs)
ex.cn: 深呼吸；深深地叹息；长长地呼气

ex.en: sleep deeply (= in a way that makes it difficult for you to wake up)
ex.cn: 酣睡

ex.en: to think deeply (= about all the aspects of sth)
ex.cn: 沉思

senses.def: to a depth that is quite a long way from the surface of sth

ex.en: to drill deeply into the wood
ex.cn: （钻头）往木头深处钻

senses.def: very fixed and strong; difficult to change or to destroy
senses.chn: 根深蒂固的；强烈的；坚定的

ex.en: a deep-rooted desire
ex.cn: 强烈的愿望

ex.en: The country's political divisions are deep-seated.
ex.cn: 这个国家的政治分歧根深蒂固。

senses.def: of or in the deeper parts of the sea

ex.en: a deep-sea diver
ex.cn: 深海潜水员

ex.en: deep-sea fishing/diving
ex.cn: 深海捕鱼／潜水

senses.def: very fixed and strong; difficult to change or to destroy
senses.chn: 根深蒂固的；强烈的；坚定的

ex.en: a deep-rooted desire
ex.cn: 强烈的愿望

ex.en: The country's political divisions are deep-seated.
ex.cn: 这个国家的政治分歧根深蒂固。

senses.def: eyes that are deep-set seem to be quite far back in a person's face
to decide not to do or use sth that you had planned to do or use

ex.en: Plans to build a new mall were deep-sixed after protests from local residents.
ex.cn: 修建新购物中心的计划由于当地居民反对而终止。

senses.def: the basic relationships between the different parts of a sentence, which show how we think when we are using language
a serious condition caused by a blood clot (= a thick mass of blood) forming in a vein

ex.en: Passengers on long-haul flights are being warned about the risks of deep vein thrombosis.
ex.cn: 长途航班上的乘客须注意可能出现深静脉血栓。

senses.def: an animal with long legs, that eats grass, leaves, etc. and can run fast. Most male deer have antlers (= horns shaped like branches). There are many types of deer.

ex.en: a herd of deer
ex.cn: 一群鹿

ex.en: a deer park
ex.cn: 鹿苑

senses.def: a cap with two peaks, one in front and one behind, and two pieces of cloth which are usually tied together on top but can be folded down to cover the ears
senses.chn: 猎鹿帽（前后各有一帽舌，两块护耳可系于帽顶）

senses.def: excellent

ex.en: a def band
ex.cn: 出色的乐队

senses.def: to damage the appearance of sth especially by drawing or writing on it
senses.chn: 损伤…的外貌（尤指乱涂、乱写）

senses.def: existing as a fact although it may not be legally accepted as existing
senses.chn: 实际上存在的（不一定合法）

ex.en: The general took de facto control of the country.
ex.cn: 这位将军实际上控制了整个国家。

senses.def: the act of damaging sb's reputation by saying or writing bad or false things about them

ex.en: The company sued for defamation.
ex.cn: 这家公司因受到诽谤而提起诉讼。

senses.def: intended to harm sb by saying or writing bad or false things about them
to harm sb by saying or writing bad or false things about them
failure to do sth that must be done by law, especially paying a debt

ex.en: The company is in default on the loan.
ex.cn: 这家公司拖欠借款。

ex.en: Mortgage defaults have risen in the last year.
ex.cn: 按揭借款违约在近一年里呈上升趋势。

senses.def: what happens or appears if you do not make any other choice or change
senses.chn: 默认；系统设定值；缺省值；预置值

ex.en: The default option is to save your work every five minutes.
ex.cn: 默认设置为每五分钟存盘一次。

ex.en: What is your default browser?
ex.cn: 你的默认浏览器是什么？

senses.def: a game or competition can be won by default if there are no other people, teams, etc. taking part
senses.chn: （比赛）因其他参赛者不到场，由于对手缺席（而胜出）

senses.def: if sth happens by default, it happens because you have not made any other decision or choices which would make things happen in a different way
senses.chn: 由于没有特别作出决定（或选择）

senses.def: because of a lack of sth

ex.en: They accepted what he had said in default of any evidence to disprove it.
ex.cn: 由于缺乏相反的证据，他们相信了他的话。

senses.def: to fail to do sth that you legally have to do, especially by not paying a debt
senses.chn: 违约，不履行义务（尤指不偿还债务）

ex.en: to default on a loan/debt
ex.cn: 拖欠借款／债务

ex.en: defaulting borrowers/tenants
ex.cn: 不偿还债务的借款人；拖欠租金的承租人

senses.def: to happen when you do not make any other choice or change
to win against sb in a war, competition, sports game, etc.

ex.en: He defeated the champion in three sets.
ex.cn: 他三盘击败了冠军。

ex.en: a defeated army
ex.cn: 败军

senses.def: to stop sth from being successful

ex.en: The motion was defeated by 19 votes.
ex.cn: 这项动议以差额 19 票被否决。

ex.en: Staying late at the office to discuss shorter working hours rather defeats the object of the exercise!
ex.cn: 迟迟待在办公室讨论缩短工作时间恰恰是在阻挠这一目标的实现！

senses.def: if sth defeats you, you cannot understand it

ex.en: The instruction manual completely defeated me.
ex.cn: 这操作指南把我完全弄糊涂了。

senses.def: failure to win or to be successful

ex.en: The party faces defeat in the election.
ex.cn: 这个党面临选举失败。

ex.en: a narrow/heavy defeat
ex.cn: 惜败；惨败

ex.en: The world champion has only had two defeats in 20 fights.
ex.cn: 这个世界冠军在 20 场比赛中只败过两场。

ex.en: They finally had to admit defeat (= stop trying to be successful).
ex.cn: 他们最后只得认输。

senses.def: the act of winning a victory over sb/sth

ex.en: the defeat of fascism
ex.cn: 战胜法西斯主义

senses.def: expecting not to succeed, and showing it in a particular situation

ex.en: a defeatist attitude/view
ex.cn: 失败主义的态度／观点

senses.def: to get rid of solid waste from your body through your bowels
a fault in sth or in the way it has been made which means that it is not perfect

ex.en: a speech defect
ex.cn: 言语缺陷

ex.en: a defect in the glass
ex.cn: 玻璃杯的缺陷

senses.def: to leave a political party, country, etc. to join another that is considered to be an enemy
having a fault or faults; not perfect or complete
senses.chn: 有缺点的；有缺陷的；有毛病的

ex.en: defective goods
ex.cn: 有缺陷的商品

ex.en: Her hearing was found to be slightly defective.
ex.cn: 经检查，她的听力有点缺陷。

senses.def: the act of protecting sb/sth from attack, criticism, etc.

ex.en: soldiers who died in defence of their country
ex.cn: 为保卫祖国而献身的战士

ex.en: When her brother was criticized she leapt to his defence.
ex.cn: 她的哥哥受到批评时，她马上跳出来卫护。

ex.en: What points can be raised in defence of this argument?
ex.cn: 有什么论点能提出来为这个说法辩护呢？

ex.en: I have to say in her defence that she knew nothing about it beforehand.
ex.cn: 我得为她说句话，她事先并不知道此事。

senses.def: something that provides protection against attack from enemies, the weather, illness, etc.

ex.en: The town walls were built as a defence against enemy attacks.
ex.cn: 城墙是为防御敌人袭击而修建的。

ex.en: The harbour's sea defences are in poor condition.
ex.cn: 港口的海防工事状况很差。

ex.en: The body has natural defence mechanisms to protect it from disease.
ex.cn: 人体对疾病具有先天性防御机制。

ex.en: Humour is a more effective defence than violence.
ex.cn: 幽默是比暴力更有效的防御武器。

senses.def: the organization of the people and systems that are used by a government to protect a country from attack

ex.en: the Ministry of Defence
ex.cn: 国防部

ex.en: the Department of Defense
ex.cn: 国防部

ex.en: Further cuts in defence spending are being considered.
ex.cn: 目前正在考虑进一步削减国防开支。

senses.def: something that is said or written in order to support sth

ex.en: a defence of Marxism
ex.cn: 为马克思主义辩解

senses.def: what is said in court to prove that a person did not commit a crime; the act of presenting this argument in court

ex.en: Her defence was that she was somewhere completely different at the time of the crime.
ex.cn: 她的辩词是案发时她根本就不在现场。

ex.en: He wanted to conduct his own defence.
ex.cn: 他想自己为自己辩护。

senses.def: the lawyer or lawyers whose job is to prove in court that a person did not commit a crime
the players who must prevent the other team from scoring; the position of these players on the sports field

ex.en: Welford cut through the defence to score the winning goal.
ex.cn: 韦尔福特突破防守射进了制胜的一球。

ex.en: She plays in defence.
ex.cn: 她打防守。

ex.en: He plays on defense.
ex.cn: 他打防守。

senses.def: a contest, game, etc. in which the previous winner or winners compete in order to try to win again

ex.en: Barcelona's defence of the Champions League title
ex.cn: 欧洲冠军联赛巴塞罗那队的冠军卫冕赛

senses.def: weak; not able to protect yourself; having no protection
senses.chn: 软弱的；不能自卫的；无防御的

ex.en: defenceless children
ex.cn: 没有自卫能力的儿童

ex.en: The village is defenceless against attack.
ex.cn: 这个村庄毫无防御能力。

senses.def: to protect sb/sth from attack

ex.en: Troops have been sent to defend the borders.
ex.cn: 已派出部队去守卫边疆。

ex.en: All our officers are trained to defend themselves against knife attacks.
ex.cn: 我们所有的警察都接受过自卫训练，能够对付持刀袭击。

ex.en: It is impossible to defend against an all-out attack.
ex.cn: 防御全面进攻是不可能的。

senses.def: to say or write sth in support of sb/sth that has been criticized

ex.en: How can you defend such behaviour?
ex.cn: 你怎能为这种行为辩解呢？

ex.en: Politicians are skilled at defending themselves against their critics.
ex.cn: 从政者都善于为自己辩解，反驳别人的批评。

senses.def: to protect your own goal to stop your opponents from scoring
to take part in a competition that you won the last time and try to win it again
senses.chn: 参加比赛（或选举）保住（头衔、席位等）

ex.en: He is defending champion.
ex.cn: 他在参加卫冕赛。

ex.en: She will be defending her title at next month's championships.
ex.cn: 她将在下月的锦标赛上争取蝉联冠军。

ex.en: He intends to defend his seat in the next election.
ex.cn: 他想在下届选举中寻求连任。

senses.def: to act as a lawyer for sb who has been charged with a crime

ex.en: He has employed one of the UK's top lawyers to defend him.
ex.cn: 他请了英国一位顶尖律师为他辩护。

senses.def: the person in a trial who is accused of committing a crime, or who is being sued by another person
a player who must stop the other team from scoring in games such as football (soccer), hockey, etc.
a person who defends and believes in protecting sth

ex.en: a passionate defender of human rights
ex.cn: 热诚的人权卫士

senses.def: able to be supported by reasons or arguments that show that it is right or should be allowed
senses.chn: 可辩解的；合乎情理的；有正当理由的

ex.en: Is abortion morally defensible?
ex.cn: 堕胎从道德上讲合乎情理吗？

senses.def: able to be defended from an attack
protecting sb/sth against attack

ex.en: a defensive measure
ex.cn: 防御措施

ex.en: Troops took up a defensive position around the town.
ex.cn: 部队在全城采取了守势。

senses.def: behaving in a way that shows that you feel that people are criticizing you
senses.chn: 戒备的；怀有戒心的；自卫的

ex.en: Don't ask him about his plans—he just gets defensive.
ex.cn: 别问他有什么计划，他老存有戒心。

senses.def: connected with trying to prevent the other team or player from scoring points or goals

ex.en: defensive play
ex.cn: 防守型打法

senses.def: acting in a way that shows that you expect to be attacked or criticized; having to defend yourself
senses.chn: 处于防御姿态；处于戒备状态；采取守势

ex.en: Their questions about the money put her on the defensive.
ex.cn: 他们问到钱的问题时，她就警觉起来。

ex.en: Warnings of an enemy attack forced the troops onto the defensive.
ex.cn: 敌军显示出进攻的迹象，部队不得不进入戒备状态。

senses.def: medical treatment that involves more tests, operations, etc. than a person really needs because a doctor is worried that a claim or complaint may be made against them in court if they make a mistake in the treatment they give
senses.chn: 防御性医疗，自卫性医疗（医生担心因误诊被起诉而让病人做过多的化验、手术等）

senses.def: to delay sth until a later time

ex.en: The department deferred the decision for six months.
ex.cn: 这个部门推迟了六个月才作决定。

ex.en: She had applied for deferred admission to college.
ex.cn: 她已申请延期入学。

senses.def: to agree to accept what sb has decided or what they think about sb/sth because you respect him or her

ex.en: We will defer to whatever the committee decides.
ex.cn: 我们遵从委员会的任何决定。

senses.def: behaviour that shows that you respect sb/sth

ex.en: The women wore veils in deference to the customs of the country.
ex.cn: 这些妇女戴着面纱是遵从这个国家的习俗。

ex.en: The flags were lowered out of deference to the bereaved family.
ex.cn: 降旗是出于对死者家属的尊重。

senses.def: open refusal to obey sb/sth

ex.en: a look/an act/a gesture of defiance
ex.cn: 反抗的神色／行动／表示

ex.en: Nuclear testing was resumed in defiance of an international ban.
ex.cn: 尽管国际上明令禁止，核试验又在进行了。

senses.def: (in South Africa in the past, especially in the period after 1952) a series of activities in which black people refused to obey laws that were not fair
senses.chn: 抗法运动（尤指 1952 年之后，南非黑人拒绝遵守不公平的法律规定）

senses.def: openly refusing to obey sb/sth, sometimes in an aggressive way
senses.chn: 公然违抗的；反抗的；挑衅的

ex.en: a defiant teenager
ex.cn: 一个反叛的少年

ex.en: The terrorists sent a defiant message to the government.
ex.cn: 恐怖分子向政府发出了挑战书。

senses.def: the use of a controlled electric shock from a defibrillator to return the heart to its natural rhythm
a piece of equipment used to control the movements of the heart muscles by giving the heart a controlled electric shock
senses.chn: 除颤器（通过电击心脏控制心肌运动）

senses.def: the state of not having, or not having enough of, sth that is essential

ex.en: Vitamin deficiency in the diet can cause illness.
ex.cn: 饮食中缺乏维生素会导致疾病。

ex.en: a deficiency of Vitamin B
ex.cn: 缺乏维生素 B

senses.def: a fault or a weakness in sth/sb that makes it or them less successful

ex.en: deficiencies in the computer system
ex.cn: 计算机系统的种种缺陷

senses.def: not having enough of sth, especially sth that is essential

ex.en: a diet that is deficient in vitamin A
ex.cn: 缺乏维生素 A 的饮食

senses.def: not good enough

ex.en: Deaf people are sometimes treated as being mentally deficient.
ex.cn: 耳聋的人有时被看作智力不健全。

senses.def: the amount by which money spent or owed is greater than money earned in a particular period of time

ex.en: a budget/trade deficit
ex.cn: 预算赤字；贸易逆差

ex.en: The trade balance has been in deficit for the past five years.
ex.cn: 过去五年来贸易状况一直是逆差。

senses.def: the amount by which sth, especially an amount of money, is too small or smaller than sth else

ex.en: There's a deficit of $3 million in the total needed to complete the project.
ex.cn: 完成这项工程所需资金还缺少 300 万美元。

ex.en: The team has to come back from a 2–0 deficit in the first half.
ex.cn: 这支队得扳回上半场 0:2 的落后局面。

senses.def: to make sth dirty or no longer pure, especially sth that people consider important or holy

ex.en: Many victims of burglary feel their homes have been defiled.
ex.cn: 许多家门被撬的人都感到自己的家被玷污了。

ex.en: The altar had been defiled by vandals.
ex.cn: 圣坛受到破坏公物者的肆意践踏。

senses.def: a narrow way through mountains
to say or explain what the meaning of a word or phrase is
senses.chn: 解释（词语的含义）；给…下定义

ex.en: The term 'mental illness' is difficult to define.
ex.cn: “精神病” 这个词很难下定义。

ex.en: Life imprisonment is defined as 60 years under state law.
ex.cn: 按照州法律终身监禁定义为 60 年。

ex.en: It is important to clarify what is meant by climate change.
ex.cn: 说清楚 “气候变化” 的含义很重要。

ex.en: Climate change can / may be defined as 'the long-term fluctuations in temperature, precipitation, wind and other aspects of the earth's climate'.
ex.cn: 气候变化可以被定义为 “地球气候在温度、降水量、风力及其他方面的长期波动”。

ex.en: A generally accepted definition of global warming is the gradual increase in the overall temperature of the earth's atmosphere due to the greenhouse effect.
ex.cn: 对于全球变暖，普遍接受的一种定义是：由于受到温室效应的影响，地球大气层总体温度逐渐上升。

ex.en: The greenhouse effect is defined by the author as the process by which heat from the sun is trapped in the earth's atmosphere, causing the temperature of the earth to rise.
ex.cn: 作者将温室效应定义为：地球大气层锁住来自太阳的热量，导致地球温度上升的过程。

senses.def: to describe or show sth accurately

ex.en: We need to define the task ahead very clearly.
ex.cn: 我们需要明确今后的任务。

ex.en: The difficulty of a problem was defined in terms of how long it took to complete.
ex.cn: 问题的难易度是以解决这个问题所花时间的长短而定的。

ex.en: It is difficult to define what makes him so popular.
ex.cn: 很难解释清楚什么原因使他如此走红。

senses.def: to show clearly a line, shape or edge
senses.chn: 画出…的线条；描出…的外形；确定…的界线；界定

ex.en: The mountain was sharply defined against the sky.
ex.cn: 那座山在天空的衬托下显得轮廓分明。

senses.def: a fixed amount of money that will be paid by a pension plan, especially when this amount is based on your salary at the end of your working life and the number of years you worked
fixed payments that are made to a pension plan, where the amount that will be paid out can change
a set of carefully chosen words used to write the explanations in some dictionaries
sure or certain; unlikely to change
senses.chn: 肯定的；确定的；不会改变的

ex.en: Can you give me a definite answer by tomorrow?
ex.cn: 你最晚明天能给我一个确定的答复吗？

ex.en: Is it definite that he's leaving?
ex.cn: 他肯定要离开吗？

ex.en: I've heard rumours, but nothing definite.
ex.cn: 我听到一些流言，但都不确定。

ex.en: a definite offer of a job
ex.cn: 明确给予一份工作

ex.en: I'm not sure—I can find out for definite if you like.
ex.cn: 我没把握，如果你愿意，我可以去核实。

ex.en: That's definite then, is it?
ex.cn: 那么，那是确切的了，是吗？

senses.def: easily or clearly seen or understood; obvious

ex.en: The look on her face was a definite sign that something was wrong.
ex.cn: 一看她的神色就知道出事了。

ex.en: There was a definite feeling that things were getting worse.
ex.cn: 人们明显感到事情越来越糟。

senses.def: sure that sth is true or that sth is going to happen and stating it to other people

ex.en: I'm definite about this.
ex.cn: 我对这事毫无疑问。

senses.def: sth that you are certain about or that you know will happen; sb who is sure to do sth

ex.en: 'We're moving our office to Glasgow.' 'That's a definite, is it?'
ex.cn: “我们的办事处要搬到格拉斯哥去。” “这事儿定了，是吗？”

ex.en: 'Is Sarah coming to the party?' 'Yes, she's a definite.'
ex.cn: “萨拉要来参加聚会吗？” “是的，她肯定来。”

senses.def: the word the in English, or a similar word in another language
senses.chn: 定冠词（如英语中的 the）

senses.def: a way of emphasizing that sth is true and that there is no doubt about it

ex.en: I definitely remember sending the letter.
ex.cn: 我记得这封信肯定发出去了。

ex.en: 'Was it what you expected?' 'Yes, definitely.'
ex.cn: “那是你所期待的吗？” “当然是。”

ex.en: 'Do you plan to have children?' 'Definitely not!'
ex.cn: “你们打算要孩子吗？” “绝对没这个打算！”

ex.en: Some old people want help; others most definitely do not.
ex.cn: 有些老人想要得到帮助，有些却根本不需要。

senses.def: in a way that is certain or that shows that you are certain

ex.en: The date of the move has not been definitely decided yet (= it may change).
ex.cn: 搬迁日期还未完全确定下来。

ex.en: Please say definitely whether you will be coming or not.
ex.cn: 请说清楚，你来还是不来。

senses.def: an explanation of the meaning of a word or phrase, especially in a dictionary; the act of stating the meanings of words and phrases
senses.chn: （尤指词典里的词或短语的）释义；解释

ex.en: clear simple definitions
ex.cn: 简单明了的释义

ex.en: Neighbours by definition live close by (= this is what being a neighbour means).
ex.cn: 顾名思义，“邻居” 就要住在邻近的地方。

ex.en: It is important to clarify what is meant by climate change.
ex.cn: 说清楚 “气候变化” 的含义很重要。

ex.en: Climate change can / may be defined as 'the long-term fluctuations in temperature, precipitation, wind and other aspects of the earth's climate'.
ex.cn: 气候变化可以被定义为 “地球气候在温度、降水量、风力及其他方面的长期波动”。

ex.en: A generally accepted definition of global warming is the gradual increase in the overall temperature of the earth's atmosphere due to the greenhouse effect.
ex.cn: 对于全球变暖，普遍接受的一种定义是：由于受到温室效应的影响，地球大气层总体温度逐渐上升。

ex.en: The greenhouse effect is defined by the author as the process by which heat from the sun is trapped in the earth's atmosphere, causing the temperature of the earth to rise.
ex.cn: 作者将温室效应定义为：地球大气层锁住来自太阳的热量，导致地球温度上升的过程。

senses.def: what an idea, etc. means

ex.en: What's your definition of happiness?
ex.cn: 你对幸福的定义是什么？

senses.def: the quality of being clear and easy to see

ex.en: The definition of the digital TV pictures is excellent.
ex.cn: 数字电视图像的清晰度很高。

senses.def: final; not able to be changed
senses.chn: 最后的；决定性的；不可更改的

ex.en: a definitive agreement/answer/statement
ex.cn: 最后的协议／答复／声明

ex.en: The definitive version of the text is ready to be published.
ex.cn: 文本的正稿已备妥，可以发表了。

senses.def: considered to be the best of its kind and almost impossible to improve

ex.en: the definitive biography of Einstein
ex.cn: 最完整可靠的爱因斯坦传记

senses.def: to let air or gas out of a tyre, balloon, etc.; to become smaller because of air or gas coming out
senses.chn: 放掉（轮胎、气球等的）气；（使）瘪下来

senses.def: to make sb feel less confident; to make sb/sth feel or seem less important

ex.en: All the criticism had left her feeling totally deflated.
ex.cn: 所有这些批评使她彻底失去了信心。

senses.def: to reduce the amount of money being used in a country so that prices fall or stay steady
a reduction in the amount of money in a country's economy so that prices fall or remain the same
the action of air being removed from sth
to change direction or make sth change direction, especially after hitting sth
senses.chn: （尤指击中某物后）偏斜，转向，使偏斜，使转向

ex.en: The ball deflected off Reid's body into the goal.
ex.cn: 球打在里德身上反弹进球门。

ex.en: He raised his arm to try to deflect the blow.
ex.cn: 他举起手臂试图挡开这一击。

senses.def: to succeed in preventing sth from being directed towards you

ex.en: All attempts to deflect attention from his private life have failed.
ex.cn: 本想转移人们对他私生活的注意，但一切努力都失败了。

ex.en: She sought to deflect criticism by blaming her family.
ex.cn: 她责怪她的家人，企图以此转移对她的批评。

senses.def: to prevent sb from doing sth that they are determined to do
senses.chn: 阻止（某人做已决定做的事）

ex.en: The government will not be deflected from its commitments.
ex.cn: 政府决不会因任何阻碍而放弃承诺。

senses.def: a sudden change in the direction that sth is moving in, usually after it has hit sth; the act of causing sth to change direction
senses.chn: （常指击中某物后）突然转向，偏斜，偏离

ex.en: the angle of deflection
ex.cn: 偏斜度

ex.en: the deflection of the missile away from its target
ex.cn: 导弹偏离目标

ex.en: The goal was scored with a deflection off the goalkeeper.
ex.cn: 这个入球是球打在守门员身上反弹入网的。

senses.def: to have sex with a woman who has not had sex before
senses.chn: 奸污（处女）；夺去（女子）的贞操

senses.def: to remove the condensation from a car's windows so that you can see clearly
senses.chn: 除去（汽车玻璃上的）雾水

senses.def: a chemical that removes the leaves from plants, sometimes used as a weapon in war
senses.chn: 落叶剂（有时用作军事武器）

senses.def: to destroy the leaves of trees or plants, especially with chemicals
to cut down and destroy all the trees in a place
senses.chn: 砍掉（某地）的树林；毁掉（某地）的森林

ex.en: Two thirds of the region has been deforested in the past decade.
ex.cn: 在过去十年里这个地区的森林有三分之二被毁掉。

senses.def: the act of cutting down or burning the trees in an area
to change or spoil the usual or natural shape of sth
senses.chn: 改变…的外形；损毁…的形状；使成畸形

ex.en: The disease had deformed his spine.
ex.cn: 疾病导致他脊柱变形。

senses.def: the process or result of changing and spoiling the normal shape of sth
a change in the normal shape of sth as a result of injury or illness

ex.en: a deformation of the spine
ex.cn: 脊柱的畸变

senses.def: having a shape that is not normal because it has grown wrongly

ex.en: She was born with deformed hands.
ex.cn: 她的双手天生畸形。

senses.def: a condition in which a part of the body is not the normal shape because of injury, illness or because it has grown wrongly

ex.en: Drugs taken during pregnancy may cause physical deformity in babies.
ex.cn: 妊娠期服用的药物可能引起婴儿身体畸形。

senses.def: (in Britain) Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs
senses.chn: （英国）环境、食品和乡村事务部

senses.def: to organize the files on a computer so that information relating to each file is stored in the same area, so the computer works faster
to get money illegally from a person or an organization by tricking them

ex.en: All three men were charged with conspiracy to defraud.
ex.cn: 三人均被控密谋诈骗。

ex.en: They were accused of defrauding the company of $14 000.
ex.cn: 他们被控诈骗该公司 14 000 美元。

senses.def: to give sb back the money that they have spent on sth
senses.chn: 支付，付给（已开支的款项）

senses.def: to officially remove a priest from his or her job, because he or she has done sth wrong
senses.chn: 免去（行为不端的牧师）的圣职

ex.en: a defrocked priest
ex.cn: 被免职的祭司

senses.def: to become or make sth warmer, especially food, so that it is no longer frozen

ex.en: It will take about four hours to defrost.
ex.cn: 解冻要花四小时左右。

ex.en: Make sure you defrost the chicken completely before cooking.
ex.cn: 一定要让冻鸡化透后再烹调。

senses.def: when you defrost a fridge/refrigerator or freezer, or when it defrosts, you remove the ice from it
senses.chn: 给（冰箱或冷冻柜）除霜；除霜

senses.def: to remove ice from the surface of a car's windows
senses.chn: 除去（汽车玻璃上的）冰霜

senses.def: skilful and quick

ex.en: deft hands/fingers/footwork
ex.cn: 灵活的手／手指／步法

ex.en: He finished off the painting with a few deft strokes of the brush.
ex.cn: 他用画笔熟练地勾上几笔，这幅画就完成了。

senses.def: skilful

ex.en: her deft command of the language
ex.cn: 她对这种语言的充分掌握

senses.def: no longer existing, operating or being used
senses.chn: 已灭绝的；不再起作用的；不再使用的

senses.def: to stop a possibly dangerous or difficult situation from developing, especially by making people less angry or nervous

ex.en: Local police are trying to defuse racial tension in the community.
ex.cn: 当地的警察竭力缓和这个社区种族间的紧张关系。

senses.def: to remove the fuse from a bomb so that it cannot explode
to refuse to obey or show respect for sb in authority, a law, a rule, etc.

ex.en: I wouldn't have dared to defy my teachers.
ex.cn: 我可不敢不听老师的话。

ex.en: Hundreds of people today defied the ban on political gatherings.
ex.cn: 今天有数百人违抗禁止政治集会的规定。

senses.def: to be impossible or almost impossible to believe, explain, describe, etc.
senses.chn: 不可能，无法（相信、解释、描绘等）

ex.en: a political move that defies explanation
ex.cn: 无法解释的政治举动

ex.en: The beauty of the scene defies description.
ex.cn: 景色之美简直难以描绘。

senses.def: to successfully resist sth to a very unusual degree

ex.en: The baby boy defied all the odds and survived (= stayed alive when it seemed certain that he would die).
ex.cn: 这名男婴九死一生活了下来。

senses.def: used to say that sb should try to do sth, as a way of emphasizing that you think it is impossible to do it
senses.chn: 激，挑动（某人尽力做你认为不可能的事）

ex.en: I defy anyone not to cry at the end of the film.
ex.cn: 我倒要看看有谁在电影结尾时不哭。

senses.def: to become worse, for example by becoming lower in quality or weaker

ex.en: Her health degenerated quickly.
ex.cn: 她的健康状况迅速恶化。

ex.en: The march degenerated into a riot.
ex.cn: 示威游行变成了暴乱。

senses.def: having moral standards that have fallen to a level that is very low and unacceptable to most people

ex.en: a degenerate popular culture
ex.cn: 颓废的大众文化

senses.def: having returned to a simple structure; lacking sth that is usually present
a person whose behaviour shows moral standards that have fallen to a very low level
the process of becoming worse or less acceptable in quality or condition

ex.en: social/moral degeneration
ex.cn: 社会倒退；道德沦丧

ex.en: Intensive farming in the area has caused severe degeneration of the land.
ex.cn: 这个地区的集约化农业使得土壤严重贫瘠化。

senses.def: getting or likely to get worse as time passes
senses.chn: （随着时间的推移）变性的，退行性的

ex.en: degenerative diseases such as arthritis
ex.cn: 诸如关节炎之类的变性病

senses.def: to remove burned meat or vegetable juices from a pan by pouring in liquid and stirring
senses.chn: 洗锅收汁（烹饪时加入液体溶解锅里焦化的肉和菜汁等）

ex.en: When the meat is brown, deglaze the pan with white wine.
ex.cn: 当肉变成褐色时，用白葡萄酒洗锅收汁。

senses.def: that can be changed to a simpler form
senses.chn: 可降级的；可降低的；可降解的

senses.def: a situation in which sb has lost all self-respect and the respect of other people

ex.en: the degradation of being sent to prison
ex.cn: 被关进监狱的落魄境况

senses.def: the process of sth being damaged or made worse

ex.en: environmental degradation
ex.cn: 环境恶化

senses.def: to show or treat sb in a way that makes them seem not worth any respect or not worth taking seriously
senses.chn: 降低…身份；侮辱…的人格；使受屈辱

ex.en: This poster is offensive and degrades women.
ex.cn: 这张海报冒失无礼，有辱女性尊严。

senses.def: to change or make sth change to a simpler chemical form
to make sth become worse, especially in quality
treating sb as if they have no value, so that they lose their self-respect and the respect of other people
senses.chn: 有辱人格的；降低身份的；贬低的

ex.en: the inhuman and degrading treatment of prisoners
ex.cn: 犯人所受的不人道和侮辱性待遇

senses.def: to remove grease or oil from sth
a unit for measuring angles

ex.en: an angle of ninety degrees (90°)
ex.cn: 90 度角

senses.def: a unit for measuring temperature

ex.en: Water freezes at 32 degrees Fahrenheit (32°F) or zero/nought degrees Celsius (0°C).
ex.cn: 水在 32 华氏度或零摄氏度结冰。

senses.def: the amount or level of sth

ex.en: Her job demands a high degree of skill.
ex.cn: 她的工作要求有高超的技能。

ex.en: I agree with you to a certain degree.
ex.cn: 我在某种程度上同意你的观点。

ex.en: To what degree can parents be held responsible for a child's behaviour?
ex.cn: 父母应在多大程度上对孩子的行为负责呢？

ex.en: Most pop music is influenced, to a greater or lesser degree, by the blues.
ex.cn: 多数流行音乐都不同程度地受到布鲁斯音乐的影响。

senses.def: the qualification obtained by students who successfully complete a university or college course

ex.en: My brother has a master's degree from Harvard.
ex.cn: 我哥哥有哈佛大学的硕士学位。

ex.en: She has a degree in Biochemistry from Queen's University.
ex.cn: 她有女王大学的生物化学学位。

ex.en: a four-year degree course
ex.cn: 四年的学位课程

senses.def: a university or college course, normally lasting three years or more
senses.chn: （大学通常三年或以上的）学位课程

ex.en: I'm hoping to do a chemistry degree.
ex.cn: 我希望攻读化学学位课程。

senses.def: a level in a scale of how serious sth is

ex.en: murder in the first degree (= of the most serious kind)
ex.cn: 一级谋杀（最严重）

ex.en: first-degree murder
ex.cn: 一级谋杀

ex.en: third-degree (= very serious) burns
ex.cn: 三度烧伤（非常严重）

senses.def: slowly and gradually

ex.en: By degrees their friendship grew into love.
ex.cn: 他们的友谊逐渐发展成为爱情。

senses.def: extremely; to an extreme degree
senses.chn: 极端地；非常地；极大程度上

senses.def: to make sb lose their human qualities such as kindness, pity, etc.

ex.en: the dehumanizing effects of poverty and squalor
ex.cn: 贫穷和肮脏的环境造成丧失人性的结果

senses.def: an electrical machine for removing water from the air
to remove the water from sth, especially food, in order to preserve it
to lose too much water from your body; to make a person's body lose too much water

ex.en: Runners can dehydrate very quickly in this heat.
ex.cn: 天这样热，赛跑运动员很快会脱水。

ex.en: the dehydrating effects of alcohol
ex.cn: 酒精引起的脱水

senses.def: to remove the ice from sth
a substance that is put on a surface to remove ice or to stop it from forming
relating to a word or an expression whose meaning depends on who says it, where they are, who they are talking to, etc., for example 'you', 'me', 'here', 'next week'
senses.chn: （词语或表达方式）指示的（如 you、me、here、next week 等）

senses.def: to treat or worship sb as a god
senses.chn: 把（某人）奉若神明；把（某人）尊为神；崇拜

senses.def: to do sth in a way that shows you think you are too important to do it
senses.chn: 屈尊，俯就，降低身份（做某事）

ex.en: She just grunted, not deigning to look up from the page.
ex.cn: 她只咕哝了一声，继续看书，不屑抬起头来看一眼。

senses.def: belief in God, especially a God that created the universe but does not take part in it
senses.chn: 自然神论，理神论（认为上帝创造世界后让其自然运行）

senses.def: a god or goddess

ex.en: Greek/Roman/Hindu deities
ex.cn: 希腊／罗马／印度教诸神

senses.def: God
the function or use of deictic words or expressions (= ones whose meaning depends on where, when or by whom they are used)
senses.chn: 指示功能；指示词的使用

senses.def: unhappy and disappointed
senses.chn: 沮丧的；情绪低落的；垂头丧气的

ex.en: She looked so dejected when she lost the game.

the use of a small computer and a printer to produce a small book, a magazine or other printed material
senses.chn: 桌面出版，桌上排版（用微型电脑和打印机从事出版业务）

senses.def: the capital and largest city of the US state of Iowa
senses.chn: 得梅因（美国艾奥瓦州首府和最大城市）

senses.def: empty and without people, making you feel sad or frightened
senses.chn: 无人居住的；荒无人烟的；荒凉的

ex.en: a bleak and desolate landscape
ex.cn: 一片荒凉的景色

senses.def: very lonely and unhappy
senses.chn: 孤独凄凉的；不幸的；忧伤的

senses.def: to make sb feel sad and without hope
senses.chn: 使感到悲惨；使感到凄凉；使悲伤绝望

ex.en: She had been desolated by the death of her friend.
ex.cn: 朋友的去世使她感到十分悲伤。

senses.def: the feeling of being very lonely and unhappy
the state of a place that is ruined or destroyed and offers no joy or hope to people

ex.en: a scene of utter desolation
ex.cn: 满目疮痍的景象

senses.def: the feeling of having lost all hope

ex.en: She uttered a cry of despair.
ex.cn: 她发出了绝望的叫声。

ex.en: A deep sense of despair overwhelmed him.
ex.cn: 深深的绝望使他痛苦不堪。

ex.en: He gave up the struggle in despair.
ex.cn: 他绝望地放弃了斗争。

ex.en: One harsh word would send her into the depths of despair.
ex.cn: 一句严厉的话就会使她陷入极度的绝望之中。

ex.en: Eventually, driven to despair, he threw himself under a train.
ex.cn: 他被逼得走投无路，最后卧轨自杀了。

senses.def: to make sb worried or unhappy, because they cannot help

ex.en: My handwriting was the despair of my teachers.
ex.cn: 我的字写得很差，使老师们感到十分失望。

senses.def: advice not to try to do sth because it is too difficult
to stop having any hope that a situation will change or improve
senses.chn: 绝望；失去希望；丧失信心

ex.en: Don't despair! We'll think of a way out of this.
ex.cn: 别灰心！我们会找到出路的。

ex.en: I despair of him; he can't keep a job for more than six months.
ex.cn: 我对他都绝望了，他做任何工作都不超过半年。

ex.en: They'd almost despaired of ever having children.
ex.cn: 他们对生孩子几乎不抱任何希望了。

senses.def: showing or feeling the loss of all hope
senses.chn: 表示绝望的；感到绝望的；没有希望的

ex.en: a despairing cry/look/sigh
ex.cn: 绝望的呼声／神情／叹息

ex.en: With every day that passed he became ever more despairing.
ex.cn: 随着日子一天天过去，他越来越绝望。

senses.def: a man who does dangerous and criminal things without caring about himself or other people
feeling or showing that you have little hope and are ready to do anything without worrying about danger to yourself or others
senses.chn: （因绝望而）不惜冒险的，不顾一切的，拼命的

ex.en: The prisoners grew increasingly desperate.
ex.cn: 犯人因绝望而越来越胆大妄为。

ex.en: Stores are getting desperate after two years of poor sales.
ex.cn: 两年来销路不畅，商店不惜冒起险来。

ex.en: Somewhere out there was a desperate man, cold, hungry, hunted.
ex.cn: 那外面有个男人又冷又饿，还有人抓他，走投无路了。

ex.en: I heard sounds of a desperate struggle in the next room.
ex.cn: 我听到隔壁房间里有拼命挣扎的声音。

senses.def: giving little hope of success; tried when everything else has failed
senses.chn: 绝望的；孤注一掷的；铤而走险的

ex.en: a desperate bid for freedom
ex.cn: 孤注一掷争取自由的努力

ex.en: She clung to the edge in a desperate attempt to save herself.
ex.cn: 为了活命，她拼命抓住边缘。

ex.en: His increasing financial difficulties forced him to take desperate measures.
ex.cn: 不断增加的经济困难迫使他采取了铤而走险的办法。

ex.en: Doctors were fighting a desperate battle to save the little girl's life.
ex.cn: 医生们不惜一切地奋力抢救小女孩的生命。

senses.def: needing or wanting sth very much

ex.en: He was so desperate for a job he would have done anything.
ex.cn: 他当时太想找份工作了，什么事都愿意干。

ex.en: I'm desperate for a cigarette.
ex.cn: 我很想抽支烟。

ex.en: I was absolutely desperate to see her.
ex.cn: 我极想见到她。

senses.def: extremely serious or dangerous
senses.chn: 极严重的；极危险的；很危急的

ex.en: The children are in desperate need of love and attention.
ex.cn: 这些孩子非常需要爱心和关注。

ex.en: They face a desperate shortage of clean water.
ex.cn: 他们面临洁净水的严重短缺。

senses.def: the state of being desperate

ex.en: In desperation, she called Louise and asked for her help.
ex.cn: 在走投无路的情况下，她给路易丝打了个电话请她帮忙。

ex.en: There was a note of desperation in his voice.
ex.cn: 听他的语气他急得要命。

ex.en: an act of sheer desperation
ex.cn: 完全不顾一切的行为

senses.def: very unpleasant or evil
senses.chn: 令人厌恶的；可鄙的；卑鄙的

ex.en: a despicable act/crime
ex.cn: 卑鄙的行为／罪行

ex.en: I hate you! You're despicable.
ex.cn: 我恨你！你真卑鄙。

senses.def: to dislike and have no respect for sb/sth

ex.en: She despised gossip in any form.
ex.cn: 她对任何形式的流言蜚语都嗤之以鼻。

ex.en: He despised himself for being so cowardly.
ex.cn: 他为自己如此怯懦而自惭形秽。

ex.en: He hates violence in any form.
ex.cn: 他憎恶任何形式的暴力。

ex.en: I've always hated cabbage.
ex.cn: 我从来都讨厌吃卷心菜。

ex.en: I don't like it when you phone me so late at night.
ex.cn: 我不喜欢你夜里这么晚给我打电话。

ex.en: I can't stand his brother.
ex.cn: 他弟弟让我受不了。

senses.def: used to show that sth happened or is true although sth else might have happened to prevent it

ex.en: Her voice was shaking despite all her efforts to control it.
ex.cn: 尽管她竭尽全力控制自己，声音仍然在颤抖。

ex.en: Despite applying for hundreds of jobs, he is still out of work.
ex.cn: 尽管他申请了数百个工作，但仍然在失业中。

ex.en: She was good at physics despite the fact that she found it boring.
ex.cn: 尽管她认为物理枯燥无味，她却学得很好。

ex.en: Politicians have promised to improve road safety. So far, however, little has been achieved.
ex.cn: 政客们承诺要加强道路安全。但是，迄今为止成效微乎其微。

ex.en: Despite clear evidence from road safety studies, no new measures have been introduced.
ex.cn: 尽管道路安全研究已得出确切依据，但仍未实施任何新措施。

ex.en: Politicians have promised to improve road safety. In spite of this / Despite this, little has been achieved so far.
ex.cn: 政客们承诺要加强道路安全。尽管如此，迄今为止成效微乎其微。

senses.def: used to show that sb did not intend to do the thing mentioned

ex.en: He had to laugh despite himself.
ex.cn: 他不想笑，但没法不笑。

senses.def: to steal sth valuable from a place; to make a place less attractive by damaging or destroying it
sad, without much hope
senses.chn: 苦恼的；沮丧的；泄气的；失望的

ex.en: She was becoming increasingly despondent about the way things were going.
ex.cn: 她对事情的发展越来越失望。

senses.def: a ruler with great power, especially one who uses it in a cruel way
senses.chn: 专制统治者；专制君主；暴君

ex.en: an enlightened despot (= one who tries to use his/her power in a good way)
ex.cn: 开明的专制君主

senses.def: the rule of a despot
an attractive house, especially a large one (from the words 'desirable residence')
senses.chn: 理想的房子（desirable residence 的缩略形式）

senses.def: sweet food eaten at the end of a meal

ex.en: What's for dessert?
ex.cn: 餐后甜点吃什么？

ex.en: a rich chocolate dessert
ex.cn: 腻人的巧克力甜点

ex.en: a dessert wine
ex.cn: 餐末甜酒

ex.en: the dessert trolley (= a table on wheels from which you choose your dessert in a restaurant)
ex.cn: （餐厅内）送甜点的手推车

senses.def: a spoon of medium size
the amount a dessertspoon can hold
to make a system, country, government, etc. become less firmly established or successful
senses.chn: 使（制度、国家、政府等）动摇；使不安定；使不稳定

ex.en: Terrorist attacks were threatening to destabilize the government.
ex.cn: 恐怖袭击威胁着政府的稳定。

ex.en: The news had a destabilizing effect on the stock market.
ex.cn: 这消息引起了股市的动荡。

senses.def: a place to which sb/sth is going or being sent

ex.en: popular holiday destinations like the Bahamas
ex.cn: 像巴哈马那样深受大众喜爱的度假胜地

ex.en: to arrive at/reach your destination
ex.cn: 到达目的地

ex.en: Our luggage was checked all the way through to our final destination.
ex.cn: 我们的行李一直被托运到最终目的地。

senses.def: a hotel, store, etc. that people will make a special trip to visit
senses.chn: 作为目的地的（旅馆、商店、饭店等）

senses.def: a wedding held in an exciting or unusual place in a foreign country where all the people who travel to the wedding can also have a holiday/vacation
senses.chn: 度假地婚礼，海外婚礼（在国外度假胜地举行，宾客可兼达旅游的目的）

senses.def: having a future which has been decided or planned at an earlier time, especially by fate
senses.chn: 预定；注定；（尤指）命中注定

ex.en: He was destined for a military career, like his father before him.
ex.cn: 他命中注定要步父亲的后尘，过戎马生涯。

ex.en: We seem destined never to meet.
ex.cn: 我们似乎是命中注定无缘相见。

senses.def: on the way to or intended for a place

ex.en: goods destined for Poland
ex.cn: 运往波兰的货物

senses.def: what happens to sb or what will happen to them in the future, especially things that they cannot change or avoid

ex.en: the destinies of nations
ex.cn: 国家的命运

ex.en: He wants to be in control of his own destiny.
ex.cn: 他想要掌握自己的命运。

senses.def: the power believed to control events
senses.chn: 主宰事物的力量；命运之神

ex.en: I believe there's some force guiding us—call it God, destiny or fate.
ex.cn: 我总认为有某种力量在指引着我们，称之为上帝也罢，天意也罢，还是命运也罢。

ex.en: This ring has always brought me good luck.
ex.cn: 这戒指总是给我带来好运。

ex.en: The results could simply be due to chance.
ex.cn: 这结果可能纯属意外。

ex.en: They met through a series of strange coincidences.
ex.cn: 他们因一连串奇妙的巧合而相遇。

ex.en: Their early arrival was just an accident.
ex.cn: 他们早到仅仅是偶然而已。

ex.en: Fate decreed that she would never reach America.
ex.cn: 命中注定她永远到不了美国。

senses.def: without money, food and the other things necessary for life

ex.en: When he died, his family was left completely destitute.
ex.cn: 他死时家里一贫如洗。

senses.def: people who are destitute

ex.en: This ring has always brought me good luck.
ex.cn: 这戒指总是给我带来好运。

ex.en: The results could simply be due to chance.
ex.cn: 这结果可能纯属意外。

ex.en: They met through a series of strange coincidences.
ex.cn: 他们因一连串奇妙的巧合而相遇。

ex.en: Their early arrival was just an accident.
ex.cn: 他们早到仅仅是偶然而已。

ex.en: Fate decreed that she would never reach America.
ex.cn: 命中注定她永远到不了美国。

ex.en: I believe there's some force guiding us—call it God, destiny or fate.
ex.cn: 我认为有某种力量在指引着我们，称之为上帝也罢，天意也罢，或是命运也罢。

senses.def: lacking sth

ex.en: They seem destitute of ordinary human feelings.
ex.cn: 他们似乎一点人情味都没有。

senses.def: to reduce the amount of goods in a shop/store, the amount of materials kept available for making sth in a factory, etc.
senses.chn: 减少存货；减少库存；去库存

senses.def: to relax after working hard or experiencing stress; to reduce the amount of stress that you experience
senses.chn: 放松；舒缓压力；减少压力

ex.en: De-stress yourself with a relaxing bath.
ex.cn: 舒舒服服洗个澡放松一下。

senses.def: to damage sth so badly that it no longer exists, works, etc.

ex.en: The building was completely destroyed by fire.
ex.cn: 这栋建筑物被大火彻底焚毁了。

ex.en: They've destroyed all the evidence.
ex.cn: 他们销毁了一切证据。

ex.en: Heat gradually destroys vitamin C.
ex.cn: 加热会逐渐破坏维生素 C。

ex.en: You have destroyed my hopes of happiness.
ex.cn: 你毁掉了我得到幸福的希望。

ex.en: Failure was slowly destroying him (= making him less and less confident and happy).
ex.cn: 失败渐渐地把他毁了。

senses.def: to kill an animal deliberately, usually because it is sick or not wanted
senses.chn: （因动物有病或不再需要而）杀死，消灭，人道毁灭

ex.en: The injured horse had to be destroyed.
ex.cn: 这匹马受了伤，只好把它杀了。

senses.def: a small fast ship used in war, for example to protect larger ships
a person or thing that destroys

ex.en: Sugar is the destroyer of healthy teeth.
ex.cn: 糖会危害健康的牙齿。

senses.def: the act of destroying sth; the process of being destroyed

ex.en: the destruction of the rainforests
ex.cn: 对热带雨林的破坏

ex.en: weapons of mass destruction
ex.cn: 大规模杀伤性武器

ex.en: a tidal wave bringing death and destruction in its wake
ex.cn: 带来死亡与破坏的海啸

ex.en: The central argument is that capitalism sows the seeds of its own destruction (= creates the forces that destroy it).
ex.cn: 主要论点是资本主义播下了自我毁灭的种子。

senses.def: causing destruction or damage
senses.chn: 引起破坏（或毁灭）的；破坏（或毁灭）性的

ex.en: the destructive power of modern weapons
ex.cn: 现代武器的毁灭性力量

ex.en: the destructive effects of anxiety
ex.cn: 焦虑的破坏性影响

senses.def: going from one thing to another, without a definite plan and without enthusiasm
senses.chn: 漫无目的的；无条理的；随意的

ex.en: I wandered about in a desultory fashion.
ex.cn: 我漫无目的地四处游荡。

ex.en: a desultory conversation
ex.cn: 漫无边际的谈话

senses.def: detective

ex.en: Det Insp (= Inspector) Cox
ex.cn: 考克斯探长

senses.def: to remove sth from sth larger; to become separated from sth

ex.en: Detach the coupon and return it as soon as possible.
ex.cn: 将表格撕下后尽快寄回。

ex.en: One of the panels had become detached from the main structure.
ex.cn: 一块镶板已从主体结构上脱落。

ex.en: The skis should detach from the boot if you fall.
ex.cn: 要是你跌倒了，滑雪板就会脱离靴子。

senses.def: to leave or separate yourself from sb/sth

ex.en: She detached herself from his embrace.
ex.cn: 她挣脱了他的拥抱。

ex.en: I tried to detach myself from the reality of these terrible events.
ex.cn: 我尽力使自己从这些可怕事件的现实中摆脱出来。

senses.def: to send a group of soldiers, etc. away from the main group, especially to do special duties
that can be taken off

ex.en: a coat with a detachable hood
ex.cn: 带有活风帽的外套

senses.def: not joined to another house on either side
senses.chn: 单独的；独立的；不连接的

senses.def: showing a lack of feeling
senses.chn: 不带感情的；超然的；冷漠的

ex.en: She wanted him to stop being so cool, so detached, so cynical.
ex.cn: 她希望他不再那么冷酷无情，那么无动于衷，那么愤世嫉俗。

senses.def: not influenced by other people or by your own feelings
senses.chn: 客观的；公正的；无偏见的

ex.en: a detached observer
ex.cn: 客观的观察者

senses.def: the state of not being involved in sth in an emotional or personal way

ex.en: He answered with an air of detachment.
ex.cn: 他回答时带着冷漠的神态。

ex.en: She felt a sense of detachment from what was going on.
ex.cn: 她对眼前发生的事感到很超然。

senses.def: the state of not being influenced by other people or by your own feelings

ex.en: In judging these issues a degree of critical detachment is required.
ex.cn: 在裁决这些争议时须要有一定程度的公正判断力。

senses.def: a group of soldiers, ships, etc. sent away from a larger group, especially to do special duties
senses.chn: 分遣队；支队；特遣小分队

ex.en: a detachment of artillery
ex.cn: 炮兵支队

senses.def: the act of detaching sth; the process of being detached from sth

ex.en: to suffer detachment of the retina
ex.cn: 出现视网膜脱落

senses.def: a small individual fact or item; a less important fact or item

ex.en: an expedition planned down to the last detail
ex.cn: 计划详尽的探险

ex.en: He stood still, absorbing every detail of the street.
ex.cn: 他一动不动地站着，不放过街上的每一细微之处。

ex.en: Tell me the main points now; leave the details till later.
ex.cn: 现在把要点告诉我，细节留到以后再说。

senses.def: the small facts or features of sth, when you consider them all together

ex.en: This issue will be discussed in more detail in the next chapter.
ex.cn: 这个问题将在下一章详细论述。

ex.en: The research has been carried out with scrupulous attention to detail.
ex.cn: 研究工作一丝不苟地完成了。

ex.en: He had an eye for detail (= noticed and remembered small details).
ex.cn: 他很善于发现并记住细节。

ex.en: The fine detail of the plan has yet to be worked out.
ex.cn: 这个方案的具体细节尚未制订出来。

senses.def: information about sth
senses.chn: 具体情况；（关于某事物的）资料，消息

ex.en: Please supply the following details: name, age and sex.
ex.cn: 请提供下列资料：姓名、年龄及性别。

ex.en: Further details and booking forms are available on request.
ex.cn: 备有详细资料和订购单以供索取。

ex.en: They didn't give any details about the game.
ex.cn: 他们没有提供这场比赛的具体情况。

ex.en: 'We had a terrible time—' 'Oh, spare me the details (= don't tell me any more).'
ex.cn: “我们倒霉透了…” “唉呀，别给我细说了。”

senses.def: a small part of a picture or painting; the smaller or less important parts of a picture, pattern, etc. when you consider them all together
senses.chn: （照片、绘画等的）细部，局部，次要部分

ex.en: This is a detail from the 1844 Turner painting.
ex.cn: 这是透纳 1844 年画作的局部。

ex.en: a huge picture with a lot of detail in it
ex.cn: 一幅有很多细微之处的巨型画

senses.def: a group of soldiers given special duties
to explain sth fully

ex.en: I can't go into details now; it would take too long.
ex.cn: 我现在不能细说，太费工夫。

senses.def: to give a list of facts or all the available information about sth
senses.chn: 详细列举；详细说明；详述

ex.en: The brochure details all the hotels in the area and their facilities.
ex.cn: 这本小册子详细介绍了当地所有旅馆及其设施。

senses.def: to give an official order to sb, especially a soldier, to do a particular task

ex.en: Several of the men were detailed to form a search party.
ex.cn: 几个人被派组成一个搜索队。

senses.def: to clean a car extremely thoroughly

ex.en: He got work for a while detailing cars.
ex.cn: 他干了一段时间的清洗汽车的工作。

senses.def: giving many details and a lot of information; paying great attention to details

ex.en: a detailed description/analysis/study
ex.cn: 详细的描述／分析／研究

ex.en: He gave me detailed instructions on how to get there.
ex.cn: 他详细地告诉我如何去那里。

senses.def: small details put on a building, piece of clothing, etc., especially for decoration
to keep sb in an official place, such as a police station, a prison or a hospital, and prevent them from leaving

ex.en: One man has been detained for questioning.
ex.cn: 一个男人被拘留审问。

senses.def: to delay sb or prevent them from going somewhere

ex.en: I'm sorry—he'll be late; he's been detained at a meeting.
ex.cn: 对不起，他要晚点儿到，他因会议耽搁了。

senses.def: a person who is kept in prison, usually because of his or her political opinions
senses.chn: （通常因政治主张）被拘留者，被扣押者

senses.def: to discover or notice sth, especially sth that is not easy to see, hear, etc.

ex.en: The tests are designed to detect the disease early.
ex.cn: 这些检查旨在早期查出疾病。

ex.en: an instrument that can detect small amounts of radiation
ex.cn: 能检测微量辐射的仪器

ex.en: Do I detect a note of criticism?
ex.cn: 这好像带有批评的意味吧？

ex.en: The first thing I noticed about the room was the smell.
ex.cn: 我首先注意到的是这屋子里的气味。

ex.en: Please note (that) the office will be closed on Monday.
ex.cn: 请注意办事处星期一将关闭。

ex.en: Note that the prices are inclusive of VAT.
ex.cn: 注意这些价格含增值税。

senses.def: the process of detecting sth; the fact of being detected

ex.en: crime prevention and detection

ex.cn: 去年汽车盗窃案的侦破率仅为 13%。

ex.cn: 他勇敢顽强地与疾病作斗争。

ex.cn: 毁灭性的爆炸／火灾／旋风

ex.cn: 石油泄漏对海洋里的珊瑚礁有着毁灭性影响。

ex.cn: 他在这次事故中受到致命伤害。

ex.cn: 如果这家工厂倒闭，将给当地居民以毁灭性的打击。

ex.cn: 她自己做衣服。

ex.cn: 他画了一栋漂亮的房子。

ex.cn: 汽车发动机出了故障，我们只好停下来。

ex.cn: 海湾危机迅速加剧。

ex.cn: 我们采取行动之前需要有更多时间观察情况的发展。
