senses.def: to break into small parts or pieces and be destroyed

ex.en: The plane disintegrated as it fell into the sea.
ex.cn: 飞机坠入大海时解体了。

senses.def: to become much less strong or united and be gradually destroyed

ex.en: The authority of the central government was rapidly disintegrating.
ex.cn: 中央政府的权威在迅速丧失。

senses.def: to dig up sth, especially a dead body, from the ground
to find sth that has been hidden or lost for a long time
senses.chn: 发现（隐藏或丢失很久的东西）；使显现

senses.def: lack of interest

ex.en: His total disinterest in money puzzled his family.
ex.cn: 他对金钱毫无兴趣使他的家人感到迷惑不解。

senses.def: the fact of not being involved in sth
not influenced by personal feelings, or by the chance of getting some advantage for yourself

ex.en: a disinterested onlooker/spectator
ex.cn: 不偏不倚的旁观者／观众

ex.en: Her advice appeared to be disinterested.
ex.cn: 她的建议似乎是客观公正的。

ex.en: What a disgusting smell!
ex.cn: 这气味真难闻！

ex.en: She could smell his foul breath.
ex.cn: 她闻得到他的口臭。

ex.en: The stew looked revolting.
ex.cn: 这煨菜看上去令人作呕。

senses.def: not interested
senses.chn: 无兴趣的；不关心的；冷漠的

ex.en: He is completely uninterested in politics.
ex.cn: 他对政治毫无兴趣。

ex.en: I am not really interested in politics.
ex.cn: 我并不真正热衷于政治。

ex.en: A solicitor can give you disinterested advice.
ex.cn: 律师可给你公正的忠告。

ex.en: The food was dull and uninteresting.
ex.cn: 食物单调无味。

senses.def: to stop investing money in a company, an industry or a country; to reduce the amount of money invested
the process of reducing the amount of money that you have invested in a particular company, industry, etc.
not communicated or described in a clear or logical way; not connected
senses.chn: 不连贯的；支离破碎的；杂乱无章的

senses.def: a difference between two things that you would expect to be in agreement with each other
a device for storing information on a computer, with a magnetic surface that records information received in electronic form
a device that passes data between a disk and the memory of a computer or from one disk or computer to another
to not like sb/sth

ex.en: Why do you dislike him so much?
ex.cn: 你为什么那么讨厌他呢？

ex.en: He disliked it when she behaved badly in front of his mother.
ex.cn: 他讨厌她在他母亲面前举止失当。

ex.en: I dislike being away from my family.
ex.cn: 我不喜欢同家人分开。

ex.en: Much as she disliked going to funerals (= although she did not like it at all), she knew she had to be there.
ex.cn: 尽管她很不喜欢参加葬礼，但她知道她必须去。

ex.en: He disliked her staying away from home.
ex.cn: 他不愿意让她住在外面。

ex.en: He hates violence in any form.
ex.cn: 他憎恶任何形式的暴力。

senses.def: a feeling of not liking sb/sth

ex.en: He did not try to hide his dislike of his boss.
ex.cn: 他没有掩饰自己对上司的反感。

ex.en: She took an instant dislike to the house and the neighbourhood.
ex.cn: 她一下子就对那栋房子以及街坊邻里产生了反感。

senses.def: a thing that you do not like
senses.chn: 不喜欢的事物；讨厌的事物

ex.en: I've told you all my likes and dislikes.
ex.cn: 我喜欢什么，不喜欢什么，都对你说了。

senses.def: to put a bone out of its normal position in a joint

ex.en: He dislocated his shoulder in the accident.
ex.cn: 他在事故中肩膀脱臼了。

ex.en: a dislocated finger
ex.cn: 脱臼的手指

senses.def: to stop a system, plan etc. from working or continuing in the normal way
senses.chn: 扰乱（制度、计划等）；使混乱；使运转不正常

senses.def: to force or knock sth out of its position

ex.en: The wind dislodged one or two tiles from the roof.
ex.cn: 大风从屋顶上刮下了一两片瓦来。

senses.def: to force sb to leave a place, position or job

ex.en: The rebels have so far failed to dislodge the President.
ex.cn: 叛乱分子至今未能把总统赶下台。

senses.def: not loyal or faithful to your friends, family, country, etc.
senses.chn: （对国家、家庭等）不忠实的，不忠诚的；（对朋友等）不守信义的

ex.en: He was accused of being disloyal to the government.
ex.cn: 他被指控对政府不忠。

senses.def: causing or showing sadness
senses.chn: 忧郁的；凄凉的；惨淡的；阴沉的

ex.en: dismal conditions/surroundings/weather
ex.cn: 悲惨的状况；凄凉的环境；阴沉的天气

senses.def: not skilful or successful; of very low quality
senses.chn: 不熟练的；差劲的；不怎么样的

ex.en: The singer gave a dismal performance of some old songs.
ex.cn: 那歌手唱了几首老歌，唱得也不怎么样。

ex.en: Their recent attempt to increase sales has been a dismal failure.
ex.cn: 他们最近努力提高销售量，全是白费劲。

senses.def: to take apart a machine or structure so that it is in separate pieces

ex.en: I had to dismantle the engine in order to repair it.
ex.cn: 我得把发动机拆开来修理。

ex.en: The steel mill was dismantled piece by piece.
ex.cn: 钢厂已经一块块拆散了。

senses.def: to end an organization or a system gradually in an organized way

ex.en: The government was in the process of dismantling the state-owned industries.
ex.cn: 政府正在着手逐步取消国有企业。

senses.def: a worried, sad feeling after you have received an unpleasant surprise

ex.en: She could not hide her dismay at the result.
ex.cn: 她无法掩饰自己对这一结果的惶恐不安。

ex.en: He looked at her in dismay.
ex.cn: 他诧异地看着她。

ex.en: To her dismay, her name was not on the list.
ex.cn: 使她难过的是，名单上没有她的名字。

ex.en: The news has been greeted with dismay by local business leaders.
ex.cn: 当地商界领袖听到这消息都感到很丧气。

senses.def: to make sb feel shocked and disappointed

ex.en: Their reaction dismayed him.
ex.cn: 他们的反应使他感到惊愕。

senses.def: to cut or tear the dead body of a person or an animal into pieces
to divide a country, an organization, etc. into smaller parts
to decide that sb/sth is not important and not worth thinking or talking about
senses.chn: 不予考虑；摒弃；对…不屑一提

ex.en: I think we can safely dismiss their objections.
ex.cn: 我认为我们对他们的异议完全可以不予理会。

ex.en: Vegetarians are no longer dismissed as cranks.
ex.cn: 素食主义者不再被当作怪人。

ex.en: He dismissed the opinion polls as worthless.
ex.cn: 他认为民意测验毫无用处而不予考虑。

ex.en: The suggestion should not be dismissed out of hand (= without thinking about it).
ex.cn: 这建议不应当直接就被摒弃。

senses.def: to put thoughts or feelings out of your mind
senses.chn: 去除，消除，摒除（思想、感情等）

ex.en: Dismissing her fears, she climbed higher.
ex.cn: 她排除了恐惧，爬得更高了。

ex.en: He dismissed her from his mind.
ex.cn: 他挥去了对她的思念。

senses.def: to officially remove sb from their job

ex.en: She claims she was unfairly dismissed from her post.
ex.cn: 她声称自己被无理免职。

senses.def: to send sb away or allow them to leave
senses.chn: 让（某人）离开；把（某人）打发走；解散

ex.en: At 12 o'clock the class was dismissed.
ex.cn: 12 点下课了。

senses.def: to say that a trial or legal case should not continue, usually because there is not enough evidence

ex.en: The case was dismissed.
ex.cn: 此案已被驳回。

senses.def: to end the innings of a player or team
senses.chn: 使（球员或球队）退场；使出局

senses.def: the act of dismissing sb from their job; an example of this

ex.en: He still hopes to win his claim against unfair dismissal.
ex.cn: 他声称遭无理解雇，仍然希望赢得申诉。

ex.en: The dismissals followed the resignation of the chairman.
ex.cn: 董事长辞职后紧接着就是解雇人员。

senses.def: the failure to consider sth as important
senses.chn: 不予考虑；不予理会；摒弃

ex.en: Her casual dismissal of the threats seemed irresponsible.
ex.cn: 她对这些威胁毫不在乎而不予理会，似乎很不负责任。

senses.def: the act of not allowing a trial or legal case to continue, usually because there is not enough evidence

ex.en: the dismissal of the appeal
ex.cn: 驳回上诉

senses.def: the act of sending sb away or allowing them to leave
the end of the innings of a player or team
showing that you do not believe a person or thing to be important or worth considering

ex.en: a dismissive gesture/tone
ex.cn: 轻蔑的手势／语调

senses.def: to get off a horse, bicycle or motorcycle
failure or refusal to obey
failing or refusing to obey
senses.chn: 不服从的；不顺从的；违抗的

ex.en: a disobedient child
ex.cn: 不听话的孩子

senses.def: to refuse to do what a person, a law, an order, etc. tells you to do; to refuse to obey

ex.en: He was punished for disobeying orders.
ex.cn: 他因违抗命令而受到惩罚。

senses.def: deliberately not helpful

ex.en: a disobliging manner
ex.cn: 不合作的态度

senses.def: an untidy state; a lack of order or organization

ex.en: His financial affairs were in complete disorder.
ex.cn: 他的财务完全是一笔糊涂账。

ex.en: The room was in a state of disorder.
ex.cn: 房间凌乱不堪。

senses.def: violent behaviour of large groups of people

ex.en: an outbreak of rioting and public disorder
ex.cn: 暴乱和公众骚乱的爆发

senses.def: an illness that causes a part of the body to stop functioning correctly

ex.en: a blood/bowel, etc. disorder
ex.cn: 血液病、闹肚子等

ex.en: eating disorders
ex.cn: 进食障碍

ex.en: He was suffering from some form of psychiatric disorder.
ex.cn: 他患有某种类型的精神错乱。

ex.en: He suffers from a rare blood disease.
ex.cn: 他患有一种罕见的血液病。

ex.en: She died after a long illness.
ex.cn: 她久病不愈而亡。

ex.en: a rare disorder of the liver
ex.cn: 一种罕见的肝病

senses.def: showing a lack of order or control

ex.en: disordered hair
ex.cn: 乱七八糟的头发

ex.en: a disordered state
ex.cn: 混乱状态

senses.def: suffering from a mental or physical disorder

ex.en: emotionally disordered children
ex.cn: 有情绪障碍的孩子

senses.def: showing lack of control; publicly violent or noisy
senses.chn: 难驾驭的；目无法纪的；骚乱的

ex.en: disorderly conduct
ex.cn: 目无法纪的行为

ex.en: They were arrested for being drunk and disorderly.
ex.cn: 他们因醉酒滋事而被捕。

senses.def: untidy

ex.en: newspapers in a disorderly pile by the door
ex.cn: 门边乱七八糟的一堆报纸

senses.def: a brothel (= place where people pay to have sex)
badly planned; not able to plan or organize well
senses.chn: 计划不周的；缺乏组织的；杂乱无章的

ex.en: It was a hectic disorganized weekend.
ex.cn: 这个周末忙乱得一塌糊涂。

ex.en: She's so disorganized.
ex.cn: 她太缺乏条理了。

senses.def: to make sb unable to recognize where they are or where they should go

ex.en: The darkness had disorientated him.
ex.cn: 黑暗使他迷失了方向。

senses.def: to make sb feel confused
senses.chn: 使迷惘；使不知所措；使无所适从

ex.en: Ex-soldiers can be disorientated by the transition to civilian life.
ex.cn: 退伍军人转而去过平民生活可能会感到茫然。

senses.def: to decide that you no longer want to be connected with or responsible for sb/sth
senses.chn: 与…断绝关系；否认对…的责任

ex.en: Her family disowned her for marrying a foreigner.
ex.cn: 她的家人因她嫁给了外国人而与她断绝关系。

senses.def: to suggest that sb/sth is not important or valuable

ex.en: I don't mean to disparage your achievements.
ex.cn: 我并不想贬低你的成就。

senses.def: made up of parts or people that are very different from each other
senses.chn: 由不同的人（或事物）组成的

ex.en: a disparate group of individuals
ex.cn: 三教九流的一帮人

senses.def: so different from each other that they cannot be compared or cannot work together
senses.chn: 迥然不同的；无法比较的；不相干的

senses.def: a difference, especially one connected with unfair treatment
senses.chn: （尤指因不公正对待引起的）不同，不等，差异，悬殊

ex.en: the wide disparity between rich and poor
ex.cn: 贫富悬殊

senses.def: not influenced by emotion
senses.chn: 不动感情的；冷静的；不带偏见的

ex.en: taking a calm, dispassionate view of the situation
ex.cn: 以冷静、客观公正的观点看待形势

ex.en: a dispassionate observer
ex.cn: 冷静的旁观者

senses.def: to send sb/sth somewhere, especially for a special purpose

ex.en: Troops have been dispatched to the area.
ex.cn: 部队已派往那个地区。

ex.en: A courier was dispatched to collect the documents.
ex.cn: 已派快递员去取文件。

senses.def: to send a letter, package or message somewhere
senses.chn: 发出，发送（邮件、包裹、信息）

ex.en: Goods are dispatched within 24 hours of your order reaching us.
ex.cn: 订单到达我方 24 小时内发货。

senses.def: to deal or finish with sb/sth quickly and completely
senses.chn: 迅速处理；迅速办妥；迅速完成

ex.en: He dispatched the younger player in straight sets.
ex.cn: 他连续几盘迅速击败了那位比他年轻的选手。

senses.def: to kill a person or an animal
the act of sending sb/sth somewhere

ex.en: More food supplies are ready for immediate dispatch.
ex.cn: 更多的食品供应已备妥即刻发运。

senses.def: a message or report sent quickly from one military officer to another or between government officials
senses.chn: （军事人员或政府官员之间的）急件，快信

senses.def: a report sent to a newspaper by a journalist who is working in a foreign country
senses.chn: （驻外国记者发给报刊的）新闻报道，电讯

ex.en: dispatches from the war zone
ex.cn: 从战区发来的报道

senses.def: quickly and efficiently
a container for carrying official documents
a box on a table in the centre of the House of Commons in the British parliament, which ministers stand next to when they speak
senses.chn: 下议院案头文箱（置于英国下议院中央的桌子上，大臣站在桌边发言）

senses.def: a person whose job is to see that trains, buses, planes, etc. leave on time
senses.chn: （火车、公交车、飞机等的）调度员

senses.def: a person whose job is to send emergency vehicles to where they are needed
a person whose job is to carry messages or packages by motorcycle
to make sth, especially a feeling or belief, go away or disappear
senses.chn: 驱散，消除（尤指感觉或信仰）

ex.en: His speech dispelled any fears about his health.
ex.cn: 他的发言消除了人们对他身体健康的担心。

senses.def: not necessary; that can be got rid of
senses.chn: 不必要；可有可无；不重要

ex.en: They looked on music and art lessons as dispensable.
ex.cn: 他们认为音乐课和美术课是可有可无的。

senses.def: a place in a hospital, shop/store, etc. where medicines are prepared for patients
a place where patients are treated, especially one run by a charity
senses.chn: （尤指慈善机构的）医务室，诊所

senses.def: special permission, especially from a religious leader, to do sth that is not usually allowed or legal
senses.chn: （尤指宗教领袖给予的）豁免，宽免

ex.en: She needed a special dispensation to remarry.
ex.cn: 她需要得到特准才能再婚。

ex.en: The sport's ruling body gave him dispensation to compete in national competitions.
ex.cn: 体育运动管理机构特许他参加全国性的体育比赛。

senses.def: the act or process of providing sth, especially by sb in authority

ex.en: the dispensation of justice
ex.cn: 执法

senses.def: a political or religious system that operates in a country at a particular time
senses.chn: （某一国家某一时期的政治、宗教）制度

senses.def: to give out sth to people

ex.en: The machine dispenses a range of drinks and snacks.
ex.cn: 这台机器发售各种饮料和小吃。

senses.def: to provide sth, especially a service, for people

ex.en: The organization dispenses free health care to the poor.
ex.cn: 这个机构为穷人提供免费医疗。

ex.en: to dispense justice/advice
ex.cn: 执法；给予忠告

senses.def: to prepare medicine and give it to people, as a job

ex.en: to dispense a prescription
ex.cn: 按处方配药

ex.en: to dispense medicine
ex.cn: 发药

ex.en: a dispensing chemist
ex.cn: 药剂师

senses.def: to stop using sb/sth because you no longer need them or it

ex.en: Debit cards dispense with the need for cash altogether.
ex.cn: 有借记卡就完全不需要用现金了。

ex.en: I think we can dispense with the formalities (= speak openly and naturally to each other).
ex.cn: 我想我们就免去客套吧。

senses.def: a machine or container holding money, drinks, paper towels, etc. that you can obtain quickly, for example by pulling a handle or pressing buttons
senses.chn: 自动取款机；自动售货机；自动取物器

ex.en: a soap dispenser
ex.cn: 皂液瓶

senses.def: the process of sending sb/sth in different directions; the process of spreading sth over a wide area

ex.en: police trained in crowd dispersal
ex.cn: 在疏散人群方面受过训练的警察

ex.en: the dispersal of seeds
ex.cn: 种子的传播

senses.def: to move apart and go away in different directions; to make sb/sth do this

ex.en: The fog began to disperse.
ex.cn: 雾开始散了。

ex.en: The crowd dispersed quickly.
ex.cn: 人群很快便散开了。

ex.en: Police dispersed the protesters with tear gas.
ex.cn: 警察用催泪瓦斯驱散了抗议者。

senses.def: to spread or to make sth spread over a wide area

ex.en: The seeds are dispersed by the wind.
ex.cn: 这些种子由风传播。

senses.def: the process by which people or things are spread over a wide area
having no hope or enthusiasm
senses.chn: 气馁的；垂头丧气的；心灰意懒的

ex.en: She looked tired and dispirited.
ex.cn: 她显得疲倦而且神情沮丧。

senses.def: making sb lose their hope or enthusiasm
senses.chn: 令人沮丧的；使人气馁的

ex.en: a dispiriting experience/failure
ex.cn: 令人沮丧的经历／失败

senses.def: to take the place of sb/sth

ex.en: Gradually factory workers have been displaced by machines.
ex.cn: 工厂的工人已逐渐被机器取代。

ex.en: The ship displaces 58 000 tonnes (= as a way of measuring its size).
ex.cn: 这艘轮船的排水量为 58 000 吨。

senses.def: to force people to move away from their home to another place

ex.en: Around 10 000 people have been displaced by the fighting.
ex.cn: 大约 1 万人因战争而背井离乡。

senses.def: to move sth from its usual position

ex.en: Check for roof tiles that have been displaced by the wind.
ex.cn: 检查一下屋顶上是否有瓦被风刮得挪了位。

senses.def: to remove sb from a job or position

ex.en: displaced workers
ex.cn: 辞退的工人

senses.def: a refugee
the act of displacing sb/sth; the process of being displaced

ex.en: the largest displacement of civilian population since World War Two
ex.cn: 自第二次世界大战以来最大规模的平民迁移

senses.def: the amount of a liquid moved out of place by sth floating or put in it, especially a ship floating in water

ex.en: a ship with a displacement of 10 000 tonnes
ex.cn: 排水量为 1 万吨的船

senses.def: things that you do in order to avoid doing what you are supposed to be doing
behaviour in animals or humans that seems to have no connection with the situation in which it is performed, resulting from two conflicting urges
senses.chn: 替换活动，移代活动（人或动物由于对立的驱力而表现出不相宜的行为）

senses.def: to put sth in a place where people can see it easily; to show sth to people

ex.en: The exhibition gives local artists an opportunity to display their work.
ex.cn: 这次展览为当地艺术家提供了展示自己作品的机会。

ex.en: She displayed her bruises for all to see.
ex.cn: 她将自己身上青一块紫一块的伤痕露出来给大家看。

senses.def: to show signs of sth, especially a quality or feeling
senses.chn: 显示，显露，表现（尤指特性或情感）

ex.en: I have rarely seen her display any sign of emotion.
ex.cn: 我难得见到她将喜怒形于色。

ex.en: These statistics display a definite trend.
ex.cn: 这些统计数据表现出一种明显的趋势。

senses.def: to show information

ex.en: The screen will display the username in the top right-hand corner.
ex.cn: 屏幕将在右上角显示用户名称。

ex.en: This column displays the title of the mail message.
ex.cn: 这一栏显示邮件标题。

senses.def: to show a special pattern of behaviour that is intended to attract a female bird or animal
an arrangement of things in a public place to inform or entertain people or advertise sth for sale

ex.en: a beautiful floral display outside the Town Hall
ex.cn: 市政厅外陈设的美丽的花

ex.en: a window display
ex.cn: 橱窗陈列

ex.en: a display cabinet
ex.cn: 陈列柜

senses.def: an act of performing a skill or of showing sth happening, in order to entertain

ex.en: a firework display
ex.cn: 烟火表演

ex.en: a breathtaking display of aerobatics
ex.cn: 惊险的特技飞行表演

senses.def: an occasion when you show a particular quality, feeling or ability by the way that you behave
senses.chn: （特性、情感或能力的）显示，表现，表露

ex.en: a display of affection/strength/wealth
ex.cn: 爱的流露；实力的显示；财富的炫耀

senses.def: the words, pictures, etc. shown on a computer screen

ex.en: a high resolution colour display
ex.cn: 高分辨率彩色显示

senses.def: put in a place where people can look at it

ex.en: Designs for the new sports hall are on display in the library.
ex.cn: 新体育馆的设计图展示在图书馆里。

ex.en: to put sth on temporary/permanent display
ex.cn: 临时／长期展出某物

senses.def: a box in a shop/store for displaying goods, especially goods whose prices have been reduced
senses.chn: （商店）陈列柜；（尤指）减价货品柜

senses.def: to make sb feel upset, annoyed or not satisfied
the feeling of being upset and annoyed

ex.en: She made no attempt to hide her displeasure at the prospect.
ex.cn: 她没有掩饰自己对前景并不乐观。

senses.def: to enjoy yourself by doing sth active
made to be thrown away after use
senses.chn: 用后即丢弃的；一次性的

ex.en: disposable gloves/razors
ex.cn: 一次性手套／剃刀

ex.en: disposable nappies
ex.cn: 一次性尿布

ex.en: disposable diapers
ex.cn: 一次性尿布

senses.def: available for use
senses.chn: 可动用的；可自由支配的

ex.en: disposable assets/capital/resources
ex.cn: 可支配资产／资本／资源

ex.en: a person's disposable income (= money they are free to spend after paying taxes, etc.)
ex.cn: 个人可支配收入

senses.def: items such as nappies/ diapers and contact lenses that are designed to be thrown away after use
senses.chn: 用后即丢弃的物品，一次性物品（如尿布、隐形眼镜片）

senses.def: the act of getting rid of sth

ex.en: a bomb disposal squad
ex.cn: 炸弹清除小组

ex.en: sewage disposal systems
ex.cn: 污水处理系统

ex.en: the disposal of nuclear waste
ex.cn: 核废料的处理

senses.def: the sale of part of a business, property, etc.
available for use as you prefer/sb prefers
senses.chn: 任某人处理；供某人任意使用；由某人自行支配

ex.en: He will have a car at his disposal for the whole month.
ex.cn: 他将有一辆汽车归他使用一个月。

ex.en: Well, I'm at your disposal (= I am ready to help you in any way I can).
ex.cn: 好吧，我听候你的吩咐。

senses.def: to arrange things or people in a particular way or position
to make sb behave in a particular way
senses.chn: 使倾向于；使有意于；使易于

ex.en: a drug that disposes the patient towards sleep
ex.cn: 使病人想睡觉的药

senses.def: to get rid of sb/sth that you do not want or cannot keep

ex.en: the difficulties of disposing of nuclear waste
ex.cn: 处理核废料的困难

ex.en: to dispose of stolen property
ex.cn: 销赃

senses.def: to deal with a problem, question or threat successfully

ex.en: That seems to have disposed of most of their arguments.
ex.cn: 这样就似乎把他们的大部分论点都驳倒了。

senses.def: to defeat or kill sb

ex.en: It took her a mere 20 minutes to dispose of her opponent.
ex.cn: 她仅用了 20 分钟就击败了对手。

senses.def: willing or prepared to do sth

ex.en: I'm not disposed to argue.
ex.cn: 我无意争论。

ex.en: You're most welcome to join us if you feel so disposed.
ex.cn: 你若有意参加，我们非常欢迎。

ex.en: being naturally disposed towards speculation
ex.cn: 天生喜欢猜测

senses.def: having a good/bad opinion of a person or thing

ex.en: She seems favourably disposed to the move.
ex.cn: 她似乎对这一行动持赞同态度。

senses.def: the natural qualities of a person's character

ex.en: to have a cheerful disposition
ex.cn: 性情开朗

ex.en: people of a nervous disposition
ex.cn: 神经质的人

senses.def: a tendency to behave in a particular way

ex.en: to have/show a disposition towards violence
ex.cn: 有／表现出暴力倾向

senses.def: the way sth is placed or arranged
a formal act of giving property or money to sb
to take sb's property, land or house away from them
senses.chn: 剥夺，夺去（某人的财产、土地、房屋）

senses.def: the state of two things not being at an equally high or low level; an example of this
senses.chn: 不相称；不均衡；不成比例；不相称（或不均衡、不成比例）的东西

ex.en: the disproportion between the extra responsibilities and the small salary increase
ex.cn: 额外的责任与小幅增加的薪金之间的不相称

ex.en: a profession with a high disproportion of male to female employees
ex.cn: 男女雇员比例严重失调的职业

senses.def: too large or too small when compared with sth else
senses.chn: 不成比例的；不相称的；太大（或太小）的

ex.en: The area contains a disproportionate number of young middle-class families.
ex.cn: 此地年轻的中产阶级家庭特别多。

senses.def: to show that sth is wrong or false

ex.en: The theory has now been disproved.
ex.cn: 这一理论现已证明是错误的。

senses.def: that can or should be questioned or argued about
senses.chn: 可质疑的；有争辩余地的；可商榷的

senses.def: a discussion about sth that people cannot agree on
an argument or a disagreement between two people, groups or countries; discussion about a subject where there is disagreement

ex.en: a dispute between the two countries about the border
ex.cn: 两国间的边界争端

ex.en: the latest dispute over fishing rights
ex.cn: 最近关于捕鱼权的争端

ex.en: industrial/pay disputes
ex.cn: 劳资／工资纠纷

ex.en: The union is in dispute with management over working hours.
ex.cn: 工会与资方在工时问题上发生纠纷。

ex.en: The cause of the accident was still in dispute (= being argued about).
ex.cn: 事故的原因仍在争议之中。

ex.en: The matter was settled beyond dispute by the court judgment (= it could no longer be argued about).
ex.cn: 此问题已由法庭判决，不容争辩。

senses.def: to question whether sth is true and valid
senses.chn: 对…提出质询；对…表示异议（或怀疑）

ex.en: These figures have been disputed.
ex.cn: 有人对这些数字提出了质疑。

ex.en: to dispute a decision/claim
ex.cn: 对某项决定／权利要求提出异议

ex.en: The family wanted to dispute the will.
ex.cn: 家属想对遗嘱提出质疑。

ex.en: No one is disputing that there is a problem.
ex.cn: 没有人否认现在有问题。

ex.en: It is disputed whether the law applies in this case.
ex.cn: 有人对这项法律是否适用于这个案例提出质疑。

senses.def: to argue or disagree strongly with sb about sth, especially about who owns sth

ex.en: disputed territory
ex.cn: 有争议的领土

ex.en: The issue remains hotly disputed.
ex.cn: 这个问题至今仍在激烈的辩论中。

senses.def: to fight to get control of sth or to win sth

ex.en: On the last lap three runners were disputing the lead.
ex.cn: 在最后一圈，三名赛跑者在争夺领先地位。

senses.def: to prevent sb from doing sth because they have broken a rule or are not suitable
senses.chn: 使不合格；使不适合；取消（某人）的资格

ex.en: He was disqualified from the competition for using drugs.
ex.cn: 他因使用违禁药被取消比赛资格。

ex.en: You could be disqualified from driving for up to three years.
ex.cn: 你可能会被取消驾驶资格达三年之久。

ex.en: A heart condition disqualified him for military service.
ex.cn: 心脏病使他不符合服兵役的条件。

senses.def: feelings of worry and unhappiness about sth

ex.en: There is considerable public disquiet about the safety of the new trains.
ex.cn: 公众对新型列车的安全深感忧虑。

senses.def: causing worry and unhappiness
senses.chn: 令人不安的；使人忧虑的

senses.def: a long complicated speech or written report on a particular subject
senses.chn: 专题演讲；专题论文；专题报告

senses.def: to not consider sth; to treat sth as unimportant

ex.en: The board completely disregarded my recommendations.
ex.cn: 董事会完全无视我的建议。

ex.en: Safety rules were disregarded.
ex.cn: 安全规定被忽视了。

senses.def: the act of treating sb/sth as unimportant and not caring about them/it

ex.en: She shows a total disregard for other people's feelings.
ex.cn: 她丝毫不顾及别人的感受。

senses.def: a building, road, etc. that is in a state of disrepair has not been taken care of and is broken or in bad condition

ex.en: The station quickly fell into disrepair after it was closed.
ex.cn: 车站关闭后很快便破败不堪。

senses.def: that people consider to be dishonest and bad
senses.chn: 名声不好的；不名誉的；不光彩的

ex.en: She spent the evening with her disreputable brother Stefan.
ex.cn: 她同声名狼藉的弟弟斯蒂芬一起度过了这个晚上。

ex.en: a disreputable area of the city
ex.cn: 城里名声不好的地方

senses.def: the fact that sb/sth loses the respect of other people

ex.en: The players' behaviour on the field is likely to bring the game into disrepute.
ex.cn: 球员在赛场上的表现很可能使这场比赛臭名远扬。

senses.def: a lack of respect for sb/sth

ex.en: disrespect for the law/the dead
ex.cn: 藐视法律；对死者的不敬

ex.en: No disrespect intended, sir. It was just a joke.
ex.cn: 先生，绝无不敬之意。这不过是个玩笑而已。

senses.def: to speak about or treat sb/sth without respect

ex.en: They were accused of disrespecting the country's flag.
ex.cn: 他们被控亵渎国旗。

ex.en: They were accused of treating the country's flag with disrespect.
ex.cn: 他们被控亵渎国旗。

senses.def: to take off your or sb else's clothes; to take off clothes worn for an official ceremony
senses.chn: 脱去（某人）的衣服；脱衣服；脱去制服（或礼服）

ex.en: She went behind the screen to disrobe.
ex.cn: 她到屏风后面去换装。

senses.def: to make it difficult for sth to continue in the normal way

ex.en: Demonstrators succeeded in disrupting the meeting.
ex.cn: 示威者成功地扰乱了会议。

ex.en: Bus services will be disrupted tomorrow because of the bridge closure.
ex.cn: 明日公共汽车服务将因大桥停止通行而受影响。

senses.def: causing problems, noise, etc. so that sth cannot continue normally
senses.chn: 引起混乱的；扰乱性的；破坏性的

ex.en: She had a disruptive influence on the rest of the class.
ex.cn: 她搅扰了班上其他学生。

senses.def: a feeling that you are not pleased and satisfied

ex.en: Many people have expressed their dissatisfaction with the arrangement.
ex.cn: 许多人表示对这一安排不满。

senses.def: something that causes you to feel dissatisfied
not happy or satisfied with sb/sth
senses.chn: （对…）不满的，不高兴的，不满意的

ex.en: dissatisfied customers
ex.cn: 不满的顾客

ex.en: If you are dissatisfied with our service, please write to the manager.
ex.cn: 对于服务如有不满，请函告经理。

senses.def: to cut up a dead person, animal or plant in order to study it
to study sth closely and/or discuss it in great detail
senses.chn: 仔细研究；详细评论；剖析

ex.en: Her latest novel was dissected by the critics.
ex.cn: 评论家对她最近出版的一部小说作了详细剖析。

senses.def: to divide sth into smaller pieces, areas, etc.

ex.en: The city is dissected by a network of old canals.
ex.cn: 古老的运河网将这座城市分割开来。

senses.def: to hide your real feelings or intentions, often by pretending to have different ones
senses.chn: 掩盖，掩饰（真实感情或意图）

ex.en: She was a very honest person who was incapable of dissembling.
ex.cn: 她是一个非常诚实的人，不会伪装。

senses.def: to spread information, knowledge, etc. so that it reaches many people

ex.en: Their findings have been widely disseminated.
ex.cn: 他们的研究成果已经广为传播。

senses.def: disagreement between people or within a group
senses.chn: 意见分歧；（派性）纷争；不和

ex.en: dissension within the government
ex.cn: 政府内部的意见分歧

senses.def: the fact of having or expressing opinions that are different from those that are officially accepted

ex.en: political/religious dissent
ex.cn: 政治观点／宗教信仰上的分歧

senses.def: a judge's statement giving reasons why he or she disagrees with a decision made by the other judges in a court case
senses.chn: （诉讼案中某法官对其他法官判决的）异议，不同意见

senses.def: to have or express opinions that are different from those that are officially accepted

ex.en: Only two ministers dissented from the official view.
ex.cn: 只有两位部长与官方持不同的观点。

senses.def: a person who does not agree with opinions that are officially or generally accepted
senses.chn: （对官方或普遍认可的意见）持异议者，持不同意见者

senses.def: a long piece of writing on a particular subject, especially one written for a university degree
senses.chn: 专题论文；（尤指）学位论文

senses.def: to do sth that harms sb and the opinion that other people have of them
a person who strongly disagrees with and criticizes their government, especially in a country where this kind of action is dangerous
not the same
senses.chn: 不一样的；不同的；不相似的

ex.en: These wines are not dissimilar (= are similar).
ex.cn: 这些葡萄酒都差不多。

senses.def: to hide your real feelings or intentions, often by pretending to have different ones
senses.chn: 掩盖，掩饰（真实感情或意图）

senses.def: to gradually become or make sth become weaker until it disappears

ex.en: Eventually, his anger dissipated.
ex.cn: 他的愤怒终于平息了。

ex.en: Her laughter soon dissipated the tension in the air.
ex.cn: 她的笑声很快消除了紧张气氛。

senses.def: to waste sth, such as time or money, especially by not planning the best way of using it
senses.chn: 挥霍，浪费，消磨（时间、金钱等）

senses.def: enjoying activities that are harmful such as drinking too much alcohol
the process of disappearing or of making sth disappear

ex.en: the dissipation of energy in the form of heat
ex.cn: 以热量形式耗散的能量

senses.def: the act of wasting money or spending money until there is none left

ex.en: concerns about the dissipation of the country's wealth
ex.cn: 对挥霍国家财富的忧虑

senses.def: behaviour which is enjoyable but has a harmful effect on you
to say or do sth to show that you are not connected with or do not support sb/sth; to make it clear that sth is not connected with a particular plan, action, etc.
senses.chn: 否认同…有关系；声明不支持；表明无关

ex.en: He tried to dissociate himself from the party's more extreme views.
ex.cn: 他极力表明自己并不赞成该党较为偏激的观点。

ex.en: They were determined to dissociate the UN from any agreement to impose sanctions.
ex.cn: 他们决心阻止联合国同意实施制裁。

senses.def: to think of two people or things as separate and not connected with each other
senses.chn: 把…分开（或看作是无关联的）

ex.en: She tried to dissociate the two events in her mind.
ex.cn: 她试图从思想上将这两件事分开。

senses.def: enjoying immoral activities and not caring about behaving in a morally acceptable way
senses.chn: 放纵的；放荡的；道德沦丧的

senses.def: the act of officially ending a marriage, a business agreement or a parliament
senses.chn: （婚姻关系的）解除；（商业协议的）终止；（议会的）解散

senses.def: the process in which sth gradually disappears

ex.en: the dissolution of barriers of class and race
ex.cn: 阶级和种族隔阂的消除

senses.def: the act of breaking up an organization, etc.
to mix with a liquid and become part of it

ex.en: Salt dissolves in water.
ex.cn: 盐溶解于水。

ex.en: Heat gently until the sugar dissolves.
ex.cn: 慢慢加热直到糖溶解为止。

senses.def: to make a solid become part of a liquid

ex.en: Dissolve the tablet in water.
ex.cn: 把药片溶于水中。

senses.def: to officially end a marriage, business agreement or parliament
senses.chn: 解除（婚姻关系）；终止（商业协议）；解散（议会）

ex.en: Their marriage was dissolved in 1999.
ex.cn: 他们于 1999 年解除了婚姻关系。

ex.en: The election was announced and parliament was dissolved.
ex.cn: 宣布选举后，议会解散了。

senses.def: to disappear; to make sth disappear

ex.en: When the ambulance had gone, the crowd dissolved.
ex.cn: 救护车离开后人群便散开了。

ex.en: His calm response dissolved her anger.
ex.cn: 他平静的回答化解了她的怒气。

senses.def: to suddenly start laughing, crying, etc.
senses.chn: 禁不住（笑起来或哭起来等）

ex.en: When the teacher looked up, the children dissolved into giggles.
ex.cn: 教师抬头看时，孩子们不禁咯咯地笑起来。

ex.en: Every time she heard his name, she dissolved into tears.
ex.cn: 每当听到他的名字时，她都禁不住泪流满面。

senses.def: to remove or destroy sth, especially by a chemical process; to be destroyed in this way
senses.chn: （尤以化学手段）除去，毁掉；（被）破坏

ex.en: a new detergent that dissolves stains
ex.cn: 新型去污洗涤剂

ex.en: All the original calcium had dissolved away.
ex.cn: 所有原始钙都被破坏了。

senses.def: a combination of musical notes that do not sound pleasant together
lack of agreement
to persuade sb not to do sth

ex.en: I tried to dissuade him from giving up his job.
ex.cn: 我劝过他不要放弃自己的工作。

ex.en: They were going to set off in the fog, but were dissuaded.
ex.cn: 他们原打算在雾中出发，但被劝阻了。

senses.def: a stick that was used in the past for holding wool when it was spun by hand
senses.chn: （旧时手工纺纱用的）纺纱杆，绕线杆

senses.def: on the woman's side of the family
located away from the centre of the body or at the far end of sth

ex.en: the distal end of the tibia
ex.cn: 胫骨远端

senses.def: the amount of space between two places or things

ex.en: a short/long distance
ex.cn: 短距离；长距离

ex.en: the distance of the earth from the sun
ex.cn: 太阳到地球的距离

ex.en: a distance of 200 kilometres
ex.cn: 200 公里的距离

ex.en: What's the distance between New York City and Boston/from New York City to Boston?
ex.cn: 纽约市离波士顿有多远？

ex.en: In the US, distance is measured in miles.
ex.cn: 在美国，测量距离以英里作单位。

ex.en: The beach is within walking distance of my house (= you can walk there easily).
ex.cn: 海滩离我家很近，走几步路就到了。

senses.def: being far away in space or in time
senses.chn: （空间的）遥远；（时间的）久远，间隔

ex.en: Distance is no problem on the Internet.
ex.cn: 在互联网上距离根本不是问题。

senses.def: a point that is a particular amount of space away from sth else

ex.en: You'll never get the ball in from that distance.
ex.cn: 你绝不可能从那么远的地方把球投进去。

senses.def: a difference or lack of a connection between two things

ex.en: The distance between fashion and art remains as great as ever.
ex.cn: 时尚与艺术之间的差别之大依然如故。

ex.en: The government is keen to put some distance between itself and these events (= show that there is no connection between them).
ex.cn: 政府急于表示自身与这些事件无关。

ex.en: Eddie is, by some distance (= by a great amount), the funniest character in the show.
ex.cn: 埃迪显然是这个节目中最有趣的人物。

senses.def: a situation in which there is a lack of friendly feelings or of a close relationship between two people or groups of people

ex.en: The coldness and distance in her voice took me by surprise.
ex.cn: 她话语中透出的冷淡和疏远使我感到意外。

senses.def: from a place or time that is not near; from far away
senses.chn: 离一段距离；从远处；遥远地；久远地

ex.en: She had loved him at a distance for years.
ex.cn: 她曾经暗恋他好多年。

senses.def: to continue playing in a competition or sports contest until the end

ex.en: Nobody thought he would last 15 rounds, but he went the full distance.
ex.cn: 谁都以为他坚持不到 15 个回合，可是他却打完了全场。

senses.def: far away but still able to be seen or heard

ex.en: We saw lights in the distance.
ex.cn: 我们看到了远处的点点灯光。

ex.en: Alice stood staring into the distance.
ex.cn: 艾丽斯站着凝视远方。

senses.def: to refuse to be friendly with sb; to not let sb be friendly towards you
senses.chn: 对…冷淡；同…疏远；与…保持一定距离

senses.def: to make sure you are not too near sb/sth
to avoid getting too friendly or involved with a person, group, etc.
senses.chn: 疏远；避免（与…）亲近；避免介入

ex.en: She was warned to keep her distance from Charles if she didn't want to get hurt.
ex.cn: 有人告诫她说，如果不想受到伤害，就离查尔斯远一点。

senses.def: very close
very close
near enough to be reached or attacked easily; near enough to reach or attack sth easily
senses.chn: 近在咫尺；在攻击距离之内

ex.en: The beach is within striking distance.
ex.cn: 海滩近在咫尺。

ex.en: The cat was now within striking distance of the duck.
ex.cn: 此时，猫就在可攻击鸭子的距离内。

senses.def: to become, or to make sb/sth become, less involved or connected with sb/sth

ex.en: When he retired, he tried to distance himself from politics.
ex.cn: 退休后，他便尽量使自己置身于政治之外。

ex.en: It's not always easy for nurses to distance themselves emotionally.
ex.cn: 对护士来说，使自己不动感情有时并不容易。

senses.def: a system of education in which people study at home with the help of special Internet sites and television and radio programmes, and send or email work to their teachers
far away in space or time

ex.en: the distant sound of music
ex.cn: 远处的音乐声

ex.en: distant stars/planets
ex.cn: 遥远的恒星／行星

ex.en: The time we spent together is now a distant memory.
ex.cn: 我们一起度过的时光现已成为久远的记忆。

ex.en: The airport was about 20 kilometres distant.
ex.cn: 机场在大约 20 公里远的地方。

ex.en: a star 30 000 light years distant from the Earth
ex.cn: 离地球 3 万光年远的恒星

ex.en: Peace was just a distant hope (= not very likely).
ex.cn: 和平只是遥不可及的希望而已。

senses.def: not like sth else

ex.en: Their life seemed utterly distant from his own.
ex.cn: 他们的生活与他自己的生活似乎完全不同。

senses.def: related to you but not closely

ex.en: a distant cousin/aunt/relative
ex.cn: 远房堂兄弟／姑母／亲戚

senses.def: not friendly; not wanting a close relationship with sb
senses.chn: 不友好的；冷淡的；疏远的

ex.en: Pat sounded very cold and distant on the phone.
ex.cn: 从电话里听起来帕特非常冷淡和疏远。

senses.def: not paying attention to sth but thinking about sth completely different
senses.chn: 心不在焉的；恍惚的；出神的

ex.en: There was a distant look in her eyes; her mind was obviously on something else.
ex.cn: 她眼神恍惚，显然心里在想着别的什么事儿。

senses.def: a long time ago

ex.en: stories from the distant past
ex.cn: 很久以前的故事

senses.def: not a long time in the future but fairly soon
a feeling that sb/sth is unpleasant or offensive

ex.en: He looked around the filthy room in distaste.
ex.cn: 他厌恶地环视着这肮脏的房间。

ex.en: a distaste for politics of any sort
ex.cn: 对任何形式的政治的反感

senses.def: unpleasant or offensive
senses.chn: 使人不愉快的；令人反感的；讨厌的

senses.def: an infectious disease of animals, especially cats and dogs, that causes fever and coughing
senses.chn: 瘟热（动物，尤指猫、狗的传染病）

senses.def: a type of paint that is mixed with water and used on walls
senses.chn: 刷墙水粉；水浆涂料；水性墙漆

senses.def: to swell or make sth swell because of pressure from inside

ex.en: starving children with huge distended bellies
ex.cn: 鼓着浮肿肚子的挨饿儿童

senses.def: to make a liquid pure by heating it until it becomes a gas, then cooling it and collecting the drops of liquid that form

ex.en: to distil fresh water from sea water
ex.cn: 用蒸馏法从海水中提取淡水

ex.en: distilled water
ex.cn: 蒸馏水

senses.def: to make sth such as a strong alcoholic drink in this way

ex.en: The factory distils and bottles whisky.
ex.cn: 这家工厂用蒸馏法酿造瓶装威士忌酒。

senses.def: to get the essential meaning or ideas from thoughts, information, experiences, etc.

ex.en: The notes I made on my travels were distilled into a book.
ex.cn: 我的旅行笔记精选汇编成了一本书。

senses.def: a substance which is formed by distilling a liquid
a person or company that produces spirits (= strong alcoholic drinks) such as whisky by distilling them
senses.chn: （采用蒸馏法的）酿酒者，酿酒公司

senses.def: a factory where strong alcoholic drink is made by the process of distilling
easily or clearly heard, seen, felt, etc.
senses.chn: 清晰的；清楚的；明白的；明显的

ex.en: There was a distinct smell of gas.
ex.cn: 有一股明显的煤气味。

ex.en: His voice was quiet but every word was distinct.
ex.cn: 他说话声音不大，但字字清晰。

senses.def: clearly different or of a different kind
senses.chn: 截然不同的；有区别的；不同种类的

ex.en: The results of the survey fell into two distinct groups.
ex.cn: 调查结果分为截然不同的两组。

ex.en: Jamaican reggae music is quite distinct from North American jazz or blues.
ex.cn: 牙买加的雷盖音乐完全不同于北美的爵士乐或布鲁斯音乐。

ex.en: rural areas, as distinct from major cities
ex.cn: 完全不同于大城市的农村地区

senses.def: used to emphasize that you think an idea or situation definitely exists and is important
senses.chn: 确定无疑的；确实的；确切的

ex.en: Being tall gave Tony a distinct advantage.
ex.cn: 托尼个子高是个明显的优势。

ex.en: I had the distinct impression I was being watched.
ex.cn: 我确实感到有人在监视我。

ex.en: A strike is now a distinct possibility.
ex.cn: 目前罢工确有可能发生。

senses.def: a clear difference or contrast especially between people or things that are similar or related

ex.en: distinctions between traditional and modern societies
ex.cn: 传统社会和现代社会的差别

ex.en: Philosophers did not use to make a distinction between arts and science.
ex.cn: 哲学家过去不把人文科学和自然科学区别开来。

ex.en: We need to draw a distinction between the two events.
ex.cn: 我们得把两起事件区别开来。

senses.def: the quality of being excellent or important

ex.en: a writer of distinction
ex.cn: 优秀作家

senses.def: the quality of being sth that is special

ex.en: She had the distinction of being the first woman to fly the Atlantic.
ex.cn: 她不同凡响，是第一个飞越大西洋的女子。

senses.def: the separation of people or things into different groups

ex.en: The new law makes no distinction between adults and children (= treats them equally).
ex.cn: 这项新法规对成人和孩子同样适用。

ex.en: All groups are entitled to this money without distinction.
ex.cn: 所有团体一律有权得到这笔款项。

senses.def: a special mark/grade or award that is given to sb, especially a student, for excellent work
senses.chn: （尤指给学生的）优等评分，荣誉，奖赏

ex.en: Naomi got a distinction in maths.
ex.cn: 娜奥米的数学得了优等。

ex.en: He graduated with distinction.
ex.cn: 他以优异成绩毕业。

senses.def: having a quality or characteristic that makes sth different and easily noticed
senses.chn: 独特的；特别的；有特色的

ex.en: clothes with a distinctive style
ex.cn: 式样独特的衣服

ex.en: The male bird has distinctive white markings on its head.
ex.cn: 雄鸟的头上有明显的白色斑纹。

senses.def: to recognize the difference between two people or things

ex.en: At what age are children able to distinguish between right and wrong?
ex.cn: 儿童到什么年龄才能明辨是非？

ex.en: It was hard to distinguish one twin from the other.
ex.cn: 很难分辨出一对孪生儿谁是谁。

ex.en: Sometimes reality and fantasy are hard to distinguish.
ex.cn: 有时候现实和幻想很难区分。

senses.def: to be a characteristic that makes two people, animals or things different
senses.chn: 成为…的特征；使具有…的特色；使有别于

ex.en: What was it that distinguished her from her classmates?
ex.cn: 是什么使得她有别于班上其他同学呢？

ex.en: The male bird is distinguished from the female by its red beak.
ex.cn: 雄鸟喙红色，有别于雌鸟。

ex.en: Does your cat have any distinguishing marks?
ex.cn: 你的猫有什么特殊斑纹吗？

senses.def: to be able to see or hear sth

ex.en: I could not distinguish her words, but she sounded agitated.
ex.cn: 我听不清她说的话，但听得出她很激动。

senses.def: to do sth so well that people notice and admire you
senses.chn: 使出众；使著名；使受人青睐

ex.en: She has already distinguished herself as an athlete.
ex.cn: 作为运动员她已享有盛名。

senses.def: very successful and admired by other people

ex.en: a distinguished career in medicine
ex.cn: 在医学领域的辉煌生涯

senses.def: having an appearance that makes sb look important or that makes people admire or respect them
senses.chn: 显得重要的；高贵的；有尊严的

ex.en: I think grey hair makes you look very distinguished.
ex.cn: 我认为灰白的头发使你看上去特别可敬。

senses.def: to change the shape, appearance or sound of sth so that it is strange or not clear

ex.en: a fairground mirror that distorts your shape
ex.cn: 露天游乐场的哈哈镜

ex.en: The loudspeaker seemed to distort his voice.
ex.cn: 他的声音从喇叭里传出来好像失真了。

senses.def: to twist or change facts, ideas, etc. so that they are no longer correct or true

ex.en: Newspapers are often guilty of distorting the truth.
ex.cn: 报章常犯歪曲事实的错误。

ex.en: The article gave a distorted picture of his childhood.
ex.cn: 这篇文章对他的童年作了歪曲的描述。

senses.def: to take sb's attention away from what they are trying to do
senses.chn: 转移（注意力）；分散（思想）；使分心

ex.en: You're distracting me from my work.
ex.cn: 你使我不能专心工作。

ex.en: Don't talk to her—she's very easily distracted.
ex.cn: 不要同她讲话，她的注意力很容易分散。

ex.en: It was another attempt to distract attention from the truth.
ex.cn: 这又是企图分散人们对事实真相的注意力。

senses.def: unable to pay attention to sb/sth because you are worried or thinking about sth else
senses.chn: 注意力分散的；思想不集中的

senses.def: a thing that takes your attention away from what you are doing or thinking about
senses.chn: 分散注意力的事物；使人分心的事物

ex.en: I find it hard to work at home because there are too many distractions.
ex.cn: 我发觉在家里工作很难，因为使人分心的事太多。

ex.en: cinema audiences looking for distraction
ex.cn: 寻求解闷的电影观众

senses.def: an activity that amuses or entertains you
so that you become upset, excited or angry, and not able to think clearly
senses.chn: 到心烦意乱（或激动、气愤）的地步

ex.en: The children are driving me to distraction today.
ex.cn: 今天孩子们闹得我心烦意乱。

senses.def: a person or thing that takes your attention away from what you should be doing
one of the wrong answers in a multiple-choice test
extremely upset and anxious so that you cannot think clearly
senses.chn: 心烦意乱的；心急如焚的；发狂的

senses.def: a feeling of great worry or unhappiness; great suffering

ex.en: The newspaper article caused the actor considerable distress.
ex.cn: 报上的文章给这位演员带来极大的痛苦。

ex.en: She was obviously in distress after the attack.
ex.cn: 她受到攻击后显然很痛苦。

ex.en: deep emotional distress
ex.cn: 感情上的深深痛苦

senses.def: suffering and problems caused by not having enough money, food, etc.

ex.en: economic/financial distress
ex.cn: 经济拮据；财政困难

senses.def: a situation in which a ship, plane, etc. is in danger or difficulty and needs help

ex.en: a distress signal (= a message asking for help)
ex.cn: 求救信号

ex.en: It is a rule of the sea to help another boat in distress.
ex.cn: 救助别的遇难船是海上的规则。

senses.def: a woman who needs help
senses.chn: 落难女子；需要帮助的女子

senses.def: to make sb feel very worried or unhappy

ex.en: It was clear that the letter had deeply distressed her.
ex.cn: 这封信显然使她极为悲伤。

ex.en: Don't distress yourself (= don't worry).
ex.cn: 你别犯愁了。

senses.def: upset and anxious

ex.en: He was too distressed and confused to answer their questions.
ex.cn: 他非常苦恼而困惑，无法回答他们的问题。

senses.def: suffering pain; in a poor physical condition

ex.en: When the baby was born, it was blue and distressed.
ex.cn: 这婴儿出生时全身发青，非常虚弱。

senses.def: made to look older and more worn than it really is
senses.chn: 刻意磨损以显老旧的；做旧的

ex.en: a distressed leather jacket
ex.cn: 做旧的皮夹克

senses.def: having problems caused by lack of money
senses.chn: 贫困的；窘迫的；受经济困扰的

ex.en: They buy up financially distressed companies.
ex.cn: 他们收购陷入财务危机的公司。

ex.en: The charity helps kids in distressed situations.
ex.cn: 这个慈善机构帮助处于困境的儿童。

senses.def: making you feel extremely upset, especially because of sb's suffering
senses.chn: 使人痛苦的；令人苦恼的

senses.def: to give things to a large number of people; to share sth between a number of people

ex.en: The newspaper is distributed free.
ex.cn: 本报免费派发。

ex.en: The organization distributed food to the earthquake victims.
ex.cn: 这个机构向地震灾民分发了食品。

ex.en: The money was distributed among schools in the area.
ex.cn: 这笔款项是在本地区的学校中分配的。

senses.def: to send goods to shops/stores and businesses so that they can be sold

ex.en: Who distributes our products in the UK?
ex.cn: 谁在英国经销我们的产品？

senses.def: to spread sth, or different parts of sth, over an area

ex.en: Make sure that your weight is evenly distributed.
ex.cn: 要确保你的重量分布均匀。

senses.def: the way that sth is shared or exists over a particular area or among a particular group of people

ex.en: the unfair distribution of wealth
ex.cn: 财富分配不公

ex.en: The map shows the distribution of this species across the world.
ex.cn: 地图上标明了这一物种在全世界的分布情况。

ex.en: They studied the geographical distribution of the disease.
ex.cn: 他们研究了这种疾病的地域分布情况。

senses.def: the act of giving or delivering sth to a number of people

ex.en: the distribution of food and medicines to the flood victims
ex.cn: 向遭受洪灾的难民分发食品和药物

ex.en: He was arrested on drug distribution charges.
ex.cn: 他被指犯传播毒品罪而遭逮捕。

senses.def: the system of transporting and delivering goods

ex.en: distribution costs
ex.cn: 经销成本

ex.en: worldwide distribution systems
ex.cn: 全球经销系统

ex.en: marketing, sales and distribution
ex.cn: 营销、销售和经销

senses.def: a board that contains the connections for several electrical circuits
connected with distribution of goods
a person or company that supplies goods to shops/stores, etc.

ex.en: Japan's largest software distributor
ex.cn: 日本最大的软件分销公司

senses.def: a device in an engine that sends electric current to the spark plugs
an area of a country or town, especially one that has particular features

ex.en: the City of London's financial district
ex.cn: 伦敦市中心的金融区

senses.def: one of the areas which a country, town or state is divided into for purposes of organization, with official boundaries (= borders)

ex.en: a tax/postal district
ex.cn: 税务区；邮政区

ex.en: a school district
ex.cn: 学区

ex.en: congressional districts
ex.cn: 议会选区

ex.en: district councils
ex.cn: 区议会

senses.def: (in the US) a lawyer who is responsible for bringing criminal charges against sb in a particular area or state
(in the US) a court that deals with cases in a particular area
(in Britain) a nurse who visits patients in their homes
a feeling of not being able to trust sb/sth

ex.en: They looked at each other with distrust.
ex.cn: 他们心怀戒备地看着对方。

ex.en: He has a deep distrust of all modern technology.
ex.cn: 他对所有现代技术都深表怀疑。

senses.def: to feel that you cannot trust or believe sb/sth

ex.en: She distrusted his motives for wanting to see her again.
ex.cn: 她怀疑他想再见她一面是别有用心。

senses.def: to interrupt sb when they are trying to work, sleep, etc.

ex.en: I'm sorry to disturb you, but can I talk to you for a moment?
ex.cn: 对不起，打扰你一下，我能跟你谈一会儿吗？

ex.en: If you get up early, try not to disturb everyone else.
ex.cn: 如果你起得早，尽量不要打扰别人。

ex.en: Do not disturb (= a sign placed on the outside of the door of a hotel room, office, etc.)
ex.cn: 请勿打扰（旅馆房间、办公室等门上的提示牌）

ex.en: She awoke early after a disturbed night.
ex.cn: 她被闹腾了一夜，很早就醒了。

senses.def: to move sth or change its position

ex.en: Don't disturb the papers on my desk.
ex.cn: 别把我写字台上的文件弄乱了。

senses.def: to make sb worry

ex.en: The letter shocked and disturbed me.
ex.cn: 这封信使我感到震惊和不安。

ex.en: It disturbed her to realize that she was alone.
ex.cn: 她意识到自己孤单一人，心里感到很不安。

senses.def: actions that make you stop what you are doing, or that upset the normal state that sth is in; the act of disturbing sb/sth or the fact of being disturbed

ex.en: The building work is creating constant noise, dust and disturbance.
ex.cn: 建筑施工不断制造噪音、灰尘和干扰。

ex.en: a disturbance in the usual pattern of events
ex.cn: 对平常事情发展状况的干扰

ex.en: the disturbance of the local wildlife by tourists
ex.cn: 游客对当地野生动物的滋扰

senses.def: a situation in which people behave violently in a public place

ex.en: serious disturbances in the streets
ex.cn: 街上的严重骚乱

ex.en: He was charged with causing a disturbance after the game.
ex.cn: 他被指控在比赛结束后制造骚乱。

senses.def: a state in which sb's mind or a function of the body is upset and not working normally

ex.en: emotional disturbance
ex.cn: 情绪失常

senses.def: mentally ill, especially because of very unhappy or shocking experiences
senses.chn: 有精神病的；心理不正常的；精神紊乱的

ex.en: a special school for emotionally disturbed children
ex.cn: 为精神异常儿童开办的特殊学校

ex.en: The question is, was the man insane when he committed the crime?
ex.cn: 问题在于这男人犯罪时是否处于精神失常状态？

ex.en: the treatment of anxiety in neurotic patients
ex.cn: 对神经官能症病人焦虑感的治疗

ex.en: She became neurotic about keeping the house clean.
ex.cn: 她对保持房子清洁有点神经质。

ex.en: He works with emotionally disturbed children.
ex.cn: 他从事跟精神异常儿童有关的工作。

senses.def: unhappy and full of bad or shocking experiences
senses.chn: 不幸的；多灾多难的；坎坷的

ex.en: The killer had a disturbed family background.
ex.cn: 那名杀手出身于一个坎坷不幸的家庭。

senses.def: very anxious and unhappy about sth
senses.chn: 心神不安的；心烦意乱的；烦恼的

ex.en: I was deeply disturbed and depressed by the news.
ex.cn: 这消息使我深感不安和沮丧。

senses.def: making you feel anxious and upset or shocked
senses.chn: 引起烦恼的；令人不安的；引起恐慌的

ex.en: a disturbing piece of news
ex.cn: 一则令人不安的消息

senses.def: to make a group of people unable to agree with each other or work together
senses.chn: 使不统一；使不和；使纷争

ex.en: a disunited political party
ex.cn: 四分五裂的政党

senses.def: a lack of agreement between people

ex.en: disunity within the Conservative party
ex.cn: 保守党内部的不统一

senses.def: a situation in which sth is no longer being used

ex.en: The factory fell into disuse twenty years ago.
ex.cn: 这家工厂二十年前就废弃了。

senses.def: no longer used

ex.en: a disused station
ex.cn: 废弃的车站

senses.def: a long channel dug at the side of a field or road, to hold or take away water
to get rid of sth/sb because you no longer want or need it/them

ex.en: The new road building programme has been ditched.
ex.cn: 新的道路建设计划已废弃。

ex.en: He ditched his girlfriend.
ex.cn: 他把女朋友给甩了。

senses.def: if a pilot ditches an aircraft, or if it ditches, it lands in the sea in an emergency
senses.chn: 使（飞机）在海上紧急降落；（在海上）迫降

senses.def: to stay away from school without permission
extremely boring

ex.en: The question is, was the man insane when he committed the crime?
ex.cn: 问题在于这男人犯罪时是否处于精神失常状态？

ex.en: the treatment of anxiety in neurotic patients
ex.cn: 对神经官能症病人焦虑感的治疗

ex.en: She became neurotic about keeping the house clean.
ex.cn: 她对保持房子清洁有点神经质。

ex.en: He works with emotionally disturbed children.
ex.cn: 他从事跟精神异常儿童有关的工作。

senses.def: to hesitate about what to do because you are unable to decide

ex.en: Stop dithering and get on with it.
ex.cn: 别再犹豫了，继续干吧。

ex.en: She was dithering over what to wear.
ex.cn: 她拿不定主意穿什么好。

senses.def: a state of not being able to decide what you should do

ex.en: I'm in a dither about who to invite.
ex.cn: 我拿不定主意邀请谁。

senses.def: a state of excitement or worry

ex.en: Don't get yourself in a dither over everything.
ex.cn: 不要什么事都紧张兮兮。

senses.def: used with two objects. In the sentence 'I gave her the book', for example, the verb 'give' is ditransitive and 'her' and 'the books' are both objects.
senses.chn: 双及物的；（后接）双宾语的

senses.def: used, especially in a list, underneath a particular word or phrase, to show that it is repeated and to avoid having to write it again
used instead of a particular word or phrase, to avoid repeating it
senses.chn: （代替某一词语以免重复）同样，也一样

ex.en: The waiters were rude and unhelpful, the manager ditto.
ex.cn: 这些服务员态度生硬，服务不周，经理也一样。

senses.def: a short simple song
silly; not able to be trusted to remember things or to think in an organized way
senses.chn: 傻的；愚蠢的；忘性大的；糊涂的

senses.def: a substance that causes an increase in the flow of urine
active during the day
taking one day

ex.en: the diurnal rotation of the earth
ex.cn: 地球的周日自转

senses.def: a famous woman singer, especially an opera singer
senses.chn: 著名女歌唱家（尤指歌剧女主角）

senses.def: a bed with a thick base and a mattress
a long low soft seat without a back or arms
to jump into water with your head and arms going in first

ex.en: We dived into the river to cool off.
ex.cn: 我们一头跳进河里，凉快一下。

senses.def: to swim underwater wearing breathing equipment, collecting or looking at things

ex.en: to dive for pearls
ex.cn: 潜水采珠

ex.en: The main purpose of his holiday to Greece was to go diving.
ex.cn: 他到希腊度假的主要目的就是去潜水。

senses.def: to go to a deeper level underwater

ex.en: The whale dived as the harpoon struck it.

senses.chn: 脱氧核糖核酸（全写为 deoxyribonucleic acid，动植物的细胞中带有基因信息的化学物质）

ex.en: a DNA test
ex.cn: DNA 测试

senses.def: the particular pattern of genes in an individual person, especially used to identify sb or find out if sb has committed a crime *
used to refer to actions that you do not mention by name or do not know about

ex.en: What are you doing this evening?
ex.cn: 你今晚打算做什么？

ex.en: We will do what we can to help.
ex.cn: 我们会尽力帮助。

ex.en: Are you doing anything tomorrow evening?
ex.cn: 你明晚有事吗？

ex.en: The company ought to do something about the poor service.
ex.cn: 公司应该对差劲的服务采取点措施。

ex.en: What have you done to your hair?
ex.cn: 你的头发是怎么搞的？

ex.en: There's nothing to do (= no means of passing the time in an enjoyable way) in this place.
ex.cn: 这地方没什么好玩的。

senses.def: to act or behave in the way mentioned

ex.en: Do as you're told!
ex.cn: 叫你怎么做你就怎么做！

ex.en: They are free to do as they please.
ex.cn: 他们想怎么做就怎么做。

ex.en: You would do well to (= I advise you to) consider all the options before buying.
ex.cn: 你购买之前最好对各种选择都考虑一下。

senses.def: used to ask or talk about the success or progress of sb/sth

ex.en: How is the business doing?
ex.cn: 生意好吗？

ex.en: She did well out of (= made a big profit from) the deal.
ex.cn: 她从这笔交易中赚了不少钱。

ex.en: He's doing very well at school (= his work is good).
ex.cn: 他在学校里学习很不错。

ex.en: Both mother and baby are doing well (= after the birth of the baby).
ex.cn: 母子平安。

ex.en: How are you doing (= how are you)?
ex.cn: 你好吗？

senses.def: to work at or perform an activity or a task
senses.chn: 从事（工作）；进行（活动）；执行（任务）

ex.en: I'm doing some research on the subject.
ex.cn: 我正就这一课题进行研究。

ex.en: I have a number of things to do today.
ex.cn: 我今天有些事情要做。

ex.en: I do aerobics once a week.
ex.cn: 我每周做一次有氧健身运动。

ex.en: Let's do (= meet for) lunch.
ex.cn: 咱们一起吃顿午饭吧。

ex.en: Sorry. I don't do funny (= I can't be funny).
ex.cn: 对不起。我可不是开玩笑。

senses.def: used with nouns to talk about tasks such as cleaning, washing, arranging, etc.
senses.chn: （与名词连用，表示打扫、清洗、整理等）

ex.en: to do (= wash) the dishes
ex.cn: 洗碗碟

ex.en: to do (= arrange) the flowers
ex.cn: 插花

ex.en: I like the way you've done your hair.
ex.cn: 我喜欢你梳的发式。

senses.def: to perform the activity or task mentioned

ex.en: I like listening to the radio when I'm doing the ironing.
ex.cn: 我喜欢边熨衣服边听收音机。

ex.en: She did a lot of acting when she was at college.
ex.cn: 她在大学时演过很多戏。

ex.en: Let me do the dishes.
ex.cn: 我来洗碗吧。

ex.en: Michael said he would do the kitchen floor.
ex.cn: 迈克尔说他来擦洗厨房地板。

ex.en: It's your turn to do the table.
ex.cn: 轮到你摆餐具了。

ex.en: to do the shopping/cleaning/ironing/vacuuming
ex.cn: 买东西；打扫卫生；熨衣服；用吸尘器吸尘

senses.def: to work at sth as a job

ex.en: What do you do (= what is your job)?
ex.cn: 你干什么工作？

ex.en: What does she want to do when she leaves school?
ex.cn: 她毕业后想干什么？

ex.en: What did she do for a living?
ex.cn: 她过去干哪一行为生？

ex.en: What's Tom doing these days?
ex.cn: 汤姆最近在干什么？

senses.def: to learn or study sth

ex.en: I'm doing physics, biology and chemistry.
ex.cn: 我在学物理、生物和化学。

ex.en: Have you done any (= studied anything by) Keats?
ex.cn: 你读过济慈的作品吗？

senses.def: to find the answer to sth; to solve sth

ex.en: I can't do this sum.
ex.cn: 我不会做这道算术题。

ex.en: Are you good at doing crosswords?
ex.cn: 你擅长填纵横字谜吗？

senses.def: to produce or make sth

ex.en: to do a drawing/painting/sketch
ex.cn: 画画；绘画；画素描

ex.en: Does this pub do (= provide) lunches?
ex.cn: 这家酒馆供应午餐吗？

ex.en: Who's doing (= organizing and preparing) the food for the wedding reception?
ex.cn: 谁在承办婚宴的酒席？

ex.en: I'll do a copy for you.
ex.cn: 我将为你复印一份。

ex.en: I'll do you a copy.
ex.cn: 我将复印一份给你。

ex.en: She makes her own clothes.
ex.cn: 她自己做衣服。

senses.def: to perform or produce a play, an opera, etc.

ex.en: The local dramatic society is doing 'Hamlet' next month.
ex.cn: 地方戏剧社准备下月演出《哈姆雷特》。

senses.def: to copy sb's behaviour or the way sb speaks, sings, etc., especially in order to make people laugh
senses.chn: 仿效，模仿，扮演（尤为逗乐）

ex.en: He does a great Elvis Presley.
ex.cn: 他把埃尔维斯 · 普雷斯利模仿得惟妙惟肖。

ex.en: Can you do a Welsh accent?
ex.cn: 你能模仿威尔士口音吗？

senses.def: to finish sth

ex.en: Sit there and wait till I've done.
ex.cn: 坐在那儿等到我做完。

ex.en: I've done talking—let's get started.
ex.cn: 我的说话完了，咱们开始吧。

ex.en: Did you get your article done in time?
ex.cn: 你的论文按时完成了吗？

senses.def: to travel a particular distance

ex.en: How many miles did you do during your tour?
ex.cn: 你走了多少英里的旅程？

ex.en: My car does 40 miles to the gallon (= uses one gallon of petrol/gas to travel 40 miles).
ex.cn: 我的汽车每耗一加仑汽油可行驶 40 英里。

senses.def: to complete a journey/trip

ex.en: We did the round trip in two hours.
ex.cn: 我们两小时打了个来回。

senses.def: to travel at or reach a particular speed

ex.en: The car was doing 90 miles an hour.
ex.cn: 汽车以每小时 90 英里的速度行驶。

senses.def: to visit a place as a tourist

ex.en: We did Tokyo in three days.
ex.cn: 我们在东京游览了三天。

senses.def: to spend a period of time doing sth

ex.en: She did a year at college, but then dropped out.
ex.cn: 她在大学读了一年书，但后来就辍学了。

ex.en: He did six years (= in prison) for armed robbery.
ex.cn: 他因持械抢劫罪服了六年刑。

senses.def: to deal with or attend to sb/sth

ex.en: The hairdresser said she could do me (= cut my hair) at three.
ex.cn: 理发师说她三点钟可以给我理发。

senses.def: to be suitable or be enough for sb/sth

ex.en: 'Can you lend me some money?' 'Sure— will $20 do?'
ex.cn: “你能借给我一点钱吗？” “当然可以，20 元够吗？”

ex.en: These shoes won't do for the party.
ex.cn: 这双鞋聚会时穿不合适。

ex.en: The box will do fine as a table.
ex.cn: 这个箱子用作桌子还蛮不错。

ex.en: This room will do me nicely, thank you (= it has everything I need).
ex.cn: 这房间对我很合适，谢谢你。

senses.def: to cook sth

ex.en: How would you like your steak done?
ex.cn: 你的牛排要几成熟？

senses.def: to cheat sb

ex.en: This isn't a genuine antique—you've been done.
ex.cn: 这不是真正的古董，你上当了。

senses.def: to punish sb

ex.en: They did him for tax evasion.
ex.cn: 他们因他逃税而处罚了他。

ex.en: She got done for speeding.
ex.cn: 她因超速行驶而受到处罚。

senses.def: to steal from a place

ex.en: The gang did a warehouse and a supermarket.
ex.cn: 那帮匪徒抢劫了一个仓库和一家超级市场。

senses.def: to take an illegal drug

ex.en: He doesn't smoke, drink or do drugs.
ex.cn: 他不抽烟，不喝酒，也不吸毒。

senses.def: to have sex
to be about or connected with sb/sth
senses.chn: 关于；与…有关系（或有联系）

ex.en: 'What do you want to see me about?' 'It's to do with that letter you sent me.'
ex.cn: “你想见我有什么事？” “是关于你写给我的那封信。”

senses.def: used to talk about how much sb/sth is connected with sb/sth
senses.chn: 与…有些（毫无、有很大等）关系

ex.en: Her job has something to do with computers.
ex.cn: 她的工作与计算机有些关系。

ex.en: 'How much do you earn?' 'What's it got to do with you?'
ex.cn: “你挣多少钱？” “这跟你有什么关系？”

ex.en: Hard work has a lot to do with (= is an important reason for) her success.
ex.cn: 努力工作是她成功的重要原因。

ex.en: We don't have very much to do with our neighbours (= we do not speak to them very often).
ex.cn: 我们与邻居没什么来往。

ex.en: I'd have nothing to do with him, if I were you.
ex.cn: 如果我是你，我就不会跟他有任何瓜葛。

senses.def: used to say that a situation is not acceptable and should be changed or improved
senses.chn: （表示情况不令人满意、需要改变或改进）那不行，这不合适

ex.en: This is the third time you've been late this week; it simply won't do.
ex.cn: 这是你本周第三次迟到了，这可不行啊。

senses.def: used to say that sth does not make sb look attractive
senses.chn: 并不使某人漂亮一些／很多

ex.en: That hairstyle doesn't do anything for her.
ex.cn: 那种发型并不使她更漂亮。

senses.def: used to refuse a request

ex.en: 'Can you lend me ten dollars?' 'Nothing doing!'
ex.cn: “你能借给我十块钱吗？” “不行！”

senses.def: used to show that you intend to stop sb from doing sth that they were going to do
senses.chn: 不，你办不到；不，我不许你这样做；你敢

ex.en: Sharon went to get into the taxi. 'Oh no you don't,' said Steve.
ex.cn: 沙伦走过去要上出租车。“喔，不，你不许走。” 史蒂夫说道。

senses.def: used to show that you will not accept sth any longer
senses.chn: （表示不愿再接受）行了，得了，够了

ex.en: That does it, I'm off. I'm not having you swear at me like that.
ex.cn: 够了，我就要不客气了。我不能容忍你那样跟我骂骂咧咧的。

senses.def: used to say that an accident, a mistake, etc. has spoiled or ruined sth
senses.chn: 这下可糟了；这下可完了

ex.en: That's done it. You've completely broken it this time.
ex.cn: 这下可完了。你这回是把它彻底弄坏了。

senses.def: used to order sb to stop doing or saying sth

ex.en: That'll do, children—you're getting far too noisy.
ex.cn: 行啦，孩子们，你们简直吵死人了。

senses.def: used to ask how sb manages to obtain the thing mentioned

ex.en: What do you do for entertainment out here?
ex.cn: 你在这里有什么消遣？

senses.def: used to ask why sb/sth is in the place mentioned

ex.en: What are these shoes doing on my desk?
ex.cn: 这些鞋怎么在我的书桌上呢？

senses.def: to kill sb/yourself
to stop doing or having sth; to make sth end

ex.en: He thinks it's time we did away with the monarchy.
ex.cn: 他认为我们该废除君主制了。

senses.def: to criticize sb/sth unfairly
to ruin, destroy or kill sb/sth

ex.en: Without that contract, we're done for.
ex.cn: 要是没有那份合同，我们就完蛋了。

senses.def: to kill sb/yourself
to make sb very tired
senses.chn: 使筋疲力尽；使疲乏至极

ex.en: Come and sit down—you look done in.
ex.cn: 过来坐坐吧，你看样子累坏了。

senses.def: to injure a part of the body

ex.en: He did his back in lifting heavy furniture.
ex.cn: 他抬重家具时扭伤了腰。

senses.def: to unfairly prevent sb from having what they ought to have
senses.chn: （用不正当手段）阻止某人拥有，剥夺

ex.en: She was done out of her promotion.
ex.cn: 她受人算计而未获得提升。

senses.def: to attack and beat sb severely

ex.en: He was done over by a gang of thugs.
ex.cn: 他被一群暴徒毒打了一顿。

senses.def: to clean or decorate sth again

ex.en: The paintwork will need doing over soon.
ex.cn: 需要尽快重新油漆一遍。

senses.def: to do sth again

ex.en: She insisted that everything be done over.
ex.cn: 她坚持全部返工。

senses.def: to enter a building by force and steal things

ex.en: He got home to find that his flat had been done over.
ex.cn: 他到家后发现公寓里被盗了。

senses.def: to be fastened

ex.en: The skirt does up at the back.
ex.cn: 这条裙子在后面系扣。

senses.def: to fasten a coat, skirt, etc.

ex.en: He never bothers to do his jacket up.
ex.cn: 他向来都懒得扣外衣。

senses.def: to make sth into a package

ex.en: She was carrying a package done up in brown paper.
ex.cn: 她提着一个牛皮纸包。

senses.def: to repair and decorate a house, etc.

ex.en: He makes money by buying old houses and doing them up.
ex.cn: 他靠买旧房整修翻新赚钱。

senses.def: to make yourself more attractive by putting on make-up, attractive clothes, etc.
to manage without sb/sth
senses.chn: 没有…也行；没有…而设法对付过去

ex.en: She can't do without a secretary.
ex.cn: 她不能没有秘书。

ex.en: If they can't get it to us in time, we'll just have to do without.
ex.cn: 如果他们不能及时给我们拿来，我们就只好将就了。

ex.en: I could have done without being (= I wish I had not been) woken up at three in the morning.
ex.cn: 其实用不着在凌晨三点钟就把我叫醒。

senses.def: used before a full verb to form negative sentences and questions
senses.chn: （用于实义动词前构成否定句和疑问句）

ex.en: I don't like fish.
ex.cn: 我不喜欢鱼。

ex.en: They didn't go to Paris.
ex.cn: 他们没去巴黎。

ex.en: Don't forget to write.
ex.cn: 别忘了写信。

ex.en: Does she speak French?
ex.cn: 她会说法语吗？

senses.def: used to make question tags (= short questions at the end of statements)

ex.en: You live in New York, don't you?
ex.cn: 你住在纽约，不是吗？

ex.en: She doesn't work here, does she?
ex.cn: 她不在这里工作，对吧？

senses.def: used to avoid repeating a full verb

ex.en: He plays better than he did a year ago.
ex.cn: 他的球比一年前打得好了。

ex.en: She works harder than he does.
ex.cn: 她工作比他努力。

ex.en: 'Who won?' 'I did.'
ex.cn: “谁赢了？” “我赢了。”

ex.en: 'I love peaches.' ' So do I.'
ex.cn: “我爱吃桃子。” “我也爱吃。”

ex.en: 'I don't want to go back.' ' Neither do I.'
ex.cn: “我不想回去。” “我也不想。”

senses.def: used when no other auxiliary verb is present, to emphasize what you are saying
senses.chn: （句中无其他助动词时，用以加强语气）

ex.en: He does look tired.
ex.cn: 他的确显得很疲倦。

ex.en: She did at least write to say thank you.
ex.cn: 她至少还写了信道谢。

ex.en: Do shut up!
ex.cn: 把嘴给我闭上！

senses.def: used to change the order of the subject and verb when an adverb is moved to the front
senses.chn: （副词移置句首时，用以改变主语和动词的语序）

ex.en: Not only does she speak Spanish, she's also good with computers.
ex.cn: 她不仅会说西班牙语，还精通计算机。

senses.def: a party; a social event

ex.en: Are you having a big do for your birthday?
ex.cn: 你打算举行大型生日宴会吗？

senses.def: rules that you should follow

ex.en: Here are some dos and don'ts for exercise during pregnancy.
ex.cn: 这是妊娠期间锻炼的一些注意事项。

senses.def: used, especially as an exclamation, to say that you think that an action, decision, etc. is acceptable and appropriate because it means that everyone will be treated fairly
senses.chn: （尤用作感叹词，表示认为行动、决定等可以接受）彼此都要公平，应该公正才是

ex.en: Fair's fair—you can't expect them to cancel everything just because you can't make it.
ex.cn: 彼此都要公平，不可能就因为你不能出席就指望他们取消一切。

senses.def: able to be done

ex.en: It's not doable by Friday.
ex.cn: 这事星期五之前做不了。

senses.def: sexually attractive
to run away from a place without telling anyone
to show your naked bottom in public
to leave or run away from somewhere in a hurry, especially to avoid paying a bill or receiving a punishment
to slowly get angry
to be able to do whatever you like

ex.en: There were no children to cook for, so we could just please ourselves.
ex.cn: 因为不用给孩子做饭，我们就可以自便了。

senses.def: to stop doing or having sth; to make sth end

ex.en: He thinks it's time we did away with the monarchy.
ex.cn: 他认为我们该废除君主制了。

senses.def: to tell sb about sth that another person has done wrong

ex.en: Sue dobbed me in to the teacher.
ex.cn: 休向老师告了我一状。

senses.def: a way of addressing or talking about a doctor
senses.chn: （称呼或谈论时用语）医生，大夫

senses.def: a person whose job is to show tourists around a museum, etc. and talk to them about it
senses.chn: （博物馆等场所的）讲解员，向导

senses.def: quiet and easy to control
senses.chn: 驯服的；易驾驭的；易控制的

ex.en: a docile child/horse
ex.cn: 听话的孩子；温驯的马

senses.def: a part of a port where ships are repaired, or where goods are put onto or taken off them

ex.en: dock workers
ex.cn: 码头工人

ex.en: The ship was in dock.
ex.cn: 船泊在船坞。

senses.def: a group of docks in a port and the buildings around them that are used for repairing ships, storing goods, etc.
a raised platform for loading vehicles or trains
senses.chn: （供运货汽车或铁路货车装卸货物的）月台

senses.def: the part of a court where the person who has been accused of a crime stands or sits during a trial

ex.en: He's been in the dock (= on trial for a crime) several times already.
ex.cn: 他已受审几次。

senses.def: a wild plant of northern Europe with large thick leaves that can be rubbed on skin that has been stung by nettles to make it less painful
senses.chn: 酸模（北欧阔叶野草，可用来揉擦被荨麻刺伤的皮肤以止痛）

ex.en: dock leaves
ex.cn: 酸模叶

senses.def: if a ship docks or you dock a ship, it sails into a harbour and stays there
senses.chn: （使船）进港，停靠码头，进入船坞

ex.en: The ferry is expected to dock at 6.
ex.cn: 渡船预计在 6 点停靠码头。

senses.def: if two spacecraft dock, or are docked, they are joined together in space

ex.en: Next year, a technology module will be docked on the space station.
ex.cn: 明年将有一个技术舱与航天站对接。

senses.def: to take away part of sb's wages, etc.

ex.en: If you're late, your wages will be docked.
ex.cn: 如果你迟到了，就要扣你的工资。

ex.en: They've docked 15% off my pay for this week.
ex.cn: 本周他们扣掉了我 15% 的工资。

senses.def: to connect a computer to a docking station
senses.chn: 入坞（将电脑连接到扩展坞）

senses.def: to cut an animal's tail short
a person whose job is moving goods on and off ships
a document or label that shows what is in a package, which goods have been delivered, which jobs have been done, etc.
senses.chn: （载明包裹、发货、完工等情况的）单据，标签

senses.def: a list of cases to be dealt with in a particular court
senses.chn: 备审案件目录表；法院积案清单

senses.def: a list of items to be discussed at a meeting
a piece of equipment to which a portable device, for example a laptop computer, can be connected so that it can be used with a printer, a keyboard, speakers, etc.

ex.en: an iPod docking station
ex.cn: 苹果播放器基座

senses.def: the district near docks(= the place where ships are loaded and unloaded in a port)

ex.en: plans to further redevelop Bristol's docklands
ex.cn: 进一步开发布里斯托尔港区陆域的方案

senses.def: the area around the docks(= the place where ships are loaded and unloaded) in a port
an area with docks(= the place where ships are loaded and unloaded in a port) and equipment for building and repairing ships
a person who has been trained in medical science, whose job is to treat people who are ill/sick or injured

ex.en: You'd better see a doctor about that cough.
ex.cn: 你最好找医生治治你的咳嗽。

ex.en: Doctor Staples (= as a title/form of address)
ex.cn: 斯特普尔斯医生

senses.def: a place where a doctor sees patients

ex.en: an appointment at the doctor's
ex.cn: 诊所的预约门诊

senses.def: a person who has received the highest university degree

ex.en: a Doctor of Philosophy/Law
ex.cn: 哲学／法学博士

ex.en: Doctor Franks (= as a title/form of address)
ex.cn: 弗兰克斯博士

a port in Kent, south-east England, and the nearest English town to France. The part of the Channel between Dover and Calais (called the Strait of Dover) is one of the busiest sea routes in the world. The high white cliffs of Dover, which can be seen from a distance, have a special meaning to British people returning home by this route. Dover has a long history.
