ex.en: The match ended in a two-all draw.
ex.cn: 比赛以二平结束。

ex.en: He managed to hold Smith to a draw (= to stop him from winning when he seemed likely to do so).
ex.cn: 他总算与史密斯打了个平局。

senses.def: a competition in which the winners are chosen in a draw

ex.en: a prize draw
ex.cn: 抽奖

senses.def: a sports match for which the teams or players are chosen in a draw
senses.chn: 由抽签决定对手的比赛

ex.en: Liverpool have an away draw against Manchester United.
ex.cn: 利物浦队抽的签是在客场与曼彻斯特联队进行比赛。

senses.def: a set of matches for which the teams or players are chosen in a draw
senses.chn: 由抽签决定对手的系列比赛

ex.en: There are only two seeded players left in the top half of the draw.
ex.cn: 在抽签系列比赛的上半区就只剩下两名种子选手了。

senses.def: a person, a thing or an event that attracts a lot of people

ex.en: She is currently one of the biggest draws on the Irish music scene.
ex.cn: 她是目前爱尔兰音乐界最受欢迎的人物之一。

senses.def: an act of breathing in the smoke from a cigarette
to be quick to understand or react in a new situation

ex.en: You can't fool him—he's always quick on the draw.
ex.cn: 你骗不了他，他脑筋一向很快。

senses.def: to be quick at pulling out a gun in order to shoot it
the fact that chance decides sth, in a way that you cannot control
to get no response or result

ex.en: So far, the police investigation has drawn a blank.
ex.cn: 到目前为止警方的调查毫无结果。

senses.def: to say that sth is finished and not worth discussing any more
to move away from sb/sth

ex.en: He came close but she drew back.
ex.cn: 他靠近，而她却向后退。

senses.def: a disadvantage or problem that makes sth a less attractive idea

ex.en: The main drawback to it is the cost.
ex.cn: 它的主要缺点是成本高。

ex.en: This is the one major drawback of the new system.
ex.cn: 这是新系统的一大弊端。

senses.def: to make sb bleed
to stop doing sth and rest

ex.en: She talks all the time and hardly stops to draw breath.
ex.cn: 她一直滔滔不绝，几乎没停下来喘口气。

senses.def: to live; to be alive

ex.en: He was as kind a man as ever drew breath.
ex.cn: 他是世上少有的大善人。

senses.def: a bridge that can be pulled up, for example to stop people from entering a castle or to allow ships to pass under it
to reduce a supply of sth that has been created over a period of time; to be reduced

ex.en: There are many life events that can unexpectedly draw down savings.
ex.cn: 生活中许多意想不到的事情都可能会花费存款。

ex.en: If we don't cut costs our reserves will draw down.
ex.cn: 如果我们不削减开支，储备金就会减少。

senses.def: the act of reducing a supply of sth that has been created over a period of time; the amount used

ex.en: The cold winter has led to a larger-than-expected drawdown on oil stocks.
ex.cn: 寒冬使石油储备消耗量高出预料。

senses.def: the act of using money that is available to you; the amount used

ex.en: a drawdown of cash from the company's reserves
ex.cn: 从公司储备金中支取的一笔钱

senses.def: to take money from a fund that a bank, etc. has made available

ex.en: The company has already drawn down €600 million of its €725 million credit line.
ex.cn: 公司已从 7.25 亿欧元的授信额度中动用了 6 亿欧元。

ex.en: They can draw down on the loan at any time.
ex.cn: 他们可以随时提取这笔贷款。

senses.def: a part of a piece of furniture such as a desk, used for keeping things in. It is shaped like a box and has a handle on the front for pulling it out.

ex.en: in the top/middle/bottom drawer of the desk
ex.cn: 写字台的上层／中层／下层抽屉

senses.def: a person who writes a cheque
knickers or underpants , especially ones that cover the upper parts of the legs
to become dark earlier in the evening as winter gets nearer

ex.en: The nights/days are drawing in.
ex.cn: 天黑得越来越早了。

senses.def: a picture made using a pencil or pen rather than paint

ex.en: a pencil/charcoal drawing
ex.cn: 铅笔画；炭笔画

ex.en: a drawing of a yacht
ex.cn: 游艇素描画

ex.en: He did/made a drawing of the old farmhouse.
ex.cn: 他画了一幅古老农舍的素描。

ex.en: The children were drawing pictures of their pets.
ex.cn: 孩子在画他们的宠物。

ex.en: a collection of paintings by American artists
ex.cn: 美国艺术家的绘画作品集

ex.en: a pencil/charcoal drawing
ex.cn: 铅笔画；炭笔画

senses.def: the art or skill of making pictures, plans, etc. using a pen or pencil

ex.en: I'm not very good at drawing.
ex.cn: 我不擅长绘画。

ex.en: technical drawing
ex.cn: 工艺制图

senses.def: a large flat board used for holding a piece of paper while a drawing or plan is being made
to start thinking about a new way of doing sth after a previous plan or idea has failed
being prepared or considered

ex.en: It's just one of several projects on the drawing board.
ex.cn: 这只是正在筹划的几个项目中的一个。

senses.def: a short pin with a large round flat head, used especially for fastening paper to a board or wall
the ability of sb/sth to attract people
a room in a large house in which people relax and guests are entertained
to speak or say sth slowly with vowel sounds that are longer than usual

ex.en: 'Hi there!' she drawled lazily.
ex.cn: “喂，你好！” 她拖着长腔懒洋洋地说。

ex.en: He had a smooth drawling voice.
ex.cn: 他说起话来油嘴滑舌，带着拖腔。

senses.def: looking pale and thin because the person is ill/sick, tired or worried
senses.chn: （因身体不适、疲倦或忧虑）憔悴的，苍白的

senses.def: if a time or a season draws on, it passes

ex.en: Night was drawing on.
ex.cn: 夜渐深了。

senses.def: to become lighter in the evening as summer gets nearer

ex.en: The days/evenings are drawing out.
ex.cn: 白昼越来越长了。

senses.def: to make sb direct their anger, criticism, etc. at you, so that others do not have to face it
senses.chn: （为掩护他人）吸引…的火力，转移…的视线

senses.def: a piece of string sewn inside the material at the top of a bag, pair of trousers/pants, etc. that can be pulled tighter in order to make the opening smaller
senses.chn: （穿在袋口、裤腰上等的）拉绳，拉带，束带

ex.en: They fasten with a drawstring.
ex.cn: 它们是用拉绳系紧的。

senses.def: to be the person in a group who is chosen or forced to perform an unpleasant duty or task
senses.chn: 抽到倒霉签；被派做苦差事

ex.en: I drew the short straw and had to clean the toilets.
ex.cn: 我抽到了下下签，只得打扫厕所了。

senses.def: if a vehicle draws up, it arrives and stops

ex.en: The cab drew up outside the house.
ex.cn: 出租车在房子外面停了下来。

senses.def: a low flat vehicle pulled by horses and used in the past for carrying heavy loads, especially barrels of beer
senses.chn: 平板马车（旧时运重载如桶装啤酒）

senses.def: to be very afraid of sth; to fear that sth bad is going to happen

ex.en: This was the moment he had been dreading.
ex.cn: 这是他一直最担心的时刻。

ex.en: I dread being sick.
ex.cn: 我特别害怕生病。

ex.en: She dreads her husband finding out.
ex.cn: 她生怕丈夫察觉出来。

ex.en: I dread to think what would happen if there really was a fire here.
ex.cn: 我不敢想象假如这儿真的发生火灾会是什么情景。

ex.en: I both hoped and dreaded that he would come.
ex.cn: 我既希望又害怕他来。

senses.def: a feeling of great fear about sth that might or will happen in the future; a thing that causes this feeling

ex.en: The prospect of growing old fills me with dread.
ex.cn: 想到人会一天天老下去便使我充满恐惧。

ex.en: She has an irrational dread of hospitals.
ex.cn: 她对医院有莫名的恐惧。

ex.en: The committee members live in dread of (= are always worried about) anything that may cause a scandal.
ex.cn: 委员会成员整天提心吊胆，生怕有什么事会引起流言蜚语。

ex.en: My greatest dread is that my parents will find out.
ex.cn: 我最担心的就是父母会察觉出来。

senses.def: causing fear

ex.en: The dreaded moment had finally arrived.
ex.cn: 可怕的时刻终于来到了。

ex.en: Did I hear the dreaded word 'homework'?
ex.cn: 我是不是听到 “家庭作业” 这可怕的字眼了？

senses.def: very bad or unpleasant
senses.chn: 糟糕透顶的；讨厌的；令人不快的

ex.en: What dreadful weather!
ex.cn: 多么讨厌的天气！

ex.en: What a dreadful thing to say!
ex.cn: 话说得太难听了！

ex.en: It's dreadful the way they treat their staff.
ex.cn: 他们对待雇员的方式糟糕透了。

ex.en: How dreadful!
ex.cn: 多讨厌啊！

ex.en: Jane looked dreadful (= looked ill or tired).
ex.cn: 简看上去脸色很不好。

ex.en: What terrible news!
ex.cn: 多么骇人听闻的消息！

senses.def: used to emphasize how bad sth is
senses.chn: （强调糟糕的程度）极其的，极坏的

ex.en: She's making a dreadful mess of things.
ex.cn: 她把事情搞得一塌糊涂。

ex.en: I'm afraid there's been a dreadful mistake.
ex.cn: 恐怕是出了大错。

senses.def: causing fear or suffering
senses.chn: 可怕的；令人畏惧的；使人痛苦的

ex.en: a dreadful accident
ex.cn: 可怕的事故

ex.en: They suffered dreadful injuries.
ex.cn: 他们严重受伤。

senses.def: extremely; very much

ex.en: I'm dreadfully sorry.
ex.cn: 我感到非常抱歉。

ex.en: I miss you dreadfully.
ex.cn: 我非常想念你。

senses.def: very badly

ex.en: They suffered dreadfully during the war.
ex.cn: 他们在战争中遭受了巨大的痛苦。

senses.def: hair that is twisted into long thick pieces that hang down from the head, worn especially by Rastafarians
senses.chn: （尤指拉斯塔法里教派成员蓄的）长发绺，脏辫

senses.def: a type of ship used in war in the early 20th century
a series of images, events and feelings that happen in your mind while you are asleep

ex.en: I had a vivid dream about my old school.
ex.cn: 我做了一个非常逼真的梦，梦见了我的母校。

ex.en: I thought someone came into the bedroom, but it was just a dream.
ex.cn: 我还以为有人进了卧室，原来只是一场梦。

ex.en: 'Goodnight. Sweet dreams.'
ex.cn: “晚安。祝你做个好梦。”

senses.def: a wish to have or be sth, especially one that seems difficult to achieve

ex.en: Her lifelong dream was to be a famous writer.
ex.cn: 她的毕生愿望就是成为名作家。

ex.en: He wanted to be rich but it was an impossible dream.
ex.cn: 他想发财，然而这是不可能实现的梦想。

ex.en: If I win, it will be a dream come true.
ex.cn: 如果我赢了，那就是梦想成真。

ex.en: She tried to turn her dream of running her own business into reality.
ex.cn: 她努力实现经营自己企业的梦想。

ex.en: a dream car/house/job, etc.
ex.cn: 梦寐以求的汽车、房子、工作等

ex.en: I've finally found the man of my dreams.
ex.cn: 我终于找到了理想中的男人。

senses.def: a state of mind or a situation in which things do not seem real or part of normal life

ex.en: She walked around in a dream all day.
ex.cn: 她整天都在梦游似的到处转悠。

senses.def: a beautiful or wonderful person or thing
senses.chn: 梦一般美妙的人（或事物）；极美好的人（或事物）

ex.en: That meal was an absolute dream.
ex.cn: 那顿饭真是太棒了。

senses.def: to work very well

ex.en: My new car goes like a dream.
ex.cn: 我的新汽车性能好极了。

senses.def: to happen without problems, in the way that you had planned
senses.chn: 毫无困难；非常顺利；完美

senses.def: used to tell sb that sth they are hoping for is not likely to happen

ex.en: 'I'll be a manager before I'm 30.' 'In your dreams.'
ex.cn: “我要在 30 岁前当经理。” “你做梦。”

senses.def: so unpleasant that you cannot believe it is true

ex.en: In broad daylight the events of the night before seemed like a bad dream.
ex.cn: 在大白天里，前一天夜里发生的事情就像噩梦般令人难以置信。

senses.def: far more, better, etc. than you could ever have imagined or hoped for
senses.chn: 做梦都没想到；远远出乎所料；大大超出希望

senses.def: to experience a series of images, events and feelings in your mind while you are asleep

ex.en: Did I talk in my sleep? I must have been dreaming.
ex.cn: 我说梦话了吗？我肯定是在做梦。

ex.en: I dreamt about you last night.
ex.cn: 我昨晚梦见你了。

ex.en: Did it really happen or did I just dream it?
ex.cn: 这是真的吗？还是我在做梦？

ex.en: I dreamt (that) I got the job.
ex.cn: 我梦见自己得到了那份工作。

senses.def: to imagine and think about sth that you would like to happen

ex.en: She dreams of running her own business.
ex.cn: 她梦想自己开公司。

ex.en: It was the kind of trip most of us only dream about.
ex.cn: 对我们大多数人来说，这样的旅行只是梦想。

ex.en: I wouldn't dream of going without you (= I would never go without you).
ex.cn: 你不去，我绝对不会去。

ex.en: Who'd have dreamt it? They're getting married.
ex.cn: 谁会料到？他们要结婚了。

ex.en: I never dreamt (that) I'd actually get the job.
ex.cn: 我做梦也没想到会真的得到这份工作。

senses.def: to waste time just thinking about things you would like to do without actually doing anything
senses.chn: 梦幻似的度过；在遐想中虚度

senses.def: you say dream on to tell sb that an idea is not practical or likely to happen
to have an idea, especially a very unusual or silly one
senses.chn: 凭空想出，虚构出（尤指荒诞不经的事）

ex.en: Trust you to dream up a crazy idea like this!
ex.cn: 你这个人就是会想出这种荒唐的主意来！

senses.def: a man who is very attractive
senses.chn: 富有魅力的男子；迷人的男子

senses.def: a ring containing a decorated net, originally made by Native Americans, and thought to give its owner good dreams
senses.chn: 捕梦网（最初由美洲土著制作的一种带装饰网兜的圆环，据信能给主人带来好梦）

senses.def: a person who has ideas or plans that are not practical or realistic
senses.chn: 梦想家；空想家；不切实际的人

senses.def: a person who does not pay attention to what is happening around them, but thinks about other things instead
senses.chn: 做白日梦的人；出神的人；神不守舍的人

senses.def: a person who dreams

ex.en: Dreamers do not always remember their dreams.
ex.cn: 做梦的人并不总能记住自己的梦。

senses.def: a pleasant but not very realistic situation that only exists in your mind
senses.chn: 梦境；幻想世界；理想世界

ex.en: You must be living in dreamland if you think he'll change his mind.
ex.cn: 如果你认为他会改变主意，那你一定是在做梦。

senses.def: without dreams; deep and peaceful
as if existing or happening in a dream
senses.chn: 似在梦中的；如梦的；梦幻（般）的

senses.def: you say dream on to tell sb that an idea is not practical or likely to happen
to waste time just thinking about things you would like to do without actually doing anything
senses.chn: 梦幻似的度过；在遐想中虚度

senses.def: the best possible combination of people for a particular competition or activity
senses.chn: 梦之队；最佳阵容；最佳组合

senses.def: (used especially in newspapers about candidates for an election) a combination of people who, together, are considered to be the best
senses.chn: （尤用于报章，指大选的候选人）梦幻组合，最佳组合，最佳阵容

senses.def: a world that is not like the real world; a person's idea of reality that is not realistic
senses.chn: 幻想世界；理想世界；不现实的想法

ex.en: If he thinks it's easy to get a job, he's living in a dreamworld.
ex.cn: 如果他认为找工作容易，那他就是在白日做梦。

senses.def: looking as though you are thinking about other things and not paying attention to what is happening around you
senses.chn: 做白日梦的；心不在焉的

ex.en: She had a dreamy look in her eyes.
ex.cn: 她眼里带着心不在焉的神色。

senses.def: having a lot of imagination, but not very realistic

ex.en: Paul was dreamy and not very practical.
ex.cn: 保罗喜欢幻想，不太讲究实际。

senses.def: as if you are in a dream or asleep
senses.chn: 似在梦中的；模糊的；朦胧的；恍惚的

ex.en: He moved in the dreamy way of a man in a state of shock.
ex.cn: 他惊魂未定，恍恍惚惚。

senses.def: pleasant and gentle; that makes you feel relaxed

ex.en: a slow, dreamy melody
ex.cn: 缓慢柔和的旋律

senses.def: beautiful; wonderful

ex.en: What's he like? I bet he's really dreamy.
ex.cn: 他长得如何？我敢说他一定很俊。

senses.def: that makes you feel sad; dull and not interesting
senses.chn: 令人沮丧的；沉闷的；枯燥无味的

ex.en: a dreary winter's day
ex.cn: 阴沉的冬日

ex.en: a dreary film
ex.cn: 枯燥无味的影片

ex.en: a long and dreary journey on the train
ex.cn: 火车上漫长而乏味的旅程

senses.def: something that you think is of very bad quality

ex.en: The movie is utter dreck.
ex.cn: 那电影完全是垃圾。

senses.def: to remove mud, stones, etc. from the bottom of a river, canal, etc. using a boat or special machine, to make it deeper or to search for sth

ex.en: They're dredging the harbour so that larger ships can use it.
ex.cn: 他们正在疏浚港湾以便大船驶入。

ex.en: They dredge the bay for gravel.
ex.cn: 他们在挖掘海湾沙砾。

senses.def: to bring sth up from the bottom of a river, etc. using a boat or special machine

ex.en: waste dredged (up) from the seabed
ex.cn: 从海底打捞出的废物

senses.def: to cover food lightly with sugar, flour, etc.

ex.en: Dredge the top of the cake with icing sugar.
ex.cn: 把糖霜撒在蛋糕面上。

senses.def: to mention sth that has been forgotten, especially sth unpleasant or embarrassing
senses.chn: 重提，翻出（已遗忘的令人不快的往事）

ex.en: The papers keep trying to dredge up details of his past love life.
ex.cn: 这些报纸老是翻出他以往爱情生活的琐事。

senses.def: to manage to remember sth, especially sth that happened a long time ago

ex.en: Now she was dredging up memories from the depths of her mind.
ex.cn: 这时，她回忆起内心深处的往事。

senses.def: a boat or machine that is used to clear mud, etc. from the bottom of a river, or to make the river wider
the last drops of a liquid, mixed with little pieces of solid material that are left in the bottom of a container

ex.en: coffee dregs
ex.cn: 咖啡渣

senses.def: the worst and most useless parts of sth

ex.en: the dregs of society
ex.cn: 社会渣滓

senses.def: the last parts of sth

ex.en: the last dregs of daylight
ex.cn: 最后的余晖

senses.def: dull and depressing

ex.en: dreich weather on the Scottish coast
ex.cn: 苏格兰沿海地区阴郁的天气

senses.def: to make sb/sth completely wet

ex.en: We were caught in the storm and got drenched to the skin.
ex.cn: 我们遇上了暴雨，淋得浑身透湿。

ex.en: His face was drenched with sweat.
ex.cn: 他满头大汗。

ex.en: She drenched herself in perfume.
ex.cn: 她浑身洒满香水。

ex.en: The car had skidded on the wet road.
ex.cn: 汽车在湿路上打滑了。

ex.en: You'll get wet(= in the rain) if you go out now.
ex.cn: 你现在出去就会被淋湿。

ex.en: a lovely rich moist cake
ex.cn: 可爱的松软味浓的蛋糕

senses.def: a piece of women's clothing that is made in one piece and covers the body down to the legs, sometimes reaching to below the knees, or to the ankles

ex.en: a long white dress
ex.cn: 白色的长连衣裙

ex.en: a wedding dress
ex.cn: 婚纱

senses.def: clothes for either men or women

ex.en: to wear casual/formal dress
ex.cn: 穿便服／正装

ex.en: He has no dress sense (= no idea of how to dress well).
ex.cn: 他毫无服装品味。

senses.def: to put clothes on yourself/sb

ex.en: I dressed quickly.
ex.cn: 我很快穿好了衣服。

ex.en: She dressed the children in their best clothes.
ex.cn: 她给孩子们穿上了最漂亮的衣服。

ex.en: Get up and get dressed!
ex.cn: 起床穿衣服了！

senses.def: to wear a particular type or style of clothes

ex.en: to dress well/badly/fashionably/comfortably
ex.cn: 穿得好／不好／时髦／舒适

ex.en: You should dress for cold weather today.
ex.cn: 你今天应该穿防寒的衣服。

ex.en: She always dressed entirely in black.
ex.cn: 她一向全身黑色装束。

ex.en: He was dressed as a woman (= he was wearing women's clothes).
ex.cn: 他打扮得像个女人。

ex.en: warm clothing
ex.cn: 保暖服

ex.en: He was wearing a strange shapeless garment.
ex.cn: 他穿着一件不成形的奇怪衣服。

senses.def: to put on formal clothes

ex.en: Do they expect us to dress for dinner?
ex.cn: 他们要求我们穿正式服装赴宴吗？

senses.def: to provide clothes for sb

ex.en: He dresses many of Hollywood's most famous young stars.
ex.cn: 他为好莱坞许多最著名的年轻明星提供服装。

ex.cn: 他们采取了一些极为可疑的商业手段以取得目前在市场上的地位。

ex.cn: 他们认为这项计划对大多数家庭不一定有好处。

Dublin was the scene of the 1916 Easter Rising against the British, who ruled Ireland from Dublin's 13th-century castle until 1922. Many great writers and poets have come from Dublin, including Jonathan Swift, Oscar Wilde, George Bernard Shaw, W B Yeats and James Joyce.
senses.chn: 都柏林（爱尔兰共和国首都，位于东海岸，利菲河畔。1916 年爆发反抗英国的复活节起义。英国对爱尔兰的统治直到 1922 年才告结束，其政治中心位于 13 世纪建造的都柏林城堡。许多伟大的作家和诗人来自都柏林，包括乔纳森 · 斯威夫特、奥斯卡 · 王尔德、萧伯纳、W · B · 叶芝和詹姆斯 · 乔伊斯）

ex.cn: 他愤怒地噔噔走出了屋子。

ex.cn: 这个队的成功主要是她努力的结果。

ex.cn: 多数问题都是人为错误造成的。

ex.cn: 近年来肥胖儿童的数量急剧上升，很大程度上是由饮食和生活方式的改变引起的。

ex.cn: 肥胖儿童人数的增多主要是过去二十年来饮食和生活方式的改变所致。

ex.cn: 付款期限为 10 月 1 日。

ex.cn: 我还应有 15 天的休假。

ex.cn: 她很快该晋升了。
